title: Video-Coder: Reinforcing Agentic Coding for Video Generation
title_zh: Video-Coder：强化视频生成的智能体编程
abstract: Recent years have witnessed remarkable progress in video generation in terms of visual quality and temporal consistency. However, generating videos with precise spatial structure, coherent motion dynamics, and controllable scene composition remains challenging. In this paper, we introduce Video-Coder, the first attempt to train a code-driven video generation agent, which autonomously writes and executes code to construct a dynamic 3D scene (Draft Video) that provides structure and motion signals to downstream video generators. To support this paradigm, we design a dedicated data pipeline and curate two high-quality datasets, Video-Coder-SFT-6k and Video-Coder-RL-2k, which contain diverse prompts and ground-truth reference videos. We further develop the Video- Coder Harness, a unified interactive environment integrating code execution, 3D scene rendering, and execution feedback for agent training and inference. We then train Video-Coder with SFT fol- lowed by harness-native agentic reinforcement learning with dual reward feedback, which combines execution-based and video-based rewards. Additionally, we design an annealing training strategy that gradually reduces the execution reward over time, allowing the model to rely more on the video reward in the later training stages. Experiments show that Video-Coder achieves significant gains, improving Minimax-H3 by approximately 7 points on PhyGenBench and 24 points on VBench-2.0. We hope this work can serve as an open foundation for coding agents in video generation, and we fully open-source our data, models, and code
summary_zh: 现有视频生成难以控制空间结构与运动动态，提出训练代码驱动的视频生成agent，通过编写执行代码构建3D场景为下游生成器提供信号。
构建专用数据管线与交互环境Video-Coder Harness，集成代码执行、3D渲染与反馈，支持agent的SFT与原生强化学习训练。
采用双奖励反馈与退火训练策略，实验表明模型在PhyGenBench与VBench-2.0上分别提升约7和24分，已开源数据与代码。

title: CPU-ARC: Agentic Reasoning Caching for on-CPU Reasoning Reuse
title_zh: CPU-ARC：面向CPU推理复用的智能体推理缓存
abstract: Large language models reinvent the wheel all the time. They conflate task-solving with the execution of the solutions, which forces them to solve every problem from scratch. We show that once a task has been reasoned through, the application of its solution to a new problem instance can be done very efficiently and with little involvement from language models. We introduce agentic reasoning caching, a method for constructing robust CPU-executable agentic reasoning caches (ARCs) from LLM reasoning traces. ARCs show on-par performance with frontier LLMs across a range of difficult mathematical and scientific tasks, are fully explainable, continually trainable, robust to input perturbations, and 16-291x cheaper to invoke than the source model.
summary_zh: LLM将任务求解与执行混淆，导致每次均从头推理，存在重复计算问题。
提出智能体推理缓存方法，从LLM推理轨迹构建可在CPU上执行的ARC缓存。
ARC性能比肩前沿LLM，具备可解释与可微调性，且调用成本降低16-291倍。

title: On the Reliability of Majority-Vote Pseudo-Labels in Test-Time Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: 测试时强化学习中多数投票伪标签的可靠性研究
abstract: Test-time reinforcement learning (TTRL) adapts pretrained language models to unlabeled target-domain data using self-generated pseudo-labels, whose reliability remains poorly understood. We analyze majority-vote supervision for TTRL with online Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) and decompose its error into population-majority bias and prompt-dependent finite-rollout variation. Because population-majority bias is generally unidentifiable without external supervision, we focus on mitigating the downstream effects of finite-rollout variation. We propose \emph{Prompt-Conditional Distributionally Robust DPO (PC-Dr.DPO)}, which conditions within-prompt robust reweighting on observed vote reliability to make updates from sampling-sensitive prompts more conservative. We further introduce a cache-based mechanism to reduce self-supervised forgetting during online adaptation. Across six mathematical and knowledge-intensive reasoning benchmarks and five model backbones, PC-Dr.DPO matches or outperforms the strongest TTRL baseline in 24 of 30 settings.
summary_zh: 测试时强化学习依赖自生成伪标签，但多数投票伪标签的可靠性尚不明确，需分析其误差来源。
将多数投票监督的误差分解为群体多数偏差与有限 rollout 变异，并提出 PC-Dr.DPO 缓解后者影响。
PC-Dr.DPO 根据投票可靠性调整更新保守度，配合缓存机制防止遗忘，在多数设置下超越最强基线。

title: CodeQuant2: Enhanced Outlier Mitigation and Adaptive Clustering for Low-Precision LRMs
title_zh: CodeQuant2：面向低精度大型推理模型的异常值缓解与自适应聚类
abstract: Large reasoning models (LRMs) improve task performance by generating longer intermediate reasoning traces, but this substantially increases inference costs and makes low-precision quantization increasingly important. However, aggressively quantized models often perform poorly on reasoning tasks. We observe larger activation fluctuations during the first decoding steps of reasoning. Calibration that omits these early states may miss their activation fluctuations. To address these reasoning-specific quantization challenges, we propose \textbf{CodeQuant2}, a clustering-based LUT quantization framework for low-precision large reasoning models. CodeQuant2 mitigates activation outliers with rotation and scaling, uses clustering to represent non-uniform weight distributions, and adapts codebook sizes to the quantization difficulty of each layer. Guided by our observation of reasoning-time activation behavior, CodeQuant2 further improves calibration sample selection to better match actual decoding statistics. Combined with our customized LUT CUDA kernel, CodeQuant2 delivers substantial accuracy improvements on reasoning benchmarks while achieving up to $2.85\times$ speedup over BF16.
summary_zh: 大型推理模型长思维链推演导致推理成本高，但激进低精度量化会因早期解码激活波动大而严重损害性能。
提出CodeQuant2框架，通过旋转缩放缓解异常值，聚类表示非均匀权重，并按层量化难度自适应调整码本大小。
改进校准样本选择以匹配实际解码统计，配合定制LUT CUDA内核，在推理基准上显著提升精度并实现2.85倍加速。

title: Computer-Use Agents Are Embodied Generalists
title_zh: 计算机使用智能体是具身通用智能体
abstract: In many areas of AI, general-purpose models have increasingly replaced handcrafted methods and specialized architectures. We argue that embodied AI is poised for a similar shift. Our key claim is that embodied tasks can be formulated as interaction with digital software. Specifically, we build software that renders an agent's view of a physical environment on a screen and provides controls for acting in it. A computer-use agent (CUA) can then perform embodied tasks through the same screenshots and keyboard and mouse actions that it uses to operate ordinary software. Using a single CUA design and changing only the software, our entries win first-, second-, third-, and sixth-place prizes across four ECCV workshop competitions, without any competition-specific agent tuning. These results suggest that the skills CUAs learn on software, such as visual grounding, precise clicking, and exploration, already carry over to embodied tasks, giving CUAs a far broader scope in embodied AI than previously realized. We therefore advocate that computer-use agents can be embodied generalists. Further, we advocate that, by following the training strategy that made computer-use agents general, embodied AI can converge on a single general model as well, ushering in a new era of general embodied AI. Website: https://pranjal2041.github.io/cua-embodied
summary_zh: 具身AI依赖专用架构，本文提出将具身任务转化为与数字软件的交互，以统一通用模型替代定制方法。
构建软件渲染物理环境并提供控制，使计算机使用智能体（CUA）能通过截图和键鼠操作执行具身任务。
单一CUA设计在四项ECCV竞赛中获多项大奖，证明其视觉定位等技能可迁移，倡导发展通用具身AI。

title: GroundWork: Bridging Human and LLM Reasoning Through a Structured Argumentation Model
title_zh: GroundWork：基于结构化论证模型的人机推理协同系统
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into workflows that require reasoning over text documents, yet interaction remains largely conversational. This leaves argumentative structure implicit or embedded in text, making it difficult to maintain, compare, and revise arguments as analyses evolve. We present GroundWork, a mixed-initiative system that makes argument structure a shared, editable state for humans and LLMs. GroundWork operationalizes the Toulmin model of argumentation as a typed graph with explicit operations for human and LLM edits. It exposes this structure through coordinated corpus views and an editable workbench for constructing, comparing, testing, and tracing source-grounded arguments. We evaluate GroundWork through an expert study with four participants spanning consulting, product development, law, and immunology, and three use-case scenarios in intelligence, law, and medicine. Our findings show that GroundWork makes source-grounded arguments inspectable, comparable, and revisable as shared human-LLM state.
summary_zh: 人机交互多为对话式，论证结构隐含于文本，难以维护、对比和修改。
提出GroundWork系统，将Toulmin论证模型转化为类型化图，提供可编辑工作台供人机协同构建与测试论证。
专家评估表明，该系统能使基于来源的论证作为共享状态变得可检查、可对比且可修改。

title: BEV3SR: Evidence-Aware 3D Spatial Reasoning from Video
title_zh: BEV3SR：基于视频的证据感知3D空间推理
abstract: 3D spatial reasoning from video remains challenging for VLMs because videos provide sequential, view-local observations rather than persistent metric scene records. Many questions must be answered in a query-specified perspective rather than the observed camera viewpoint, and prompting with a fixed set of RGB views may miss sparse or occluded visual cues. To address these gaps, we introduce BEV3SR, a training-free and backbone-agnostic framework for RGB-D videos with camera parameters. BEV3SR turns video observations into queryable metric bird's-eye-view (BEV) scene memory and formalizes each query into an evidence-aware spatial task. The Spatial Task Formalizer specifies the query's reference frame, spatial constraints, objective, and evidence requirement. The evidence requirement determines the appropriate reasoning pathway. A query treated as requiring geometric evidence is handled by the Geometric Reasoner, which deterministically computes the answer using the metric BEV records in the query-specified reference frame. Otherwise, a query treated as requiring visual evidence is passed to the Visual Evidence Aligner, which uses BEV-indexed object records and their associated supporting views to retrieve object-consistent and scene-context RGB frames for VLM grounding. Within a standard 16-frame budget, BEV3SR consistently improves different VLM backbones across multiple 3D scene QA benchmarks, delivering large gains on spatially intensive questions and significant improvements on open-ended scene QA. These results demonstrate that BEV3SR offers an effective, efficient, and interpretable framework for explicit 3D spatial reasoning from video.
summary_zh: 视频VLM的3D空间推理受限于局部视角与遮挡，且常需在查询视角而非相机视角下作答。
提出BEV3SR框架，将视频转为可查询的BEV场景记忆，并依证据需求将查询分派至几何推理器或视觉对齐器。
无需训练且与骨干无关，在16帧预算下显著提升多骨干VLM的3D场景QA性能，推理高效可解释。

title: Agents on the Patch Path: Mining AI-Associated Security Remediation in GitHub Security Advisories
title_zh: GitHub安全建议中AI辅助安全修复的挖掘与分析
abstract: Autonomous coding agents are increasingly involved in software development, but their participation in real-world security remediation remains poorly understood. We investigate observable evidence of coding-agent involvement in commits referenced by reviewed GitHub Security Advisories (GHSAs), characterize the associated vulnerabilities, and examine review timing in relation to advisory disclosure routes. We develop a local-Git mining pipeline that identifies agent evidence through known agent accounts, explicit commit-message attribution, repository instruction files, and agent configuration artifacts. Linking these findings to GHSA-referenced commits yields 469 valid candidate advisories across 189 repositories, including 448 with direct attribution and 21 supported only by repository-level evidence. Claude is the most frequently observed tool family, followed by Copilot and Cursor. We further compare review timing against other advisories and historical baselines using an exact route--timing decomposition. Relative to advisories published in the same months, candidate advisories exhibit a modestly longer mean review lag, primarily associated with within-route timing rather than disclosure-route composition. Compared with a historical baseline, they exhibit substantially shorter mean review lags, with both route composition and within-route timing contributing to the difference. These findings demonstrate that coding-agent involvement is already observable across hundreds of security advisories and repositories, including high- and critical-severity vulnerabilities. By distinguishing direct attribution from repository-level adoption evidence and separating route-composition effects from within-route timing differences, we provide an empirical characterization of agent-associated remediation in the GHSA review pipeline.
summary_zh: 自主编码Agent参与真实安全修复的情况尚不明确，需实证分析其在GitHub安全建议（GHSA）相关提交中的参与度。
开发本地Git挖掘管道，通过Agent账户、提交信息归属及配置文件等特征识别Agent痕迹，提取出469个有效候选建议。
发现Claude等Agent已广泛参与高严重性漏洞修复；相比历史基线其审查延迟更短，为AI辅助安全修复提供了实证刻画。

title: Compaction, decay and reinforcement in a two-tier conversational memory: a paired evaluation against retrieval-augmented generation
title_zh: 双层对话记忆的压缩、衰减与强化及与RAG的对比评估
abstract: A conversational agent that remembers has to decide what to keep. Retrieval-augmented generation keeps the transcript and searches it; the alternative is to compact each turn into atomic facts and search those. We compare the two on LoCoMo, with both arms answering all 1,985 questions in one window, against the same stores, with the same generator and judge, and both predictions on one row, which licenses McNemar's exact test on the 512 questions where they disagree. On the four categories comparable work reports, compaction scores 71.4 per cent against 64.6, a lead of 6.8 points (p = 5.5e-08) at 34 per cent fewer prompt tokens. On all five, including the adversarial set comparable work drops, the lead falls to 2.0 and stops being significant, because the baseline leads adversarial by 14.6. That loss has a structure. Our lead falls as the reference answer demands more source wording, 9.6 points ahead at one or two reference words and 3.1 behind past eight, with token overlap moving the same way, so the judge is not the cause. Compaction keeps what a fact asserts and discards how it was said, so it wins where the answer is a value and loses where it is a phrasing. We also report four negative results with their power calculations.
summary_zh: 问题：对话agent需决定保留何种记忆。方法：对比RAG检索完整记录与将对话压缩为原子事实再检索两种策略。结论：在LoCoMo数据集上进行配对评估与McNemar检验。
问题：两种记忆策略整体效果差异。方法：在可比工作的四类问题上对比得分与提示词消耗。结论：压缩法得分71.4%领先RAG的64.6%（p=5.5e-08），且提示词减少34%。
问题：压缩法在对抗集失效的原因。方法：分析答案对源文本措辞的依赖程度与token重叠率。结论：压缩法丢弃原措辞仅保留事实，在需提取数值时胜出，在需原措辞时落败。

title: When Instruction Files Go Stale: Documentation Debt and Hidden Cost in Coding Agents
title_zh: 编码代理中的文档债务与隐藏成本
abstract: LLM-based coding agents such as Claude Code are guided by repository instruction files (also called context files or agent configuration files) like AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md, which are read in every agent session. As any documentation artifact, these files can fall behind the code and become stale (e.g., a test folder moves, but the file still points to the old one). In technical debt terms, such a stale instruction is documentation debt, and its interest is the cost it adds to every later agent session. Evaluations that check only task success can miss this cost, and the stale file can persist. In this study, we ask what leads agents to act on a stale instruction, how it affects their behavior and at what cost, and how they recover. We study three real-world stale instructions from active open-source repositories in depth, each a different kind of guidance: a test command, a code location, and a procedure for adding a component. Agents fix 22 maintenance tasks under three versions of each instruction (left stale, corrected to the current path, and removed), with the code and the task held fixed, and we analyze 732 trajectories of two models at the level of individual tool calls. We find that agents follow stale guidance when it is relevant to their tasks, sometimes even when correct information is available elsewhere. On the stale test command, Claude Sonnet 5.5 needed about two extra tool calls per run, a third more than with the corrected command; in the other cases, we could not detect a difference. Although agents generally recovered from the immediate failures, none repaired the underlying instruction file. Correcting the instructions eliminated operations on obsolete paths, while removing them prevented most. Our findings show that task success alone can hide the costs of documentation debt, highlighting the need to evaluate agent behavior beyond final outcomes.
summary_zh: 编码代理依赖指令文件指导，但文件易过时产生文档债务，且其利息成本常被仅看任务成功率的评估忽略。
研究三类真实过时指令，对比过时、修正与删除三种版本，分析732条轨迹以探究代理行为与成本。
代理会遵循相关过时指令致额外开销，虽能从失败恢复但均未修复指令文件；修正或删除指令可消除无效操作。
comment: 11 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables. Replication package: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23992004

title: Test-Time Compute Scales Better with Parallel Agent Teams
title_zh: 并行智能体团队实现更优的测试时计算扩展
abstract: Test-time scaling improves the performance of a fixed model by spending more computation at inference. There are two common ways to spend it on agents when a verifier can score every attempt. Best-of-N sampling runs many independent agents and keeps the best result but saturates quickly. One large team of collaborating agents can score higher but stops improving as it grows. Can we get the best of both? Our method, parallel agent teams, does so by sampling many small teams in parallel and keeping the best team's result. We test it on 12 long-horizon tasks from GPU kernels and formal proofs to exploit development. With a 27B model and a budget of 100 agents, parallel teams of ten beat parallel agents on 10 of 12 tasks and beat one team of 100 on all four tasks where we ran such large teams. At equal dollar cost the same parallel teams beat a frontier model on half the tasks. A simple statistical model shows that individual agents lose because their many samples have a low mean and that one large team loses because a single sample gets no gain from variance. Sampling many small teams in parallel balances a high mean with the gain from variance. Parallel agent teams thus offer a more effective way to scale test-time compute.
summary_zh: 测试时计算扩展存在瓶颈：Best-of-N独立采样易饱和，单一大型协作团队随规模增长收益递减。
提出并行智能体团队方法：并行采样多个小型协作团队，并保留最优团队的结果。
实验表明该方法在多数任务上优于独立采样与单一大型团队，且在同等成本下击败前沿模型，有效平衡了均值与方差收益。

title: Seeing What Matters: Benchmarking Task-Conditioned Actionable Spatial Belief for Manipulation
title_zh: 操作任务中的条件化可执行空间信念基准测试
abstract: When should a robot look at the cup, and when at the portafilter? Spatial-reasoning benchmarks evaluate whether a model can describe a scene, but manipulation needs something more specific: the ability to acquire the particular evidence that makes the current command executable. A view that is informative for one task can be useless for another, even at the same workstation. We introduce Seeing What Matters, a benchmark for task-conditioned actionable spatial belief in simulated tabletop manipulation. Across three domains--coffee workstation, drawer/cabinet, and microwave/appliance--the benchmark provides 860 frozen evaluation cases; expanding across methods, budgets, and inference repeats yields more than 115,000 evaluator episodes under two protocols: closed-loop actionability and same-object functional out-of-distribution generalization. Each case pairs a set of candidate RGB views with a manipulation command, shared scripted skills, and hidden postconditions, so the benchmark directly measures whether a view-selection policy acquires the observations its command actually needs. We also provide a diagnostic reference pipeline that maintains a spatial-functional belief state and ranks views by missing evidence. At primary budget settings, this pipeline reaches 98.8% closed-loop and 98.9% functional-OOD success; ablating the functional or command-binding components collapses performance to near zero. Seven vision-language models, evaluated on the same cases, reach only 26-43%. Replacing the reference pipeline's coverage metadata with frozen RGB-derived scores preserves 98.5%/98.9% success; shuffling the visual scores collapses it to 15%/11%, confirming that the result depends on image content. These gaps suggest that spatial belief for manipulation should be evaluated not by scene-level completeness, but by whether it acquires the evidence the current command requires.
summary_zh: 现有空间推理基准仅评估场景描述能力，但机器人操作需获取使当前指令可执行的特定证据，且同一场景下不同任务所需信息不同。
提出Seeing What Matters基准，包含860个评估用例，通过候选视角与操作指令配对，直接衡量视角选择策略是否获取了指令实际所需的观测。
实验表明，所提诊断流水线成功率近99%，移除功能或指令绑定组件则性能崩溃；而7个VLM仅达26-43%，凸显VLM在任务条件化空间推理上的不足。
comment: 22 pages (8 main + 14 supplement). Extended cross-domain evaluation and physical robot validation in progress

title: Knowing When to Intervene: Causal Evaluation of AI Agents
title_zh: AI智能体干预时机的因果评估
abstract: Current evaluations of agentic AI systems primarily rely on benchmarks. However, the static nature of benchmarks makes them uninformative about the value of auditing interventions at deployment time. For reliable deployment, we often need to determine within an agent's trajectory whether or not to intervene, e.g., by verifying the agent's current output or steering it toward different behavior, using either human review or more costly models or time-consuming agentic supervision. The value of such interventions is fundamentally a causal inference question, asking whether the causal effect of such an intervention is beneficial for the final outcome. Estimating this causal effect is particularly challenging due to the dynamic nature of the problem: the impact of an intervention depends on the current context and environment, as well as the agent's future behavior. We develop the first methodologically grounded framework for evaluating the causal effects of randomized interventions within agent trajectories. By leveraging a relatively small dataset of agent trajectories collected under randomized interventions such as verification or screening, we can estimate the dynamic causal effect of a rich class of (contextual) intervention policies. The structural parameters that we estimate can also be used to construct safety leaderboards that capture the risk of various agentic actions, which can be used by practitioners for audit prioritization. Applying our methods to tau-bench Retail, ToolSandbox, and ImpossibleBench, we find that intervention effects vary substantially across agent actions and states. More broadly, our work suggests a rich research agenda at the intersection of causal inference and agentic evaluation, which we believe is essential for the reliable and safe deployment of AI agents in the real world.
summary_zh: 现有静态基准无法评估智能体部署时的干预价值，需判断在轨迹中是否应干预以保障可靠部署。
提出首个基于因果推断的评估框架，利用随机干预轨迹数据，估计上下文干预策略的动态因果效应。
实验表明干预效应随动作和状态显著变化；估计的结构参数可构建安全排行榜，用于审计优先级排序。

title: Assessing the Impact of Retrieval-Augmented Generation on Algorithmic Problem-Solving
title_zh: 检索增强生成对算法问题求解的影响评估
abstract: Competitive programming problems pose distinctive challenges for Large Language Models, as they demand not only proficient code generation but also advanced algorithmic reasoning. This study presents a Retrieval-Augmented Generation approach specifically designed to enhance the capacity of Large Language Models to address such problems. Our approach integrates an embedding-based retrieval mechanism and a similarity search algorithm to identify analogous problems within a knowledge database, employing a dynamically adjusted threshold to mitigate retrieval noise. We conducted an evaluation using the CodeContests dataset, focusing on the test split problems that exhibit similarity to instances from the training split. The experimental framework considered three conditions: (i) problems provided solely with their original descriptions, (ii) problems supplemented with randomly selected examples from the training split, and (iii) problems augmented with similar examples retrieved through the proposed method. In addition, we incorporated a Min-K membership inference analysis to examine whether the generated code solutions were influenced by potential memorization of training data within the evaluated Large Language Models. This complementary perspective enables a deeper understanding of model behavior by distinguishing genuine generalization through retrieval from implicit recall of pretraining samples. Performance was assessed using both pass rates and the CodeForces Elo rating of the problems. The results provide empirical evidence that similarity-based retrieval substantially enhances Large Language Models performance in competitive programming scenarios, offering an scalable framework for improving code generation in algorithmic problem-solving contexts.
summary_zh: LLM解决算法竞赛题需强推理能力，本文提出RAG方法，通过嵌入检索与相似度搜索从知识库获取相似题，并动态调整阈值降噪。
在CodeContests数据集上对比无示例、随机示例与检索示例三种条件，并引入Min-K推断分析区分模型泛化与训练数据记忆。
实验表明，基于相似度的检索显著提升了LLM在算法编程场景下的通过率与Elo评分，为改进代码生成提供了可扩展框架。

title: Are These Programmers Ripe Enough to Eat? Evaluating How LLMs Handle Lexical Knowledge Conflicts in Translation
title_zh: LLM翻译中词汇知识冲突的评估研究
abstract: External lexical resources can help large language models (LLMs) translate texts in low-resource languages and specialized domains, but these resources may conflict with models' prior lexical knowledge. To isolate this conflict, we construct a controlled Mandarin-to-English translation task in which familiar source words are assigned new meanings within and across semantic categories. We treat these prompt-supplied meanings as contextual knowledge (CK) and systematically evaluate the effects of word frequency, sentence context, and prompt framing on the translated outputs. Across nine models, CK reliance is greater for less frequent source words and in sentence contexts that support the supplied meanings. Prompt framing can reduce CK reliance, but seven of nine models favor CK even when explicitly instructed to ignore the supplied meanings. Within model families, larger models are more likely than smaller models to utilize CK in their outputs. Three follow-up experiments further show that modal weakening lowers CK reliance, the effect of repetition depends on prompt layout, and the effect of reasoning varies across models. Overall, our controlled study reveals how CK reliance varies across conditions and models, motivating new methods to detect and evaluate lexical conflicts and guide models' lexical choices in LLM-based translation.
summary_zh: 问题：外部词汇资源与LLM先验知识存在冲突，影响翻译。方法：构建受控中英翻译任务并系统评估。结论：揭示知识依赖随条件与模型的变化规律。
方法：系统评估词频、句子上下文和提示框架对输出的影响。结论：低频词及支持上下文更依赖新义；多数模型即使被要求忽略新义仍倾向采用。
方法：进行模态削弱、重复和推理的后续实验。结论：模态削弱降低依赖，重复和推理效果各异，为检测冲突及指导词汇选择提供依据。

title: AnimWeb-Bench: Benchmarking Animated Webpage Code Generation from Videos
title_zh: AnimWeb-Bench：基于视频的动画网页代码生成基准
abstract: Animation is pervasive on the Web, the CSS animation property alone appears on over three-quarters of webpages. Yet existing webpage code generation benchmarks target static screenshots, user-triggered interactions, or isolated motion graphics, leaving the ability of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and coding agents to reconstruct complete animated webpages largely unexplored. To fill this gap, we introduce AnimWeb-Bench, the first benchmark for animated webpage code generation from videos. It comprises 124 real-world webpages spanning 7 application domains and 33 animation types, with 91.9% of pages combining multiple types, each paired with a reference video and the static assets of the original webpage. We further propose a human-aligned, two-dimensional evaluation protocol: Static Appearance Fidelity measures structure, text, color, and visual similarity on aligned keyframes, while Animation Fidelity tracks UI components across frames and compares their position, size, velocity, and appearance with those in the reference video. Evaluating 14 MLLMs and three coding agents reveals: (1) reproducing webpage animations is substantially more difficult than reproducing static appearance; (2) explicit frame inspection and render feedback improve the reconstruction quality of coding agents; and (3) rapid, continuous changes are harder to reproduce than discrete state transitions. Our code and dataset are available at https://starry1001.github.io/AnimWeb-Bench-website/ .
summary_zh: 现有网页代码生成基准缺乏对完整动画网页重建的评估，无法衡量MLLM和coding agent的动画生成能力。
提出AnimWeb-Bench基准，包含124个真实网页及参考视频，并提出静态外观与动画保真度二维评估协议。
实验表明动画重建远难于静态外观，逐帧检查与渲染反馈可提升agent质量，连续变化比离散状态更难重建。

title: Language as Trait, Politeness as Strategy: Controlled Tests of Linguistic Effects in LLM Social-Deduction Agents
title_zh: 语言作特质与礼貌作策略：LLM社交推理智能体的受控测试
abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents coordinate through conversation, and the same message can be phrased in simpler or more complex language, bluntly or politely. We test whether such differences change how other agents judge and act, using the LURK Werewolf framework, which separates each utterance's speech-act predicate from its natural-language realization. We rewrite only the realization, check that the game content is preserved, and replay each game day from saved checkpoints against a re-sampled control. We vary linguistic range consistently across a speaker's messages and politeness strategy per utterance. Across 30 games and 4,335 replays, neither manipulation changes the trust other agents place in the speaker, and no effect on votes or night actions survives correction for multiple comparisons; the largest uncorrected effect is that shifting range away from a neutral paraphrase changes about 4 percentage points more of the other players' votes. In natural play, 88% of face-threatening speech is bald on-record regardless of role.
summary_zh: 【问题】LLM智能体交流时，语言复杂度与礼貌性是否影响其他智能体的判断与行动？【方法】利用LURK狼人杀框架，仅改写话语的自然语言实现形式，通过重放游戏检查点进行受控对比实验。【结论】改变语言范围与礼貌策略均未显著改变其他智能体对说话者的信任，对投票或夜间行动也无显著影响。
【问题】如何分离并测试话语的语用行为与自然语言表达对智能体交互的独立影响？【方法】将话语的言语行为谓词与自然语言实现分离，仅重写自然语言部分并确保游戏内容不变，进行4300余次重放实验。【结论】即使将语言风格偏离中性改写，对其他玩家投票的最大未修正影响也仅约4个百分点。
【问题】在自然游戏交互中，智能体倾向于采用何种礼貌策略？【方法】观察并统计智能体在自然对话中面临面子威胁时的言语策略使用情况。【结论】无论智能体角色如何，88%的面子威胁言语均采用直言不讳的公开记录策略。

title: A Tight Hierarchy for Chain of Thought
title_zh: 思维链计算的紧致层级定理
abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning has emerged as a powerful paradigm for extending the computational capabilities of transformer-based models. A growing body of recent work has begun to uncover the fine-grained computational power of transformers augmented with CoT, as well as their connections to classical complexity theory. In this work, we advance this line of research by establishing the first hierarchy theorem for CoT-based computation. Our main result shows that for any reasonable resource bound $r(n) \geq n$ and any $\varepsilon > 0$, \[ \mathrm{CoT}(r(n)) \subsetneq \mathrm{CoT}(r(n)^{1+\varepsilon}), \] where $\mathrm{CoT}(r(n))$ denotes the class of decision problems solvable by transformers using $O(r(n))$ CoT reasoning steps on inputs of length $n$. Our result shows that increasing the number of CoT reasoning steps provably yields strictly greater computational power, establishing CoT steps as a fundamental resource in transformer-based computation. Unlike classical hierarchy theorems, which are typically proved via diagonalization, our approach leverages known coarse-grained simulations between CoT-augmented transformers and Turing machines in both directions. Building on these connections, we adapt the classical padding technique from complexity theory to this setting to obtain a tight hierarchy. A key technical contribution of our work is the implementation of padding within the transformer-based CoT model.
summary_zh: 为探究CoT增强Transformer的计算能力边界，本文建立了首个CoT计算的层级定理。
基于CoT与图灵机的双向模拟关系，将经典复杂度理论中的填充技术适配至CoT模型。
证明增加CoT步数能严格提升计算能力，确立了CoT步数作为Transformer计算的基础资源地位。

title: Diffusion-free Score Matching for Exact Conditional Sampling
title_zh: 无需扩散的分数匹配实现精确条件采样
abstract: The success of modern score-based generative models is largely driven by diffusion-based training, which learns a collection of time-indexed score fields corresponding to progressively noisier versions of the data distribution. While such models achieve impressive sample quality, leveraging them for sound probabilistic inference---particularly sampling from arbitrary conditionals of the model---remains challenging. This difficulty arises because conditioning information is only available for clean data and not for the higher noise levels required to generate exact conditional samples. In this paper, we introduce DIffusion-free SCOre matching (DISCO), a principled approach that sidesteps the need for time-dependent score fields altogether. Our method is based on an objective that, while reminiscent of diffusion-based training, estimates only a single score of the (slightly perturbed) data distribution, for which the exact conditional score is readily obtained. In experiments, DISCO is competitive with state-of-the-art diffusion models in terms of sample quality. More importantly, DISCO yields a more faithful representation of the underlying data distribution and---crucially---enables accurate sampling from arbitrary conditionals, outperforming standard heuristic samplers. This capability opens the door to principled and flexible probabilistic reasoning with score-based models.
summary_zh: 现有扩散模型难以从任意条件分布精确采样，因条件信息仅存于无噪数据而缺失于高噪水平。
提出DISCO方法，绕过时变分数场，仅估计单一的数据分布分数，从而直接获取精确条件分数。
实验表明DISCO采样质量媲美SOTA扩散模型，且能精确条件采样，优于启发式采样器。

title: GuardrailAgent: An Agentic Framework for Jailbreak Defense
title_zh: GuardrailAgent：一种用于越狱防御的多智能体框架
abstract: Despite undergoing safety training to align with human values, large language models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks that circumvent built-in safeguards and elicit malicious behaviors given by the adversary. Existing defenses are mostly static and fail to adapt to new or unknown attack strategies, providing limited resilience. To address these, we propose a multi-agent defense framework, GuardrailAgent, that offers adaptive, end-to-end protection. The system autonomously gathers and summarizes attack characteristics into a continuously updated knowledge base that supports both input- and output-side detection. A feedback module integrates misclassified cases for iterative improvement at minimal cost. Tested on over ten representative jailbreaks, the framework achieved a 93.1% input-side detection rate, 93.9% overall detection, and a 95.8% F1 score, while rapidly adapting to unseen attacks. These results demonstrate GuardrailAgent's outstanding capability to maintain LLM safety in the face of evolving jailbreak tactics.
summary_zh: LLM易受越狱攻击，现有防御多为静态且难以适应未知攻击策略。
提出多智能体框架GuardrailAgent，自主提取攻击特征更新知识库，支持输入输出双侧检测与反馈迭代。
在十余种攻击下实现93.9%整体检测率与95.8%的F1分数，且能快速适应未见攻击。

title: What to Delegate, What to Preserve: Human Preferences for Agentic AI Across Everyday Life and Work
title_zh: 日常与工作中人类对智能体AI的委托偏好
abstract: AI agents can execute multi-step tasks on users' behalf, yet the boundaries of acceptable delegation remain unclear. We report a scenario-based survey of 289 U.S. adults with prior AI experience covering 45 use cases across nine life domains. Each respondent evaluated one scenario per domain, producing repeated measures of automation preference, trust, collaboration, AI leadership, privacy concern, and willingness to pay. Automation preferences varied substantially across domains. Generalized estimating equation models showed that greater trust in the AI agent, desired AI leadership, prior task-specific AI use, and anticipated financial savings were associated with greater automation preference. In contrast, concerns that automation would reduce personal fulfillment predicted lower automation preference. Open-ended responses further revealed a preference for bounded autonomy, with participants often favoring substantial AI execution while retaining human involvement, oversight, or final authority. We argue that delegation is best understood as a configuration of execution, collaboration, leadership, and authority.
summary_zh: 智能体AI的任务委托边界尚不明确，通过289人跨9个生活领域的45个场景调查，探究人类对AI自动化的偏好。
信任度、期望AI主导、先前使用经验及预期财务节省正向预测自动化偏好，而担忧降低个人成就感则负向预测。
人们偏好有限自主性，即在AI执行任务时保留人类参与、监督或最终决定权，委托应视为执行、协作与权威的配置。

title: MemoryDojo: Benchmarking Poisoning Through LLM Agent Memory
title_zh: MemoryDojo：基于LLM智能体记忆的投毒基准测试
abstract: LLM agents benefit from using memory systems to improve performance on long-horizon, multi-session tasks. However, memory introduces a critical attack surface. Malicious instructions encountered in one session may be stored and propagated through memory before being retrieved and acted upon in later sessions. Because memory systems differ in how they process and retrieve information, the downstream effects of poisoning can vary significantly across systems. To quantify the effects of poisoning across different memory architectures, we introduce MemoryDojo, a benchmark for tracing the lifecycle of poisoned information through agent memory and measuring its influence on subsequent agent behavior. MemoryDojo is easily extensible, consists of 155 multi-session long-horizon trajectories covering four domains, and supports five different memory systems. Through our evaluation, we find that all memory systems are susceptible to memory poisoning, with substantial variation in downstream effects. We further propose a memory-aware poison optimization process that increases the poisoning efficacy, highlighting differences between memory architectures. We hope that MemoryDojo will support research on understanding and mitigating agentic memory risks.
summary_zh: LLM智能体记忆系统易被恶意指令投毒并在后续会话中触发，但不同架构的下游影响差异大。
提出MemoryDojo基准，追踪投毒信息在记忆中的生命周期，量化其对后续行为的影响。
实验发现所有记忆系统均易受攻击，并提出记忆感知的投毒优化方法以提升攻击效力。

title: SPARSEUP: Towards Better Recipes for Training Modern Learned Sparse Retrievers
title_zh: SPARSEUP：训练现代学习型稀疏检索器的更好方案
abstract: Learned sparse embeddings are a powerful alternative to dense retrieval, yet they have fallen behind single-vector and late interaction models. One reason for their limited adoption is that they are notoriously difficult to train, generally requiring very tight conditions to converge. We present a recipe for training Splade-like encoders on modern backbones and data that achieves a better efficiency-effectiveness trade-off. We discuss the role of logit distribution and its impact on the training stability and the final sparsity of the encoder. We also introduce a new per-position fan-out control - a hard cap on how many vocabulary dimensions each position may emit. We further apply a simple vocabulary merging strategy that removes redundant entries - such as case and word-boundary variants of the same word - which are common in cased BPE-based backbones. We apply our recipe to the LateOn backbone and training data, obtaining SPARSEUP, a sparse encoder that reaches 56.4 average nDCG@10 on BEIR-13, the highest we know of among public vocabulary-based sparse encoders below 150M parameters.
summary_zh: 学习型稀疏检索器因训练条件苛刻难以收敛而落后于稠密检索，本文提出基于现代骨干网络与数据的训练方案以优化效率与效果权衡。
分析 logit 分布对训练稳定性和最终稀疏性的影响，并引入逐位置扇出控制以硬性限制每个位置激活的词汇维度数。
采用词汇合并策略去除冗余词条，构建的 SPARSEUP 模型在 BEIR-13 上达 56.4 nDCG@10，创同规模稀疏编码器新高。

title: How Much Conversation History Does an AI Agent Need?
title_zh: AI Agent需要多少对话历史？
abstract: How does using less conversational history change reader-token use and benchmark scores? We examine this question on 1,100 BEAM questions. We held the retrieval ranking and reader constant across five fixed passage budgets, and mean assigned scores rose as the passage budget grew. The score gain per additional token became smaller at the upper tested budgets. Answerable questions generally received higher scores with more context. Pooled abstention scores sometimes rose as the passage budget shrank. We also tested message retention in a controlled task with explicit conversational-state targets and compared retained user messages with token-matched recency. Qwen matched the full state more often for direct requirements when user messages were retained. Its full-state matching declined when answers depended on references to earlier offers. Mistral produced near-floor results across the retention conditions. A scoring audit leaves the correctness of BEAM answers unresolved. These experiments characterize the token and score consequences of the tested memory budgets. Reliable budget selection depends on retaining the evidence each question requires and validating the measure used to assess answer quality.
summary_zh: 问题：减少对话历史如何影响token用量与评分？方法：在BEAM数据集上测试不同上下文预算。结论：上下文越多评分越高，但边际收益递减，缩减预算有时会提升弃权评分。
问题：不同消息保留策略如何影响模型状态匹配？方法：对比保留用户消息与基于近期的token匹配策略。结论：Qwen对直接要求匹配更好，但处理早期引用时下降；Mistral表现极差。
问题：如何可靠选择记忆预算？方法：审计评分并分析实验结果。结论：需确保保留问题所需证据，并验证评估答案质量的指标。

title: Differentially Private GraphRAG: Protecting Relation Connectivity and Semantics
title_zh: 差分隐私GraphRAG：保护关系连接与语义
abstract: Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GraphRAG) connects information across documents through entity relationships to support relational reasoning. However, black-box access to GraphRAG systems can enable adversaries to reconstruct knowledge graphs and recover both structural connectivity between entities and the semantics of their relationships. Existing defenses lack formal privacy guarantees and provide limited protection against such reconstruction attacks. We propose RelGuard, the first differentially private framework for GraphRAG, which provides formal privacy guarantees by mitigating connectivity leakage and protecting relations and their semantic meaning through relation removal. We formalize relation differential privacy (relation-DP), which bounds the distinguishability of mechanism outputs according to the semantic distance between alternative relations while accounting for relation removal. Building on this definition, we develop a four-step defense mechanism that sanitizes source documents before GraphRAG indexing by perturbing relation predicates or removing their associated connectivity using the exponential mechanism. Experiments across three GraphRAG systems and two targeted reconstruction attacks demonstrate that RelGuard provides stronger protection against reconstruction attacks than four existing defense mechanisms while better preserving downstream utility.
summary_zh: 黑盒访问GraphRAG易遭重构攻击泄露实体连接与关系语义，现有防御缺乏严格隐私保证。
提出RelGuard框架，形式化关系差分隐私(relation-DP)，通过移除或扰动关系谓词限制输出可区分性。
实验表明，相比四种现有防御，RelGuard能更强抵御重构攻击，且更好保持下游任务效用。

title: A Separation Principle for Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: 协作多智能体强化学习的分离原理
abstract: We study cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) problems in which agents evolve under decoupled noisy dynamics but share a population objective. A canonical example is a mobility operator that orchestrates a fleet of vehicles to meet customer demand. The stochastic and time-varying nature of these problems calls for learning approaches, yet existing MARL algorithms do not scale: learning assignment and routing jointly over the full state-action space becomes prohibitive as the number of agents grows. Formulating the problem over the space of probability measures, we prove a separation principle: the population cost-to-go function is upper bounded by an optimal transport problem whose transportation cost is the target-conditioned single-agent cost-to-go function. This simplifies the multi-agent problem to learning a single-agent policy and coordinating the agents via optimal transport. Building on this principle, we introduce SALT (Separation-based Assignment and Learning via optimal Transport), a family of algorithms that learn a target-conditioned single-agent policy using any standard reinforcement learning algorithm, and then coordinate the agents via optimal transport. Since learning occurs at the single-agent level, SALT scales to fleet sizes where MARL baselines become intractable and transfers without retraining to fleet sizes unseen during training. In a vehicle-delivery experiment on the southern Manhattan road network, where MARL baselines are computationally prohibitive, SALT improves travel time by 15-21% over a shortest-path routing heuristic. In stochastic grid worlds, SALT reduces average travel times by 23-61% relative to MARL baselines and scales to population sizes where these methods fail.
summary_zh: 现有MARL算法在智能体数量增长时，因联合状态动作空间过大而无法扩展。
在概率测度空间上证明分离原理，将多智能体问题简化为学习单智能体策略与最优传输协调。
提出SALT算法族，在单智能体层面学习，可扩展至MARL失效的规模，实验中显著降低出行时间。

title: Alignment by Confident Debate: Preference Learning from Multi-Agent Debate
title_zh: 基于置信辩论的对齐：多智能体辩论的偏好学习
abstract: Post-training language models for reasoning typically rely on gold answers, task-specific verifiers, or learned reward models, limiting scalability when such signals are scarce. Multi-agent debate offers a self-supervised alternative, but converting debate into reliable training supervision remains challenging: majority voting weights agreeing responses equally, lacks a principled tie-breaking rule, and is ill-defined for open-ended tasks without a canonical answer; likelihood-based scoring can conflate fluency with correctness; and homogeneous committees may reinforce correlated errors. We introduce Alignment by Confident Debate (AbCD), which converts debate traces into preference data without gold answer labels. A sampling-diverse committee debates each problem, after which final answers are clustered by task-level semantic equivalence. We use verifiable tasks (mathematical reasoning, multiple-choice quantitative QA, and executable code-generation) as a controlled test bed: their answer keys or executable checkers let us evaluate the quality of debate-derived supervision against ground truth, even though the oracle itself never uses gold labels. Post-training on the resulting preferences outperforms inference-only ensembling and debate, as well as SFT on the same traces, across five model families spanning 1B to 8B parameters and four datasets, improving consensus accuracy, with a maximum gain of $21.5_{pp}$. Ablations show that the approach transfers to a larger model and to code generation, while also revealing limitations of heterogeneous committees and agreement-based weighting. Overall, the results suggest that debate traces can yield useful preference supervision when answer equivalence is combined with confidence-weighted disagreement.
summary_zh: 现有LM推理对齐依赖金标答案或验证器，而多智能体辩论的多数投票和似然评分易受同质化错误和流畅度干扰，缺乏可靠监督。
提出AbCD方法，利用采样多样的智能体委员会进行辩论，按任务级语义等价聚类答案，无需金标标签即可从辩论轨迹构建偏好数据。
在多模型及数据集上，该方法后训练效果优于推理集成、辩论及SFT，共识准确率最高提升21.5pp，证实置信加权分歧的有效性。

title: CID: Measuring Cognitive Work Through Semantic State Change
title_zh: CID：通过语义状态变化度量认知工作
abstract: Traditional information theory provides powerful tools for analyzing statistical properties of information but offers limited insight into meaning and semantic transformation. It has never been possible to quantify the meaning of an arbitrary piece of information. Large language models represent information as vectors embedded within high-dimensional semantic spaces, enabling meaning to be analyzed geometrically. This paper defines semantic state as the vector representation of information within a model's semantic space and defines cognitive work as the transformation between semantic states, movement through semantic space. To quantify this transformation, we introduce the Contextual Information Differential (CID), a covariance-aware metric based on Mahalanobis distance measuring semantic displacement relative to the structure of the embedding manifold. By treating meaning as a geometric property of semantic space, CID provides a practical method for measuring semantic change, cognitive transformation, and information processing. This framework establishes a foundation for analyzing cognitive processing, learning, reasoning, knowledge generation, synthetic expertise, and human/AI collaboration through implementation-independent measurement of semantic state change in both human and artificial systems.
summary_zh: 传统信息论难以量化信息的语义与意义转换，需新方法度量语义变化。
利用 LLM 的高维语义空间，将语义状态定义为向量，认知工作定义为语义状态间的转换。
提出基于马氏距离的 CID 度量，为分析人机认知处理与协作提供与实现无关的测量基础。

title: StockASkill: A Local-First AgentSkill for Intelligent Stock Selection
title_zh: StockASkill：面向智能选股的本地优先AgentSkill
abstract: Quantitative equity selection and portfolio construction in emerging and cross-border markets frequently suffer from computational bottlenecks, remote API fragility, survivorship bias, and rigid execution constraints such as discrete board lots and investor-mandated drawdown limits. In this paper, we present StockASkill, a local-first, full-data-driven AgentSkill engineered as a specialized Quant Co-Processor for autonomous AI agents and quantitative researchers. Tailored for agile portfolios (10^5 ~ 10^7 RMB) where discrete lot execution and capital protection are mandatory, StockASkill embeds a columnar DuckDB OLAP engine over 42.44 million historical price records and 186,432 financial disclosures spanning 26 years across China A-shares, Hong Kong, US equities, and ETFs. By eliminating ad-hoc network dependencies during analysis, StockASkill reduces cross-sectional screening latency across 5,400+ equities from over 25 seconds to sub-0.5 seconds (a 95%+ reduction). We formalize an end-to-end mathematical pipeline integrating a 7+1 factor alpha model, an SLSQP convex optimizer under smooth CVaR drawdown surrogates with exact path projection, dynamic 100-share board lot integer quantization, and an autonomous thesis lifecycle finite-state machine. Furthermore, we provide a zero-disk, strongly-typed JSON streaming interface designed for high-throughput LLM tool-calling. Open-sourced at https://github.com/axjing/stockaskill, comprehensive empirical benchmarks from 2018 to 2024 demonstrate that the architecture achieves annualized Sharpe ratios exceeding 1.48 and Calmar ratios up to 2.17, while reducing max drawdown by up to 85% relative to benchmark indices.
summary_zh: 新兴市场量化选股常受API脆弱性、幸存者偏差及离散手数等执行约束困扰，需更稳健方案。
提出StockASkill，基于DuckDB构建本地优先的量化协处理器，集成7+1因子模型与CVaR优化器。
消除网络依赖使筛选延迟降95%以上，2018-2024实证年化夏普超1.48，最大回撤降85%。

title: Benchmarking Speaker Embedders in the Sub-Second Regime for Real-Time Voice AI Agents
title_zh: 亚秒级延迟下语音AI代理的说话人嵌入模型基准测试
abstract: Real-time Voice AI agents must separate the active user from intelligible background speech that survives conventional noise suppression. Background sources include television audio, family members, and colleagues. Production denoisers remove non-stationary environmental noise effectively. Background speech shares the spectral characteristics of the target and passes through, causing false acceptances in downstream speaker verification (SV) and automatic speech recognition (ASR). We benchmark open-source speaker embedders TitaNet-Large, TitaNet-Small, ECAPA-TDNN, CAM++, and SpeakerNet under a strict sub-second latency budget. Evaluation combines a controlled benchmark with a weighted human-annotated production set. Our controlled benchmark is built from real calls in which a second real speaker is injected into silence intervals at modulated amplitude. We report three findings. First, denoising before embedding is generally harmful and raises equal error rate (EER) across architectures. Second, truncating audio below the full voice-activity segment degrades every model. Third, roughly half of the TitaNet embedding is redundant for this task. Trailing dimensions encode population attributes such as language and gender. Such attributes carry little discriminative value in a demographically homogeneous user base. We distill these results into deployment guidance. Verification should run on raw audio with full voice-activity chunks. Thresholds should favor precision over F1. Truncated embeddings reduce the cost of similarity search.
summary_zh: 实时语音AI需分离背景语音，但背景语音频谱与目标相似会穿透降噪器，导致SV和ASR误判。
在亚秒级延迟预算下评估5种开源说话人嵌入模型，结合受控基准与人工标注的生产数据集。
发现降噪损害嵌入、截断音频降低性能、TitaNet半数维度冗余，据此给出原始音频输入等部署建议。
comment: 13 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. Accepted at AIST 2026

title: V-STORM: A Structure-Aware Grounded Chain of Thought Dataset for Faithful and Fine-Grained Spatio-Temporal Video Reasoning
title_zh: V-STORM：面向细粒度时空视频推理的结构感知溯源数据集
abstract: While MLLMs can often identify what happens in a video, they still struggle with fine-grained spatio-temporal reasoning, which requires precise grounding when and where the supporting evidence appears and composing such evidence into a coherent reasoning chain. This challenge is exacerbated by the lack of scalable data construction and evaluation pipelines that provide granular, verifiable supervision linking reasoning steps to explicit spatio-temporal evidence.To address this gap, we present V-STORM, a structure-aware framework that transforms videos into Spatio-Temporal Scene Graphs (STSGs) and derives Grounded Chain of Thought (GCoT) from validated evidence paths, making each reasoning step traceable to structured and verifiable spatio-temporal evidence.Under this framework, we construct a 260K-sample training set and a 3K-sample human-verified benchmark, both featuring GCoT annotations that link reasoning to explicit spatio-temporal evidence.Experiments reveal a clear separation between evidence localization and evidence composition: current MLLMs can often identify relevant spatio-temporal cues, yet still fail to integrate them into correct multi-step reasoning, exposing a bottleneck that answer-only evaluation largely obscures. Moreover, fine-tuning with V-STORM substantially improves both answer accuracy and grounding faithfulness, validating its effectiveness as supervision for faithful and evidence-grounded video reasoning. Our dataset, benchmark, and source code will be publicly released.
summary_zh: MLLMs在细粒度时空推理上存在困难，且缺乏可扩展的细粒度数据构建与评估流程。
提出V-STORM框架，将视频转为时空场景图并提取溯源思维链，使推理步骤可追溯验证。
实验发现当前MLLMs难以整合证据进行多步推理；用V-STORM微调可显著提升准确性与忠实度。

title: TimeOmni-Live: Continuous & Live Time Series Understanding with Long-Term Memory
title_zh: TimeOmni-Live：具备长期记忆的连续实时时序理解模型
abstract: Existing time series language models predominantly follow an offline, one-shot paradigm: they process fixed-length inputs independently and do not retain past states. This static approach fundamentally misaligns with the continuous nature of real-world streaming applications and fails to maintain the historical context necessary for cross-window reasoning. To bridge this gap, we introduce Continuous & Live Time Series Understanding (CL-TSU), a novel paradigm that shifts the focus toward maintaining a persistent, stateful understanding over open-ended data streams. To systematically evaluate this paradigm, we present LiveTS-Suite, the first comprehensive data suite tailored for CL-TSU, supporting data generation, model training, and systematic evaluation across 18 tasks spanning six core capabilities. It comprises over 5K streams totaling 2.2B timesteps, annotated with 15K specific response events. We further design an evaluation protocol that jointly assesses response timeliness, content accuracy, and computational efficiency. Building on this foundation, we propose TimeOmni-Live, the first live time series understanding model. It integrates a hybrid time series encoding for natively temporal input, a stream-persistent hybrid memory mechanism to effectively preserve exact historical evidence and long-term task states, and an elastic stream-inference synchronization strategy to reduce processing lag. Evaluations show that TimeOmni-Live establishes a strong baseline for CL-TSU, outperforming frontier LLMs (90.0 vs. 79.3 for Opus 5) with only 4B parameters and achieving 206$\times$ lower p95 latency than its backbone. Deployment on a Jetson edge device further shows its ability to support real-time continuous temporal understanding locally at the edge.
summary_zh: 现有离线时序模型无法保留历史状态，难以适应连续流数据并支持跨窗口推理。
提出CL-TSU新范式及LiveTS-Suite评测套件，含18项任务与2.2B时间步，综合评估响应时效、准确性与效率。
提出TimeOmni-Live模型，融合混合编码与持久记忆机制，以4B参数超越Opus 5，且p95延迟降低206倍，支持边缘端实时部署。

title: Nebula: Distributed Position-Independent Caching for LLM Serving
title_zh: Nebula：面向LLM服务的分布式位置无关缓存
abstract: Modern LLM workflows, such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and LLM agents, build long prompts from multiple independent text segments, making prefill a major source of computation. Reusing KV caches is therefore important for reducing serving costs and latency: distributed caching systems spread KV cache across a cluster to increase aggregate capacity, while position-independent caching (PIC) enables reuse of recurring segments under different prefixes. However, existing systems distribute KV caches but still rely on prefix caching (PC), while existing PIC methods enable position-independent reuse without cluster-wide resource management. We present Nebula, the first distributed LLM serving framework to treat PIC segments as first-class citizens, enabling remote PIC reuse and parallel prefill. To track PIC's fine-grained, asynchronous state changes, Nebula combines optimistic accounting with event-driven updates to provide a timely and truthful cluster view for cache management and prefill scheduling. To accommodate diverse reuse patterns across workloads, Nebula leverages cluster-wide ghost-hit feedback to automatically tune the allocation of shared cache capacity between PC and PIC. Finally, Nebula incorporates queueing, computation, and KV transfer costs into a unified prefill completion time model to guide elastic parallelism adjustment and locality-aware compute placement. Across four models and four real-world RAG and agentic workloads, Nebula reduces median TTFT by an average of 61.4% compared with the strongest existing baseline and recovers an average of 76.1% of the tokens missed by prefix caching.
summary_zh: 现代LLM工作流由多独立文本段构成长提示，复用KV cache可降本降延迟，但现有分布式缓存仅支持前缀缓存，缺乏位置无关缓存（PIC）的集群管理。
提出Nebula框架，首次将PIC段作为一等公民，结合乐观记账与事件驱动更新追踪状态，并基于集群反馈自动调节PC与PIC的共享缓存分配。
Nebula构建统一预填充完成时间模型指导弹性并行与计算放置，在多模型与真实RAG/Agent负载下，中位TTFT平均降低61.4%，恢复76.1%前缀缓存遗漏token。

title: ENGRAM: From Agent Experience to Weights through Verified Consolidation
title_zh: ENGRAM：基于验证整合的智能体经验权重化框架
abstract: Language-model agents use experience through external retrieval and parameter learning. Consolidating stored experience into model weights requires deciding both which experience to train on and when its external records can leave retrieval. Admission based solely on student mastery can exclude useful teacher demonstrations, while removal immediately after training can discard guidance that the model still needs. We introduce ENGRAM, a framework that separates training admission from memory release. A demonstration-aware gate admits skills based on student mastery or sufficient successful teacher demonstrations. The student learns from selected action traces with context from an Engram Trace Graph (ETG). A verification gate then compares the updated model without episodic retrieval against the base model with retrieval on reserved probes. Release requires valid training participation and scores meeting both relative and absolute criteria; records for skills that fail verification remain retrievable. Experiments across interactive and reasoning benchmarks show consistent gains over frozen-weight ETG controls, with ablations supporting demonstration-aware admission and selective adapter activation. A controlled held-out comparison shows that verified release substantially reduces the retrievable footprint while remaining close to retain-all performance and outperforming immediate and budget-matched random release. ENGRAM also improves task performance while reducing input-token usage and model calls. Skill-level verification further reduces retrievable experience through selective archival, retaining external guidance for skills that do not meet the release criteria. Code is available in anonymous.4open.science/r/engram-anonymous.
summary_zh: 现有方法将经验存入权重时，仅凭学生掌握度准入会遗漏教师示范，训练后立即移除会丢失仍需的指导。
提出ENGRAM框架，分离训练准入与记忆释放，通过示范感知门准入技能，利用ETG图提供上下文学习。
验证门对比更新模型与基线检索模型，仅验证通过的技能才释放记录；实验表明该方法减少检索足迹并提升性能。

title: Not All Entropy Is Equal: Reward-Conditioned Entropy Allocation in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
title_zh: 强化学习中基于奖励的条件熵分配
abstract: Policy entropy is widely used to diagnose exploration and collapse in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), yet its magnitude does not consistently track reasoning performance across optimization objectives. We argue that this ambiguity arises because global token entropy conflates uncertainty in successful and failed trajectories, diversity across correct solution strategies, and variation among realizations of the same strategy. We introduce \textbf{Reward-Conditioned Entropy Allocation (RCEA)}, a hierarchical diagnostic framework that separates complete-trajectory entropy from average token entropy, conditions uncertainty on verifier outcome and process validity, measures correct-solution-mode retention, and connects these population-level quantities to local covariance-driven updates. In controlled sweeps over six RLVR objectives at two model scales, entropy trajectories do not induce a stable ordering of reasoning accuracy. Token entropy is higher for verifier-failed than successful trajectories under both broad separately aggregated estimates and a common-question paired analysis, whose confidence intervals exclude equality at 10 of 12 displayed endpoints. A local covariance approximation predicts the direction of adjacent-checkpoint entropy change in 95.5\% of nonfailed transitions; a reward-stratified endpoint proxy further shows that positive chosen-token covariance is more tail-concentrated within failed prefixes. Every reportable trained endpoint exhibits some contraction in independently audited correct-solution-mode breadth, whose positive association with large-\(k\) coverage remains exploratory. These results show that entropy collapse should be diagnosed by which uncertainty is removed, rather than by global entropy alone.
summary_zh: 全局 token 熵混淆了成功与失败轨迹的不确定性，无法稳定追踪 RLVR 的推理性能。
提出 RCEA 框架，按验证结果分离轨迹熵与 token 熵，将群体指标关联至局部协方差更新。
实验表明失败轨迹 token 熵更高，局部协方差可预测熵变化方向，证明需按不确定性来源诊断熵坍缩。

title: Incentive Pathologies in a Live LLM Agent Arena: An Empirical Study of Concentration, Reward-Rule Implementation Discrepancy, and Network Dilution
title_zh: 实时LLM智能体竞技场的激励病态实证研究
abstract: We audit one live LLM agent arena (AITRAP; 22 autonomous agent seats, ~96,000 reasoning nodes) over nine days (Oct 16-25, 2026), during which the platform deployed two bundled incentive changes: a progressive tax reform (V2.9.3, Oct 19) and a seed-inversion with explorer-side action update (V3.0, Oct 21). These serve as before-and-after markers, not cleanly isolated interventions. Four exploratory predictions are tested against ten data frames (F1-F10) using the Gini coefficient, Top-K concentration share, code-level reconstruction of the continuation-bonus mechanism, and the Mann-Kendall trend test. The Gini analysis is inconclusive at 95% confidence (bootstrap intervals straddle 0.7). The Top-4 node-activity-score share falls from 97.2% (Oct 19, pre-V2.9.3) to 49.4% (Oct 25, post-V3.0; 56.7% under a merge-seat assumption). The continuation bonus, announced as depth-based x10, resolves at code level to a four-condition anti-abuse gate paying x2.85 in the typical case and permanently blocking the self-continuation it superficially rewards; the gate was active ~40 hours before the V3.0 announcement. The events-per-node ratio declines significantly (Mann-Kendall S=-45, z=-3.94, p=8.3e-5) from 7.36 to 7.069. We discuss implications for incentive designers, the announcement-implementation gap, and public peer review as an event record.
summary_zh: 针对LLM agent竞技场激励设计问题，审计平台连续9天的数据，分析累进税与种子反转两次激励变更的影响。
使用基尼系数等方法评估活动集中度，发现Top-4节点活动份额从97.2%降至49.4%，但基尼系数95%置信度下无定论。
揭示声明与代码实现的差异：宣称的深度x10续接奖励实际为x2.85且阻断自续接；节点事件比显著下降。
comment: 29 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables; data available at Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23691548

title: Agentic AI for Healthcare Claim Denial Analysis: A Policy-Grounded Framework for Privacy Preservation
title_zh: 基于策略的医疗索赔拒付分析智能体框架与隐私保护
abstract: In the healthcare sector, claim denials impose significant financial and administrative burdens, emphasizing the need for automated and trustworthy decision-support systems. This paper proposes a modular Agentic Artificial Intelligence (AI) framework for healthcare claim denial analysis, integrating specialized agents for denial risk prediction, risk factor identification, diagnosis-procedure-medication code relationship analysis, and counterfactual analysis. The framework integrates predictive analytics, graph-based learning, a Hybrid Contextual Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline grounded in healthcare policy documents, and a dedicated HIPAA Compliance Agent to support privacy protection. Evaluated on a synthetic healthcare claims dataset, the framework achieved 98% traceability of reported numerical findings, validated 214 of 216 policy citations, and removed all 280 identified sensitive identifiers without modifying the underlying analysis. These findings pave the way for further research into Agentic AI as a framework for explainable, policy-aware, and privacy-preserving healthcare claim denial management.
summary_zh: 医疗索赔拒付带来沉重负担，本文提出模块化 Agentic AI 框架，集成风险预测、关系分析与反事实分析等专用智能体。
为保障隐私与合规，框架结合图学习与混合上下文 RAG 管道，并引入 HIPAA 合规智能体以支持隐私保护。
实验表明，该框架数值可溯性达 98%，策略引用验证率极高，且成功移除全部敏感标识符，实现隐私保护下的可靠分析。

title: Typed-Centrality Grounding for Agentic GraphRAG: A Symbolic Approach for Agentic Reasoning
title_zh: 基于类型中心性符号接地代理GraphRAG方法
abstract: Knowledge Graphs (KGs) and Large Language Models (LLMs) represent two approaches for knowledge representation and reasoning over heterogeneous data. Recent research has explored their integration through Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GraphRAG) systems, which use KGs to provide structured context to LLMs. However, existing GraphRAG approaches treat KGs as homogeneous graphs and rely on textual similarity between the input prompt and the context, rather than using it as a source of deterministic knowledge. This work proposes an agent-based GraphRAG system that introduces a symbolic layer to integrate deterministic reasoning alongside text similarities. This approach is based on the definition of typed centralities for KGs, where centrality measures are computed separately for each specific KG's class. This information is used to construct a symbolic representation that is provided to the LLM as a deterministic source. The proposed system was mathematically validated and evaluated on a real-world POLE (Person, Object, Location, Event) dataset, comparing reasoning and information retrieval with and without the symbolic layer. The results indicate that the our approach leads to responses that are more consistent with the context, improving the generated outputs.
summary_zh: 现有GraphRAG将知识图谱视为同构图且仅依赖文本相似性，未利用其确定性知识。
提出代理GraphRAG系统，引入符号层整合确定性推理，基于KG类别分别计算类型中心性。
构建符号表征作为LLM的确定性输入，实验表明该方法提升了输出与上下文的一致性。
comment: Preprint. 7 pages. Final version published in 2026 IEEE Symposium on Computers and Communications (ISCC), DOI: 10.1109/ISCC70364.2026.11739974
journal_ref: 2026 IEEE Symposium on Computers and Communications (ISCC), pp. 1-7, 2026

title: SmartBloch-Agent: An Agentic Framework for Automated MRI Sequence Design and Optimization
title_zh: SmartBloch-Agent：自动MRI序列设计与优化的智能体框架
abstract: Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) pulse sequences organize radiofrequency excitation, gradient encoding, and signal acquisition, determining magnetization evolution and image formation. Sequence research requires translating imaging objectives into executable protocols meeting physical and acquisition constraints, refined via physical simulation, signal reconstruction, and scientific evaluation. Sequence construction, physical verification, parameter search, and assessment involve many tools and manual decisions, limiting automation from objective to verifiable sequence. We develop SmartBloch-Agent, an integrated framework for automated MRI sequence design and optimization. Given objectives and scientific constraints in natural language, an AI agent interprets goals, plans tasks, orchestrates tools, and makes feedback-informed decisions, drawing on a construction module and optimizers for structural design and parameter search. Our GPU-accelerated SmartBloch engine supplies physical computation for both stages, so the framework configures, per sequence and objective, event validation, Full-Bloch magnetization evolution, signal acquisition, image reconstruction, and scientific evaluation, and closes the loop without external MRI simulators. Results return to the agent to guide sequence revision, parameter optimization, and candidate selection, and the design files carry simulation, reconstruction, and evaluation evidence, forming an output package for a real-scanner workflow. Experiments show the framework automatically designs and optimizes MRI sequences for varied objectives and constraints, refines candidates with physical feedback, and improves several parameter-estimation metrics and downstream quantitative reconstruction. SmartBloch-Agent unifies objectives, design, physical execution, and evaluation into a continuous workflow for end-to-end automation of MRI sequence research.
summary_zh: MRI序列设计依赖大量人工决策与外部工具，难以实现从成像目标到可验证序列的自动化。
提出SmartBloch-Agent框架，利用AI agent解析自然语言目标，结合构建模块与优化器，并依托GPU加速的SmartBloch引擎闭环完成物理验证与参数搜索。
实验表明该框架能自动设计并优化多目标MRI序列，利用物理反馈改进候选序列，提升参数估计与下游定量重建指标。

title: DataHelix: A CPU-GPU Co-Scheduling Data Plane for Multimodal Model Training
title_zh: DataHelix：面向多模态模型训练的CPU-GPU协同调度数据平面
abstract: Multimodal model training breaks the loose coupling between data loading and model execution assumed by conventional training pipelines. Large per-sample variation in decoding cost, token/latent count, and tensor size causes both CPU preprocessing time and GPU compute time to vary substantially across data-parallel ranks (training processes). In synchronous training, these two sources of heterogeneity interact tightly: GPU execution determines how long the input pipeline has to prepare the next batch, while delayed preprocessing in any rank in turn stalls all GPUs at synchronization. As a result, optimizing CPU throughput or GPU load balance in isolation cannot eliminate pipeline bubbles. We present DataHelix, a metadata-first CPU-GPU co-scheduling data plane for multimodal training. DataHelix jointly reasons about preprocessing demand and GPU execution progress, treating each GPU compute window as the readiness budget for the next batch and coordinating preprocessing across ranks to minimize deadline misses rather than CPU makespan. To avoid expensive data movement, placement is decided while samples remain lightweight descriptors, before decoding and collation amplify them into large tensors. Descriptor-level token-latent-aware batching performs coarse pre-balancing, while cost-gated collective rebalancing corrects residual skew only when its expected benefit exceeds transfer cost. Across 11 video and multimodal workloads on 8 Ascend 910B accelerators, DataHelix reduces mean deadline-miss rate by 67.8% and mean p95 input-wait latency by 87.0%, while achieving 2.72x geometric-mean throughput over rank-local DataLoaders and 1.82x over a Ray actor pool under the same CPU budget.
summary_zh: 多模态训练中样本解码与张量尺寸差异大，导致CPU预处理与GPU计算时间在各进程间严重不均，孤立优化无法消除流水线气泡。
提出DataHelix数据平面，将GPU计算窗口作为下批次准备预算，跨进程协同预处理以最小化截止期未命中，而非仅优化CPU耗时。
在解码前基于轻量描述符决定数据放置并执行粗粒度预均衡，仅当收益大于传输开销时才触发代价门控的集合重均衡。
在8个Ascend 910B加速器上测试，DataHelix将截止期未命中率降低67.8%，吞吐量相比局部加载器提升2.72倍。

title: Artificial Shoppers and Attention Competition
abstract: We study how AI shopping interfaces affect price competition, platform profit, and consumer welfare. A platform hosts two of three products of different quality. Without AI, consumers compare the hosted pair under salience distortion and overweight whichever attribute, price or quality, stands out. Under assistance, an AI assistant recommends the two products with the highest true utility, leaving consumers to make the same distorted comparison. Under delegation, an AI agent selects the best product, subject to purchase approval. Both modes access all products and know consumers' preferences; firms price strategically. First, assistance can soften competition despite expanded product access. The middle-quality firm may forgo low-valuation consumers because attracting them requires cutting the price paid by higher-valuation consumers as well. Relative to no AI with the same assortment, assistance lowers both hosted prices under the high- and low-quality pair but can raise both under the high- and middle-quality pair. Second, we identify an alignment paradox: some consumers can become worse off than without AI even though their best option remains recommended and becomes cheaper. Salience can induce a switch to a lower-quality product whose quality loss exceeds the saving relative to the original purchase. The assistant ranks products accurately but does not optimize the shortlist for consumers' realized welfare. Third, assistance can raise both platform profit and aggregate consumer surplus with the high- and middle-quality pair; delegation can do so with the high- and low-quality pair. Fourth, among AI designs, the platform weakly prefers delegation with the high- and middle-quality pair wherever all compared pricing equilibria exist. Yet this preferred design can yield lower platform profit and aggregate consumer surplus than the no-AI optimum.

title: Travel Cost Calibration for Multi-Agent Target Assignment and Pathfinding
abstract: Target assignment and pathfinding (TAPF) is an appealing extension of classical multi-agent pathfinding (MAPF): each agent has a set of targets, and the planner must both assign a target to each agent and plan collision-free paths for them. A trivial approach is to compute an assignment that minimizes the total single-agent shortest-path distance over agent--target pairs, and then solve the resulting MAPF instance. However, this approach falls short because the shortest-path distance remains a proxy that ignores interference among agents. Assigning targets based on the costs agents actually pay, which depend on how every other agent is assigned and routed, would yield a better final outcome. To this end, we propose an iterative TAPF method that improves target assignments by calibrating travel cost estimates from fast, suboptimal MAPF feedback. Experiments show that our method produces solutions close to optimal on small instances and outperforms existing planners in solution quality on larger ones.

title: Tracybot: Preserving Developer Intent by Tracing Agent-Generated Code to Prompts
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are now widely used in software development, and LLM-based coding agents are given increasing autonomy. With coding agents, many design decisions are made in the conversation between the developer and the agent. Typically, the developer starts a conversation with an agent and states their intent, the agent proposes options if needed, and the developer plans the change accordingly. Then, the resulting code is committed. However, in such scenarios, the decisions and the intent behind the changes remain in the conversation, with no link to the code they produced. In this paper, we present Tracybot, an open-source tool that integrates with VS Code, Git, and coding agents to keep track of relevant conversations in an LLM-assisted development process. Tracybot captures each change as a Tasklet which consists of optional planning prompts used to plan a change, together with a build prompt that produces it. Tracybot has two main features: (i) it maps line-level code changes made by coding agents to the Tasklets that produced them, and (ii) it allows the developer to export a Tasklet as a decision record when needed, for example when the decision concerns the architecture of the project. We developed the tool over two iterations of a design science study, while focusing the evaluation on the usability and user-friendliness of the tool. In a focus group (7 participants) and a survey (24 participants), we found that Tracybot was perceived as useful for activities like code review, and most participants found our Tasklet design and presentation to be a clear way to represent the developer's intent. Tool: https://github.com/TracyTeam/tracybot. Video: https://youtu.be/Vg_a1F5eO04.

title: Exploring Weight-Space Programming: Capabilities, Generalization, and Limitations
abstract: Weight-Space Programming (WSP) enables reasoning agents to directly inspect and modify neural network parameters, offering an alternative to gradient-based model adaptation. However, its capabilities, cross-task generalization, and practical limitations remain insufficiently understood. We systematically investigate WSP through 16 editing trajectories across seven benchmarks and two model scales (Qwen3.5-0.8B and Qwen3.5-9B). Our findings reveal three key insights. First, WSP can achieve substantial performance gains through highly localized interventions. On full held-out evaluations, accuracy improves by up to 29.45, 4.42, 36.72, and 17.11 percentage points on MATH-500, GPQA Diamond, IFEval, and SciBench, respectively. Notably, modifying only 1,023 parameters yields a 29.45-point improvement. Second, WSP exhibits promising but uneven cross-task generalization. A Math-edited checkpoint improves GPQA Diamond, IFEval, and SciBench by 3.03, 12.18, and 20.10 points, respectively, without further editing, while leaving SciCode performance unchanged. Third, effective editing remains challenging and inconsistent. Outcomes vary substantially across trajectories, and six of the 16 trajectories retain the original weights when candidate improvements cannot be reliably validated. Together, these results highlight WSP's potential for highly localized model adaptation while revealing important challenges in intervention discovery, reliability, and cross-task transfer. Homepage: https://wsp-scope.github.io/ GitHub: https://github.com/WSP-Scope/WSP-Scope-Project

title: Enabling Privacy-Preserving Natural Language Access to Industrial Smart Meter Data
abstract: Energy management officers and grid operators increasingly rely on smart meter data for anomaly detection, performance monitoring, and strategic decision-making. However, extracting actionable insights from large-scale, heterogeneous telemetry databases requires advanced SQL and data engineering expertise, creating a critical bottleneck for non-technical personnel. Furthermore, the strict data privacy regulations and security constraints inherent to critical energy infrastructure often prohibit the routing of sensitive consumer data through cloud-based Large Language Models (LLMs). To address these challenges, we present OpenMeter, a schema-agnostic Multi-Agent System (MAS) designed to translate natural language queries into executable code and human-readable insights. This architecture lowers the technical barrier for day-to-day utility operations by empowering non-expert personnel to interact with complex databases through intuitive natural language dialogue, transforming raw telemetry into a highly valuable tool for routine grid workflows and strategic decisions. Multi-scenario ablation studies over this environment demonstrate that full multi-agent orchestration shows its largest observed accuracy gains on resource-constrained local hardware (+6.1 pp EX-R over the strongest single-agent configuration); at frontier scale, individual components retain value but should be enabled selectively, indicating that the cost of full orchestration is justified specifically where privacy demands local execution.

title: SafeOrchestrate: Runtime Checked Intent-Driven Orchestration for Cyber-Physical Systems
abstract: Modern cyber physical systems (CPS) integrate heterogeneous sensors, actuators, controllers, and services, composed at runtime rather than at design time.
