abstract: Optical Network Digital Twins (ONDTs) are emerging as a key framework for representing, synchronizing, and utilizing the physical state of optical networks for quality-of-transmission (QoT) estimation, optimization, and intelligent operation. This survey provides a comprehensive view of ONDTs, spanning digital coherent transmission and physical-layer observability to intelligent network operations. We systematically organize ONDT technologies from ecosystem, functional, control, and implementation architecture perspectives and review the enabling technologies required to construct, synchronize, and utilize digital representations of physical optical networks. As a unifying framework to describe both ONDT design and validation, we introduce a categorization based on the following figures of merit: Fidelity, Dynamicity, and Deployability (FDD). In particular, we emphasize fit-for-purpose Fidelity, where modeling effort focuses on the physical effects of components rather than solely maximizing model accuracy, favoring scalability and generalizability. Furthermore, experimental and field validations are examined to evaluate the practical applicability of ONDT technologies. We further examine experimental and field validations, from physics-based QoT estimation and measurement-informed model refinement to field synchronization, service provisioning, multi-domain observability, and infrastructure characterization. Finally, we discuss the complementary roles of ONDTs and AI agents toward autonomous optical networks and identify key research directions for practical deployment.
summary_zh: 光网络数字孪生缺乏统一框架，本文从生态、功能、控制与实现架构系统梳理其构建、同步与使能技术。
针对模型评估缺乏统一标准，提出基于保真度、动态性与可部署性（FDD）的分类框架，强调面向目标的保真度。
为验证实用性，综述从物理QoT估计到实地同步的实验验证，并探讨ONDT与AI agent协同实现自治光网络的方向。

title: RoboARCade: Benchmarking Agentic Robot Control
title_zh: RoboARCade：智能体机器人控制基准测试
abstract: Improvements in multi-modal capabilities have enabled agents to act directly as robot policies, a setting we refer to as agentic robot control (ARC). We introduce RoboARCade, a benchmark of long-horizon manipulation tasks across three embodiments designed to test in-context adaptation, memory, and reasoning for precise control. The tasks build on existing open-source benchmarks, which we make harder by widening the range of initial conditions. RoboARCade is easy to use and extend: all tasks run on a single simulation backend, MuJoCo, each task is a self-contained data pack, and agents connect through interchangeable interfaces, so new tasks, agents, and interfaces can be added independently. The benchmark separates leading agents: GPT-6 Astra achieves 49.8% compared with 43.6% for Claude Fable 5.1, leaving substantial room for improvement. Comparing two interfaces, we find that a richer visual interface adds only 1.5 to 6.8 points at 1.7 to 2.3 times the cost. Failures stem mostly from choosing a poor manipulation strategy or executing a good one imprecisely, rarely from misunderstanding the scene, and agents incorrectly claim success on 24% to 39% of attempted subtasks. Agents can also improve without human input: one successful demonstration in context raises Astra's score from 53.5% to 73.0% on a five-task subset, and a prompt the agent writes and revises itself reaches 72.0%. Code, videos and full traces are available at roboarcade.org.
summary_zh: 多模态能力提升使智能体可直接作为机器人策略，但缺乏针对长程操作中适应、记忆与推理的测试基准。
提出RoboARCade基准，基于MuJoCo构建长程操作任务，通过放宽初始条件增加难度，支持任务与智能体独立扩展。
测试显示领先智能体表现差异大且存在大量误报成功；丰富视觉接口收益低且成本高；上下文示范或自写提示可显著提升分数。

title: SMART: State-based Multi Agent Reasoning Traces for Verification-oriented Problem-Solving
title_zh: 面向验证性求解的基于状态多智能体推理轨迹框架
abstract: Complex problems with limited context, such as claims, require a means to obtain additional knowledge necessary for solution reasoning. We propose a multi-agent framework, SMART, to obtain knowledge through capturing the implicit state of participating entities in a problem context. SMART curates the state knowledge as diverse, complementary and solution-salient premises using a variety of LLMs and a structured role-based prompt strategy. Using knowledge from these real-world verified curated premises, SMART's knowledge guided solution reasoning improves validation performance up to 20% on complex scientific claims spanning 3 datasets. We show that grounding premises in real-world knowledge is necessary and improves performance up to 5%.
summary_zh: 针对有限上下文复杂问题缺乏求解知识的问题，提出多智能体框架SMART，通过捕获实体隐式状态获取知识。
SMART利用多种LLM与结构化角色提示策略，将状态知识整理为多样、互补且突出解的前提。
实验表明，基于现实知识的前提构建可提升5%性能，SMART的知识引导推理在3个数据集上提升验证性能达20%。

title: Knowing When to Teach: Learning from Teachable Prefixes in Multilingual Reasoning Distillation
title_zh: 多语言推理蒸馏中基于可教前缀的自蒸馏方法
abstract: On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) improves reasoning by training a student on its own reasoning, using the same model conditioned on reference solutions as a teacher. Applying OPSD to multilingual reasoning requires the teacher to provide useful feedback across languages, even when the student makes mistakes in intermediate steps. We observe a phenomenon we call Teacher Drift: as these mistakes accumulate, the teacher may follow the student's incorrect steps instead of correcting them. Our analysis shows that this shift tends to occur earlier in lower-resource languages. To account for these differences across languages, we propose Teachable On-Policy Self-Distillation (TOPSD), which determines where and whether teacher supervision should be applied to each reasoning trajectory. TOPSD uses teacher-student likelihood to estimate where drift begins and select a prefix for supervision. It then verifies whether the teacher can recover the correct answer from that prefix, applying distillation only to prefixes that pass verification. Experiments on multilingual mathematical reasoning across ten languages and three model scales show that TOPSD consistently outperforms conventional OPSD, particularly in low- and medium-resource languages.
summary_zh: 多语言推理自蒸馏中，学生中间步错误累积会导致教师偏离纠正，且低资源语言更早出现此现象。
提出TOPSD方法，利用师生似然估计偏离起点选取前缀，并验证教师能否从该前缀恢复正确答案。
仅对通过验证的可教前缀进行蒸馏。实验表明TOPSD全面优于传统方法，尤其中低资源语言提升显著。

title: BabyTheorist: A Benchmark for Learning to Theorize the World from Observation Alone
title_zh: BabyTheorist：从纯观察中学习世界理论的基准
abstract: How would we know whether a machine truly understands the world? We argue that one key capability is observational theory learning: acquiring reusable theories from pure observations and applying them to new situations. Current visual reasoning benchmarks focus primarily on the latter, presenting each task as a few-shot puzzle grouped by a common rule. We introduce BabyTheorist, a benchmark for controlled training and evaluation of observational theory learning. BabyTheorist generates continual streams of before-after visual observations from hidden compositional programs; during training, learners see only the resulting transitions, with no program labels, task identities, or support sets. To support theory learning and evaluation, BabyTheorist controls the program language, a curriculum over program complexity, recurring frequent subprograms, and a continual train-test protocol with level skipping. Seven representative baselines plateau well below ceiling, with the gap widening as the curriculum advances---evidence that BabyTheorist isolates a capability current program-learning approaches do not yet address.
summary_zh: 现有视觉推理基准侧重规则应用，缺乏评估从纯观察中获取可复用理论的能力。
提出BabyTheorist基准，通过隐藏组合程序生成连续视觉观察流，训练时无标签或任务ID。
七个基线模型性能远未达上限且差距递增，证明当前方法尚未解决该理论学习问题。

title: PCBRouteAgent: How Close Are LLM Agents to Becoming PCB Routing Engineers?
title_zh: PCBRouteAgent：LLM Agent距成为PCB布线工程师有多近？
abstract: Automating printed circuit board (PCB) routing requires coordinating board-level connectivity decisions with geometric execution under strict design rules. Although recent agents can interact with native routing tools, reliable routing on complex boards remains challenging. We present PCBRouteAgent, a multimodal PCB routing agent inspired by how human engineers coordinate global strategy with local execution. A Global Routing Planner combines board images and structured electrical and geometric information to specify connection topology, routing order, corridors, and layer transitions. A Detailed Routing Executor realizes these guides through KiCad's native routing engine and performs bounded local recovery. Unresolved failures are returned as structured feedback, enabling targeted guide revisions while preserving accepted routes. We evaluate PCBRouteAgent on 247 synthetic and real-world boards from four PCBWorld-Bench test splits. It achieves clean-pass rates of 100%, 94.9%, 100%, and 40% on D2, D3-A, D3-B, and D3-C, respectively. On the three real-world subsets, PCBRouteAgent outperforms the best evaluated baseline in clean-pass rate by 13.9, 36, and 10 percentage points, respectively.
summary_zh: 复杂PCB板的自动化布线需协调全局连接与局部几何执行，现有Agent难以可靠完成。
提出PCBRouteAgent，由全局规划器制定连接拓扑与布线顺序，局部执行器通过KiCad引擎实现布线。
在247个测试板上，该方法在三个真实子集的clean-pass率分别超越最优基线13.9、36和10个百分点。

title: The Promise of Strategic Agentic Scambaiting
title_zh: 策略性智能体反诈诱骗的潜力与前景
abstract: Scammers have increasingly adopted AI-driven capabilities, evolving from automated message generation to fully agentic conversational systems that scale operations and maximize the exploitation of fraudulent resources before detection and takedown. In parallel, agentic scambaiting has emerged as a defensive approach in which autonomous agents impersonate potential victims and engage scammers in sustained interactions to extract actionable threat intelligence, such as mule bank accounts and cryptocurrency wallet addresses, that can be reported to disrupt fraudulent infrastructures. Together, these developments transform online fraud into an adversarial socio-technical ecosystem in which autonomous scamming and scambaiting agents engage in deceptive interactions while competing over the discovery, preservation, and exploitation of one another's resources. A fundamental and largely unexplored question is how defensive scambaiting can remain effective in an agent-to-agent environment, and under what conditions either side gains a strategic advantage. In this paper, we present a formal model of agent-to-agent fraud interactions that captures the strategic decision spaces available to both attackers and defenders. Using this framework, we analyze the dynamics of engagement, resource consumption, belief adaptation, and disruption outcomes. We find that scammer profitability turns negative once baiting-agent prevalence exceeds certain thresholds, and that when both sides improve at the same pace, defender investment in mimicry quality outpaces equivalent gains in scammer detection capability, so the arms race favors the defender under our baseline parameters. Our model and findings provide insights into the stability, scalability, and long-term effectiveness of autonomous defensive agents in an evolving AI-mediated fraud landscape.
summary_zh: AI驱动的全自动诈骗与反诈诱骗智能体兴起，使在线欺诈演变为双方争夺资源的对抗性社会技术生态系统。
针对智能体间反诈有效性未明的问题，提出形式化模型，刻画攻防双方的战略决策空间及交互动态。
分析表明，当诱骗智能体占比超阈值时诈骗者将亏损；在同等进化速度下，防御方投资模仿质量的优势大于攻击方检测能力提升，军备竞赛利于防御方。

title: Detecting Silent Faults at the Environment-Trainer Boundary in Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: 强化学习环境与训练器边界的静默故障检测
abstract: Robot reinforcement learning increasingly runs environments outside the trainer: in another process, on another machine, in another language. Many faults at this boundary raise no error. We make the boundary a wire protocol and ask what notices a fault in it. On Pendulum, HalfCheetah, Hopper and a 7-joint arm (Pusher), we injected up to 23 faults into what crosses the wire and 2 into the trainer's log, from one value to every value. Unless every value was wrong, a learning-curve threshold caught at most one run in ten, and a comparison with ten fault-free seeds at most 21%. A clean evaluation of all 1,060 final policies agreed with the curves: of the 728 boundary-fault runs both curve checks passed, 723 scored no more than three standard deviations below fault-free seeds, though nearly all ended on other weights and, for reward faults, logged other returns. Checks of the run itself, not of its outcome, saw every fault. A step ledger kept on both sides and compared step by step caught and located every fault that crossed, on Pendulum, Hopper and Pusher on one machine and on Pendulum across two, with no fault-free run and, on Pendulum, a median 3% more training time. An episode record kept at the environment caught the faults in the trainer's log. We list such faults found in practice, in Gymnasium 1.3 and our own code and, reported by others, in five multi-agent libraries, and recommend a step ledger and episode counts kept at the environment.
summary_zh: 强化学习中环境与训练器边界易发不报错的静默故障，传统基于学习曲线的检测极易漏检。
提出在边界两侧维护并逐步比对“步骤账本”及环境端“回合记录”的方法，直接检查运行过程。
该方法能精准定位所有注入的边界故障及训练器日志故障，代价极小，优于仅检查最终结果的方法。
comment: 7 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables. Accepted to the CoRL 2026 Workshop on Everything Beneath the Policy. Code, specification, and every experiment's protocol, logs and findings: https://github.com/PlugRL

title: Structured Agentic Learning for Persistent Spatial Acquisition in RDT-TAIS-Assisted Communications
title_zh: RDT-TAIS辅助通信中持久空间获取的结构化智能体学习
abstract: Persistent TAIS operation can reduce repeated radio-information acquisition by reusing environmental knowledge across control intervals. This knowledge changes with radio-environment evolution and current communication task. This paper studies persistent spatial knowledge maintenance for TAIS control and formulates it as a sequential information-acquisition problem that maximizes effective communication performance while accounting for physical-acquisition overhead under an outage-reliability constraint. We develop structured agentic spatial intelligence (ASI), which realizes a communication-oriented agent that maintains persistent spatial knowledge, forms beliefs from radio and context observations, and adapts physical information acquisition through closed-loop interaction with the radio environment. By jointly exploiting radio-consistent context inference, temporal knowledge-sufficiency assessment, graph-structured regional reasoning, and predictive outage-risk feedback, structured ASI determines when additional acquisition is needed, where it is directed, and how much physical information is sufficient before stopping or escalating to full radio-environment reacquisition. Numerical results show that structured ASI improves the effective rate by 2.59% while reducing acquisition overhead by 25.0% at six structural changes per 100 control intervals, and achieves a 2.82% effective-rate gain with a 41.8% overhead reduction over a heterogeneous 400-interval mission.
summary_zh: TAIS持久运行需跨控制间隔复用环境知识，但知识随环境与任务演变，需解决空间知识维护问题。
提出结构化空间智能（ASI），构建通信导向智能体，通过闭环交互自适应调整物理信息获取。
ASI联合推理与评估决定获取时机、方向与充分性，在保证可靠性的同时提升有效速率并降低开销。
实验表明，ASI在结构变化下提升有效速率2.59%并降低获取开销25%，异构任务中开销降幅达41.8%。
comment: 7 pages, 4 figures. Submitted to IEEE Conference for possible publication

title: An Agent-Driven, Cross-Validated Inverse-Design Pipeline for Dielectric Metasurfaces
title_zh: 基于智能体与交叉验证的介电超构表面逆向设计流程
abstract: Inverse design of dielectric metasurfaces is powerful but labour-intensive: each new target requires choosing a parameterization and a figure of merit, managing compute resources, and critically assessing results that may be numerically unconverged, sensitive to fabrication errors or trapped in local optima. Here we present an open-source pipeline in which an artificial intelligence (AI) coding agent turns a plain-language specification into metasurface optimization runs, executes them, analyses every run with a fixed checklist and proposes the next iteration. Designs are optimized with differentiable three-dimensional rigorous coupled-wave analysis (RCWA), including robustness to fabrication tolerances, and every reported design is independently verified with finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) simulations. We demonstrate the workflow at 1550 nm on a freeform silicon metagrating, on a polarization-independent meta-atom library assembled into beam-deflecting supercells, and on metalenses built from the same library. In the metagrating case, the independent FDTD verification revealed a 5\% overestimate of the efficiency by the optimization model that a conventional convergence test had not detected, and the robust design retained most of its efficiency under $\pm$10~nm fabrication errors. In the other cases, instead, the obtained RCWA results are confirmed by full-wave simulations.
summary_zh: 超构表面逆向设计耗时费力，需人工调参且结果易受局部最优和制造误差影响。
提出开源流程：AI编码智能体将自然语言转为优化任务并迭代，结合可微3D RCWA优化与FDTD独立验证。
该流程在1550nm下验证有效；FDTD发现传统收敛测试未检出的5%效率高估，且鲁棒设计在±10nm制造误差下保持高效。
comment: The code, are openly available on GitHub at \url{https://github.com/GiuseppeELio/metasurface-agent-pipeline} (MIT License) and archived on Zenodo at 10.5281/zenodo.23982523

title: ProtoGestalt: Interpretable Prototypes for Facial Phenotyping and Diagnosis of Rare Genetic Disorders
title_zh: ProtoGestalt：面向罕见遗传病诊断的可解释面部表型原型框架
abstract: Rare genetic disorders are difficult to diagnose due to their diversity and overlapping clinical features. Facial morphology can provide diagnostic clues, yet most diagnostic models offer limited interpretability and are not designed to support broad screening for undiagnosed disease. We present ProtoGestalt, an interpretable prototype-based framework for facial phenotyping, rare-disease screening, and syndrome identification. The method extends prototype learning by constraining learned visual features to select facial regions, allowing predictions to be explained through localized and additive evidence. We assess ProtoGestalt's ability to distinguish syndromic from unaffected faces on multiple control datasets and class prevalence values. We further evaluate it's diagnostic performance on syndromes observed during training. The learned prototype-based representations provide significant separation between syndromic and case-matched control images and retain useful performance as the proportion of controls increases. The framework also demonstrates the ability to differentiate among syndromes. Although reasonably accurate specialized models for facial classification of rare disorders already exist, ProtoGestalt offers an interpretable alternative that links predictions to anatomically meaningful facial regions, potentially supporting clinical decision-making and the discovery of phenotype-gene associations.
summary_zh: 罕见遗传病表型重叠且难诊断，现有模型可解释性差且不支持广泛筛查。
提出ProtoGestalt框架，约束视觉特征至特定面部区域，通过局部加和证据解释预测。
该框架有效区分综合征与正常面部及不同综合征，为临床决策和表型-基因关联发现提供可解释支持。

title: Create Your Own Work Stack: Deploying Self-hosted AI and Tooling in a Tech Startup
title_zh: 科技初创公司中自托管AI与工具的混合部署实践
abstract: Self-hosting AI is often presented as a way to reduce inference costs and increase control, but deployment introduces its own costs. We report our experience deploying a hybrid AI stack at Grayhat Developers, a small software company with an AI-intensive development workflow. Our initial motivation was to counter the growing cost of commercial AI usage: Claude/Codex incurred approximately \$325 per month, with more than 25.93 billion recorded tokens. We experimented with local open-source models as replacements for commercial coding agents, but after learning that their performance and inference speed were insufficient, we adopted a hybrid approach in which commercial agents remained responsible for complex tasks while local models handled lower-complexity tasks, organizational information retrieval, and synchronization with self-hosted tools including Outline, Plane, and ERPNext. We estimated that approximately 30--40\% of our commercial AI workload was associated with context transfer, documentation synchronization, task management, and related operational coordination. By moving this work to local models, we estimate that approximately 90\% of this coordination workload could be handled without commercial inference, corresponding to an estimated 27--36\% reduction in overall commercial-AI workload or cost-equivalent usage. Our first internal deployment nevertheless failed to achieve adoption because it introduced UX friction. Replacing it with a centrally configured deployment substantially improved feedback and adoption. We conclude that local inference is most useful not as a wholesale replacement for commercial AI, but as part of a hybrid architecture that assigns tasks according to their capability requirements, cost, context demands, and operational sensitivity.
summary_zh: 商业AI推理成本高昂，初创公司尝试用本地开源模型替代，但性能与速度不足，故转向混合架构。
将低复杂度任务及工具同步交由本地模型处理，可减少约27-36%的商业AI工作量及等效成本。
初期部署因UX摩擦失败，改为集中配置后获采纳；证明本地推理应作为混合架构的补充而非完全替代。
comment: Accepted for poster presentation at the Thirty-Ninth Annual Conference on Innovative Applications of Artificial Intelligence (IAAI-27), February 18-20, 2027

title: Value or Attention: Investigating Layer-wise Relevance Propagation for Graph Attention Networks
title_zh: 图注意力网络中逐层相关性传播的数值与注意力路径研究
abstract: Graph Attention Networks (GATs) are increasingly used in domains where scientists need to read a model's reasoning, from medicine to materials science, yet the routing they learn remains opaque to most explainers. Layer-wise Relevance Propagation (LRP) follows the model's computation, but in an attention layer the relevance reaching a node is the sum of two mechanically different quantities: its content relevance through the value path and its routing relevance through the attention path. Existing rules either drop one or add them into a single number. We write a single product rule with free weights on the two factors that recovers current approaches as special cases. The value path measures what content a node supplied against a zero baseline; the attention path measures how the node shaped what was passed relative to its neighborhood, and its sign records whether the node's features moved the gating the way the prediction demanded. On a ground-truth classification task, we show that the same node receives negative, positive and near-zero relevance under three settings of the rule. The separated relevance maps yield a hypothesis about the model: it gains by not reading that node. We give reading rules for both paths and argue that they should be interpreted separately.
summary_zh: 图注意力网络的可解释性不足，现有LRP规则将节点的数值相关性与注意力相关性混合或丢弃，无法清晰揭示模型路由机制。
提出一种带自由权重的乘积规则，将相关性分解为衡量节点内容贡献的数值路径和衡量节点路由影响的注意力路径，统一现有方法。
实验证明同一节点在不同规则下相关性正负不一，分离两条路径能揭示模型通过不读取某节点获益的假设，二者应独立解读。
comment: Accepted at the XAI4Science Workshop @ NeurIPS 2026 (non-archival). 17 pages, 9 figures

title: DictLLM: Post-training Compression of Large Language Model with Dictionary Kernels
title_zh: 基于字典核的大语言模型后训练压缩
abstract: Efficient deployment of large language models (LLMs) on mobile devices requires balancing performance with compute and memory constraints. Post-training compression is an effective approach to managing this trade-off, while requiring much less computation than in-training counterparts. We propose DictLLM, a dictionary-based compression scheme in which weight matrices within grouped layers are decomposed into a shared dictionary and layer-specific sparse coefficients, directly obtained from a pre-trained model without further training. Specifically, we cast DictLLM as a four-step post-training optimization. First, we obtain shared dictionaries via singular value decomposition (SVD) of input-scaled weight matrices, amortizing rank across grouped layers; second, we sparsify the layer-specific coefficients to the target compression ratio using a dictionary-aware Hessian; and third, we refine the dictionaries given the resulting sparse coefficients. Finally, we aggressively quantize both components using factor-specific Hessian information: input covariance for the dictionaries and the dictionary-aware Hessian for the coefficients. The resulting representation reduces memory footprint by storing a single shared dictionary per layer group, along with sparse layer-specific coefficients. On language modeling and zero-shot reasoning benchmarks, DictLLM consistently outperforms existing post-training low-rank compression methods and pushes the Pareto frontier between model size and performance. DictLLM compresses the original LLaMA-7B model by 5.1x with only a 2.9-point increase in WikiText-2 perplexity, achieving a 3.6x higher compression ratio than the state-of-the-art low-rank method.
summary_zh: LLM移动端部署受限于算力与内存，需后训练压缩以低成本平衡性能与资源。
提出DictLLM，将分组层权重分解为共享字典与稀疏系数，经SVD、稀疏化、精炼和量化四步优化，无需重训。
实验表明DictLLM优于现有低秩压缩法，压缩LLaMA-7B达5.1倍且困惑度仅增2.9，推进了性能与体积的Pareto前沿。

title: Spatiotemporal Dynamics-Aware Industrial Anomaly Detection and Reasoning
title_zh: 感知时空动态的工业异常检测与推理
abstract: Industrial Anomaly Detection (IAD) is a long-established problem that aims to detect defects in industrial products during manufacturing for quality control. Most existing studies focus on static visual patterns as the basis for detection. However, in real manufacturing environments, many anomalies are dynamics-based, such as irregular movements that cannot be perceived from static cues alone. We observe that even recent Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM)-based approaches fall short in identifying such dynamic anomalies due to limited temporal modeling capability. To address this, we introduce MUSTARD: MUltimodal SpatioTemporal Anomaly Reasoning and Detection, a framework that equips MLLMs with fine-grained spatiotemporal dynamics awareness for detecting and reasoning about dynamics-based defects. MUSTARD introduces optical-flow-guided keyframe selection and augmented modalities to capture critical motion irregularities through local motion patterns and global dynamic evolution. Its normal pattern-based reasoning pipeline requires only a few normal reference samples as the detection basis, avoiding any model updates. This enables efficient adaptation across various products and provides high decision interpretability. MUSTARD is the first MLLM-based framework for dynamics-based IAD. Experiments demonstrate its superior performance in detecting spatiotemporal anomalies and providing plausible explanations. Our code is available at https://github.com/racercode/Mustard
summary_zh: 现有工业异常检测多关注静态视觉特征，基于MLLM的方法也缺乏时序建模能力，难以识别动态异常。
提出MUSTARD框架，通过光流引导的关键帧选择与增强模态，赋予MLLM细粒度时空动态感知能力。
该框架仅需少量正常样本即可推理，无需模型更新，在检测时空异常和提供合理解释上性能优越。
comment: Accepted at IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV) 2027

title: Can an LLM Actually Reason and Program about Neural Network's Weights or is it just memorization on steroids? Exploring "Weight-Space Programming"
title_zh: LLM对神经网络权重的推理与编程：推理还是记忆？
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have recently been reported to read and write the raw weights of neural networks directly, a capability termed weight-space programming. We ask whether the reading side of this capability reflects reasoning about weight flows or a combination of local arithmetic at the network's edges and memorized priors over public datasets. We test Claude Opus 5.5 on small convolutional networks of about 125,000 parameters trained on five image datasets, providing every weight as plain text with no tools, no forward passes, and no dataset or class names. The model performs accurate local calculations: batch-normalization statistics lead it to infer about three optimizer steps on networks stopped after three updates, and output-layer sign patterns recover the vehicle/animal split of CIFAR-10. The sessions report reading the first and last layers closely and sampling the middle, and several claims built on partial tracing fail verification, although we did not run a direct forward-pass test. Semantic judgments lean on familiar datasets: the model names CIFAR-10 for CIFAR-10 networks but also for all three fast-food networks, relabels KMNIST as MNIST, reads a 99.57%-accurate SAT-6 network as CIFAR-10 animal photos, and calls "frog" the output favored by a feature that fires most on trees. Permuting CIFAR-10's labels preserves the output split at the new indices, but every class pair the model interprets is then wrong, indicating reliance on remembered label order. These are exploratory results from mostly single runs. We conclude that zero-shot weight reading by this model is better described as local arithmetic plus dataset priors than as weight-flow tracing, and we provide a protocol for auditing future weight-space claims.
summary_zh: 问题：LLM直接读取神经网络权重的能力是基于权重流推理，还是局部算术与记忆先验的结合？
方法：将约12.5万参数的小卷积网络权重以纯文本输入Claude Opus 5.5，无工具和前向传播进行测试。
结论：该模型的零样本权重读取实为局部算术加数据集先验，而非权重流追踪，并提供了审计协议。

title: NutriVisRAG: Multimodal Exemplar Grounding for Nutrient Estimation with Vision-Language Models
title_zh: NutriVisRAG：基于视觉语言模型的多模态示例营养估计
abstract: Diet is a major determinant of health, yet accurate dietary assessment from free-living meal images remains challenging. Existing retrieval-based Vision-Language Model (VLM) approaches to nutrient estimation typically rely on textual food representations, while, to our knowledge, direct grounding on visually similar annotated meals has not been investigated. We present NutriVisRAG, a retrieval-augmented generation framework that uses a vision encoder to retrieve similar meals with known nutritional annotations and provide them as multimodal in-context exemplars for VLM nutrient estimation at inference time, without task-specific fine-tuning. We evaluate NutriVisRAG across four datasets, four VLMs, three retrieval encoders, and two prompting strategies, including free-living meals from adults with insulin-treated diabetes, where carbohydrate estimates are compared against two dietitians' annotations. Across all 96 configurations (4 datasets x 4 VLMs x 3 retrieval encoders x 2 prompting strategies), NutriVisRAG reduced the primary estimation error in 56, with improvements more frequent under whole-meal (35/48) than per-item prompting (21/48). Across the evaluated configurations, the lowest NutriVisRAG error was below the best Vanilla error in 13 of 16 VLM--dataset pairs. For GPT-5.4-mini, under whole-meal prompting, the best-performing retrieval encoder for each dataset reduced the primary error on all four datasets relative to Vanilla, with reductions of 1.7--35.7%. Overall, our results show that grounding in multimodal exemplars comprising images and respective annotations can improve nutrient estimation at inference time without task-specific fine-tuning, although the benefits remain configuration-dependent.
summary_zh: 现有VLM营养估计多依赖文本检索，缺乏对视觉相似标注餐食的直接利用，导致自由就餐图像评估不准。
提出NutriVisRAG框架，用视觉编码器检索相似标注餐食，作为多模态上下文示例提供给VLM，无需微调。
在96种配置中，该方法超半数降低了主要估计误差，GPT-5.4-mini误差降低1.7-35.7%，证明多模态示例有效。

title: Recovering the Length of a Path from its Signature
title_zh: 从路径的签名恢复其长度
abstract: We prove the length conjecture of J. Chang, T. Lyons and H. Ni for paths of bounded variation for arbitrary real Banach spaces and any reasonable tensor (algebra) norms. More precisely, we establish the missing lower bound and in this way show that the length of a tree-reduced path is recovered from the asymptotic behaviour of its normalised signature. The main technical argument uses the norm duality and shuffle algebra to express natural powers of polygonal length approximations as combinations of linear functionals acting on restricted signatures, which are then glued by suitable integrations into a linear functional of controlled growth acting on the full signature. In particular, the full proof combines tools of classical analysis and functional analysis, such as localisation by continuous cutoff functions, Stone-Weierstrass approximation of continuous functions by signature polynomials, the Hahn-Banach theorem and a support detection lemma for compactly supported real signed Borel measures.
summary_zh: 针对有界变差路径的长度猜想，在任意实Banach空间下证明缺失的下界，从而证实该猜想。
利用范数对偶与shuffle代数，将折线长度逼近的自然幂表示为作用于受限签名的线性泛函组合，再通过积分粘合为作用于完整签名的受控增长线性泛函。
结合经典与泛函分析工具（如局部化、Stone-Weierstrass逼近、Hahn-Banach定理及支撑检测引理），证明树缩减路径的长度可由其归一化签名的渐近行为恢复。

title: SEER: A Scalable Event-Driven Runtime for Parallel Execution of Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Environments
title_zh: SEER：面向多智能体强化学习环境的可扩展事件驱动运行时
abstract: Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) is increasingly used in systems where many entities interact in a shared environment. In these workloads, policy inference can be batched on GPUs, but the CPU-side environment path still updates entity states, resolves local interactions, and builds observations inside each $\mathrm{env.step}$. This path can dominate latency in interaction-intensive workloads after policy batching. Existing vectorized environment interfaces and general event-driven runtimes do not directly address the fine-grained cross-entity work inside one bounded MARL step while preserving the step-level semantics expected by learning systems. We present SEER (Scalable Event-Driven Environment Runtime), a runtime for MARL environment execution under an explicit event-locality contract. SEER models each environment step as a bounded stream of timestamped events. If direct state updates are entity-local and cross-entity effects are represented as ordered future events, SEER can run independent events in parallel while preserving serial-equivalent boundary outputs. To make this contract practical, SEER uses a CAS-based dual-layer event queue: local event queues preserve per-entity causal order, while a parallel executive list exposes ready work to global worker threads. SEER further uses STPA, a preflight-guided thread-pool selection mechanism that combines short runtime traces with static workload and hardware features. We evaluate SEER on two parameterized MARL workloads: compute-intensive UAV swarm control (Aircraft) and communication-intensive wireless management (PCS). On Aircraft, SEER reduces inference latency by 16.2\% over the baseline. On PCS, SEER reduces environment-execution latency by 46.9\%, 19.5\%, and 64.9\% over ROSS-T, NBSE, and ROOT-Sim, respectively.
summary_zh: MARL中CPU端环境交互延迟成为瓶颈，现有接口无法兼顾单步内细粒度并行与串行语义。
提出SEER运行时，将环境步建模为带时间戳事件流，通过事件-局部性契约实现并行且保持边界输出串行等价。
采用CAS双层事件队列与STPA线程池选择机制，在UAV与无线管理任务上显著降低延迟。

title: How Far Can Lightweight LLMs Go in Intent-to-SLO Translation?
title_zh: 轻量级LLM在意图到SLO转换中的能力评估
abstract: Intent-based networking (IBN) promises QoS provisioning in which the network derives the configuration from operator-stated goals. Its first step, translating a natural-language intent into enforceable service-level objectives (SLOs) grounded in a live snapshot of the network state, increasingly relies on large language models (LLMs). These large models add cost and energy to the management loop and typically require multi-GPU, cloud-hosted infrastructure. Can lightweight open LLMs take over this step dependably? We answer this question with a five-dimensional evaluation of ten LLMs with <10B parameters from five families, under four prompting setups, on 716 placement intents. We evaluate translation performance, intent validation, hallucination, energy impact, and robustness to diverse phrasing. The best configurations translate intents with a strict F1 of 0.943 and reject up to 191 of 195 invalid intents. With few-shot reasoning, the strongest models hallucinate unsupported QoS requirements in only about one response in a hundred, whereas the zero-shot setup struggles. A translated intent costs 0.044-0.148 Wh of GPU energy without reasoning, and added energy cost for reasoning pays off for the weaker models. Furthermore, we show that realistic rephrasing lowers the rejection of invalid intents in 15 of 16 configurations for the best-performing models, leaving robust intent validation as a key open challenge for reliable IBN. Our code and data are available: https://github.com/ggck43/intent2slo.
summary_zh: 意图网络依赖大模型将自然语言意图转换为SLO，但大模型成本高且耗能，需探究轻量级LLM能否可靠替代。
对10个<10B参数的轻量级LLM进行五维度评估，发现最佳配置严格F1达0.943，且能拒绝绝大多数无效意图。
Few-shot推理可大幅降低幻觉，但意图重述会削弱对无效意图的拒绝能力，鲁棒意图验证仍是开放挑战。
comment: Under review at ICC 2027. Source code and data: https://github.com/ggck43/intent2slo. (6 pages. 7 figures, 3 tables)

title: QRAE: Query-Relevant Attention Entropy for Context Compression in DeepSearch Agents
title_zh: QRAE：面向DeepSearch代理的查询相关注意力熵上下文压缩
abstract: DeepSearch LLM agents repeatedly search and carry retrieved sources into subsequent reasoning steps. This expanding context increases token consumption and latency, although many results do not contribute to later reasoning. We propose Query-Relevant Attention Entropy (QRAE), an online context compression method that uses sparse evidence-assessment heads to decide which intact retrieved chunks should persist across reasoning steps. It scores bounded candidate batches through paired prefills: a query-free control suppresses shared attention responses, while normalized entropy measures the breadth of the positive response within each chunk. High-scoring chunks enter a persistent evidence whitelist and are included in the reasoning context. Uncertain chunks remain outside the reasoning context but are retained in a candidate cache, where they can be retrieved for later reevaluation. QRAE requires neither an additional generative compression pass nor modification of the attention operator. Across multiple DeepSearch benchmarks and reasoning models, QRAE improves task success by an average of 2.35 percentage points and reduces end-to-end latency and reported token usage by an average of 30% and 45%, respectively. These benefits generalize to a model with nearly 100B parameters.
summary_zh: DeepSearch代理的扩展上下文导致token消耗与延迟增加，需在线压缩无关检索结果。
提出QRAE在线压缩方法，利用稀疏评估头与双预填充计算归一化熵，筛选高相关chunk进入持久白名单。
无需额外生成或修改注意力算子，QRAE平均提升任务成功率2.35%，降低延迟30%与token用量45%。

title: Bri3D: Bridging the Object-Scene Gap in Single-Image 3D Generation via Scene-Anchor
title_zh: Bri3D: 基于场景锚点桥接单图3D生成中的物体-场景差距
abstract: Generating compositional 3D scenes from a single image requires recovering detailed object geometry and coherent spatial arrangements. Existing object-to-scene methods, including SAM3D and MIDI, extend object generation through image-context reasoning or inter-instance modeling. Coordinating objects remains challenging with limited scene-level supervision. Directly extending object-centric generators to entire scenes can degrade geometry and fail to preserve instance scale, orientation, and pose. We propose Bri3D, a framework bridging scene-level structural reasoning and object-level generative priors through instance-aware voxel scene anchors. Bri3D predicts a color-coded scene scaffold encoding coarse object geometry and spatial arrangements. Each instance is extracted as a scene anchor and refined into a pose-preserving, prior-compatible voxel support, enabling a frozen object generator to synthesize detailed textured geometry in the anchor-defined spatial reference. This coarse-to-fine design separates scene organization from object-scale detail synthesis, focusing scene-level training on spatial organization and anchor refinement while reusing pretrained object priors. Experiments demonstrate improvements in scene layout, object geometry, visual quality, and generalization. Bri3D predicts scene layouts efficiently; full scene generation is faster than SceneGen and SAM3D.
summary_zh: 单图生成组合3D场景时，现有方法缺乏场景级监督，直接扩展物体生成器会导致几何退化及实例位姿丢失。
提出Bri3D框架，通过实例感知体素场景锚点，桥接场景结构推理与物体生成先验，采用由粗到细的设计。
实验表明该方法提升了场景布局、物体几何与泛化能力，且场景生成速度优于SceneGen和SAM3D。

title: ChemE-as-Code: An Open-Source Platform for Agentic AI in Chemical Engineering
title_zh: ChemE-as-Code：面向化学工程的智能体AI开源平台
abstract: ChemE-as-Code provides an open-source environment in which AI agents built on large language models (LLMs) can carry out chemical engineering work and engineers can check it. Its calculation tools range from catalysis through process simulation to plant layout, HAZOP and life cycle assessment, and skills tell a general-purpose agent how to use them. Engineering files are linked, machine-readable and versioned in Git; calculations run outside the LLM, each value records its origin, and automated checks report inconsistencies and out-of-date results by file and line. In an illustrative ammonia case, agents developed a written task into a preliminary basic-engineering package (simulation files, P&IDs, layout, HAZOP, datasheets, relief) for USD 224 of API cost in the design sessions. Planted faults and engineering changes show that the checks find what their rules cover and miss the rest, so they guide human review rather than replace it. No independent engineer has reviewed the design.
summary_zh: 化学工程缺乏让LLM智能体执行并受验算的工作环境，故提出开源平台ChemE-as-Code，提供从催化到工厂布局等计算工具及技能。
工程文件以Git版本化且机器可读，计算在LLM外部运行并记录数值来源，自动检查可按文件和行报告不一致与过期结果。
在合成氨案例中，智能体以224美元生成基础设计包；验证表明自动检查能发现规则内错误以辅助人工审查，但无法替代人类。
comment: 28 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables; Supporting Information (28 pages) appended. Submitted to AIChE Journal. Code and data: https://github.com/ChemE-as-Code

title: tok: a textual concrete syntax of BPMN and DMN for humans and AI agents
title_zh: 面向人类与AI代理的BPMN与DMN文本具体语法tok
abstract: tok is a plain-text notation for Business Process Model and Notation (BPMN) 2.0.2 process models and Decision Model and Notation (DMN) 1.5 decisions. One engine checks a tok document against both standards, compiles the document to XML with an automatic diagram, and serves language-model applications through the Model Context Protocol. The paper classifies the notation as an alternative concrete syntax of the BPMN and DMN metamodels and reports one study. A tok model takes 2.2 times fewer tokens than the smallest BPMN XML of 893 files exported by 37 tools and 7.7 times fewer than the files as exported. The checker signals 98.2% of 1,411 injected faults, against 85.8% for the XML Schema with bpmnlint. Four language models new to tok write valid tok from a one-page reference for 85.7 to 100% of 87 process descriptions from two datasets and valid BPMN XML for every description, and the strongest model writes tok with 25% and 19% fewer tokens than BPMN XML. As agents with a lean skill and one checker tool, the models write valid tok for 97.6 to 100% of the descriptions, the strongest model spends 21% and 14% fewer tokens on tok than on BPMN XML, and a skill which sends the model to read the reference through a tool costs 1.7 to 2.8 times the tokens of the lean skill. Of 47 event logs simulated from public models, 44 fit their source models, and tok imports every model discovered from the logs.
summary_zh: BPMN与DMN的XML格式冗长且不利于AI处理，提出纯文本表示法tok作为两者的替代具体语法。
设计单引擎实现语法校验、XML编译与自动绘图，并通过MCP协议服务LLM应用。
tok比XML更省token且查错率更高，LLM作为agent能高效生成有效tok并完成流程发现与验证。

title: AttnSR: Attention Step Reward for Long-Horizon Agentic RL
title_zh: AttnSR：面向长程智能体RL的注意力步级奖励
abstract: Long-horizon LLM agents make multi-step decisions, yet outcome-reward-only reinforcement learning provides little direct supervision for individual steps. We introduce AttnSR, a step-level reward augmentation method that derives reward allocations from policy attention extracted during training replay, without a separately trained reward model or additional rollouts. AttnSR traces backward through the policy model attention graph to estimate the relevance of earlier steps to the final response. The terminal step, measured relative to a running baseline, determines whether these rewards reinforce or penalize the selected steps. In a controlled Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct study, AttnSR consistently outperforms the PPO baseline across all evaluated checkpoints on ALFWorld, raising final held-out success from 91.2% to 97.1%. The ablation experiment shows that the benefit depends on how intermediate rewards are assigned, rather than simple accumulation of step rewards over time. AttnSR also improves ScienceWorld at every checkpoint while cutting environment interactions by 29.9%. These results support policy attention as a practical prior for step-level reward allocation in long-horizon agentic RL. Code is available at https://github.com/fairyshine/AttnSR .
summary_zh: 长程LLM智能体多步决策缺乏单步监督，仅靠结果奖励的RL难以提供细粒度指导。
提出AttnSR，利用策略模型的注意力图反向追踪，估计前序步骤对最终响应的相关性，无需额外奖励模型或rollout。
实验表明，AttnSR显著提升ALFWorld与ScienceWorld成功率，减少29.9%环境交互，验证了策略注意力作为步级奖励先验的有效性。
comment: 20 pages, 4 figures, including appendices. Code: https://github.com/fairyshine/AttnSR

title: ZeroRAG: Adaptive Semantic Peer Routing for Decentralized Retrieval-Augmented Generation
title_zh: ZeroRAG：面向去中心化RAG的自适应语义对等路由
abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is a standard approach to enhance the reliability of large language model (LLM) outputs by retrieving documents relevant to a query and supplying them in the LLM prompt. Today's RAG systems collect, index, and serve these documents from centralized stores. In practice, however, documents are owned by organizations, devices, and individuals who cannot or will not surrender custody of them to a central party, e.g., because of privacy, copyright or regulatory compliance. Existing modern decentralized retrieval techniques either reintroduce a coordinating authority, or rely on a global data structure that requires continuous network-wide coordination (e.g., DHTs). We present ZeroRAG, a decentralized routing layer for document retrieval in RAG that performs semantic query routing across an overlay of peers with- out global data structures or centralized orchestration. Documents remain with the peers that own them, and each peer keeps only lightweight local state: a bounded set of neighbor advertisements and a cache of recently routed queries. Using these, ZeroRAG steers each query through a best-first walk that progressively rewires the overlay toward semantically relevant neighbors, so recall improves over time as the network self-organizes. We evaluate ZeroRAG using three real-world workloads and two decentralized baselines. We find that ZeroRAG outperforms baselines in terms of recall and required network messages, approaches the recall and LLM answer accuracy of a centralized document store, self-heals after catastrophic peer failures, and scales to 100 000 peers.
summary_zh: 现有RAG依赖中心化存储，存在隐私与合规限制，而现有去中心化检索仍需全局协调或中心权威。
提出ZeroRAG，基于对等节点构建去中心化路由层，仅依赖轻量本地状态进行语义查询路由。
该方法无需全局数据结构，通过最佳优先游走逐步重连网络，随自组织提升召回率，且具备自愈与扩展能力。

title: Adaptive Semantic Branching: Disagreement-Localized Cross-Trajectory Regeneration for Reasoning Candidate Expansion
title_zh: 自适应语义分支：基于分歧定位的跨轨迹再生推理候选扩展
abstract: Reasoning trajectories generated for the same problem often arrive at conflicting answers. These disagreements reveal alternative intermediate decisions that can be reused to explore new solutions. We introduce Adaptive Semantic Branching (ASB), a training-free inference procedure that turns cross-trajectory disagreement into targeted candidate generation. ASB first groups independently sampled trajectories by extracted final answer, selects a representative from each group, and aligns their reasoning steps with a monotonic dynamic program. A persistent-divergence objective identifies the point at which initially similar reasoning paths develop different continuations. For each selected directed pair, ASB retains the source trajectory's textual prefix, extracts a short reasoning window from a competing donor trajectory, and generates a fresh solution conditioned on both. A diversity-aware policy allocates up to three additional generations according to the answer-cluster structure. In a 500-problem MATH evaluation with Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, ASB increases oracle candidate coverage from 445/500 (89.0%) with seven initial samples to 455/500 (91.0%), recovering correct candidates for 10 of the 55 initially uncovered problems. The method uses 576 additional generation calls across the evaluation set, averaging 8.152 calls per problem. We provide a precise specification of the branching operator, alignment objective, generation policy, and experimental configuration.
summary_zh: 同一问题生成的推理轨迹常得出冲突答案，现有方法未充分利用这些分歧来探索新解。
提出无需训练的推理过程ASB，通过单调动态规划对齐轨迹，定位持续分歧点，并融合源轨迹前缀与竞争轨迹窗口来生成新解。
在MATH评测中，ASB将候选覆盖率从89.0%提升至91.0%，成功恢复10个先前未解问题的正确候选。

title: SymFC: Configurable Semantics for All Paths Symbolic Execution in Haskell via Embeddings
title_zh: SymFC：基于嵌入的Haskell全路径符号执行可配置语义
abstract: Lightweight methods like QuickCheck have proven to be successful in functional languages and beyond, as they let users specify properties as Boolean functions directly in code. We can replicate some of their benefits for (bounded) proofs via symbolic execution. If we can execute arbitrary functions symbolically, we can specify properties just as easily. Unfortunately, existing symbolic execution tools for Haskell are restricted to a subset of the language that excludes many real-world applications like IO; they also have a hard time scaling to larger programs, making them a poor fit for general purpose lightweight verification. One reason behind these limitations is that existing techniques only offer fixed symbolic semantics for SMT base types. This makes it hard to cover more programming constructs and libraries; it also makes it difficult to fine-tune symbolic representations for better performance. We present SymFC, a new symbolic execution method for Haskell that offers configurable semantics via embeddings. An embedding of a function in SymFC is just another Haskell function that can use arbitrary code, as well as SMT primitives. Embeddings make it easy to support new programming constructs and fine-tune symbolic representations for speed. To integrate embeddings into Haskell's type system, we make use of Haskell's coercions, which let us transparently convert between a Haskell type and the type of its embedding. We realize embeddings in SymFC, an all-paths symbolic execution engine for Haskell, which lets us symbolically represent arbitrary types and values in GHC core. We implement SymFC as a GHC plugin, and evaluate it by checking properties of Haskell's container library, and the iproute library. We build embeddings for IORef, Haskell's Ptr/ForeignPtr interface, and the hardware library Clash, and our evaluation reports a 6.25x speedup on G2's own benchmarks.
summary_zh: 现有Haskell符号执行工具受限于固定语义，难以支持IO等实际应用且扩展性差。
提出SymFC方法，利用嵌入提供可配置语义，嵌入本身即Haskell函数，可混用任意代码与SMT原语。
基于Haskell coercions实现类型系统集成，以GHC插件形式支持任意类型符号表示，有效验证了容器及iproute库属性。

title: Structure from Collision via Hypothesis-Space Reasoning
title_zh: 基于假设空间推理的碰撞恢复内部结构
abstract: Knowledge of the hidden interior structure of an object, including the presence and location of cavities, is essential for predictive simulation, robotic manipulation, and nondestructive inspection. However, such cavities leave no direct signature on the static visible surface, making collision-induced deformation one of the few cues used to infer their presence. Structure from Collision (SfC) addresses this problem by recovering the hidden interior structure of an object from multiview observations of a collision event. SfC is challenging for two reasons: hidden cavities are only indirectly observable through surface motion, and voids correspond to the absence of material, making direct optimization using standard density representations difficult. The density-based SfC baseline inherits both difficulties. Surface-matching gradients do not directly indicate the cavity location, while density gradients can be weak or uninformative inside or near void regions. Therefore, we reformulate SfC as hypothesis-space reasoning, representing hidden cavities as explicit structural hypotheses whose variables encode available structural assumptions rather than relying on implicit density updates. A global stage performs gradient-free optimization over this hypothesis space using forward-only material point method (MPM) simulation. A local stage then refines the selected hypothesis as a Lagrangian particle system through gradient-based optimization using differentiable MPM simulation. On the SfC benchmark, our method improves hidden-structure reconstruction and future prediction over the density-based SfC baseline. Interior-topology stress tests and robustness analyses characterize its scope and limitations. The project page is available at https://www.kecl.ntt.co.jp/people/kaneko.takuhiro/projects/sfc-hypothesis/.
summary_zh: 物体隐藏空腔无直接视觉特征，传统基于密度的SfC方法因空腔梯度弱而难以优化。
提出将SfC重构为假设空间推理，用显式结构假设表示空腔，避免隐式密度更新。
结合无梯度全局优化与可微MPM局部精修，在SfC基准上显著优于基线方法。

title: A Low Similarity Score Does Not Show Independence after Source-Conditioned Repository Rewriting
title_zh: 源码条件重写后低相似度不能证明独立性
abstract: Maintainers sometimes cite a low token-similarity score as evidence that an LLM-assisted rewrite of a copyleft project is independent of the original. We test what such a score can support under \emph{source-conditioned} rewriting: a coding agent keeps the original in its working copy, rewrites the repository, and iterates until a fixed behavioural harness passes, with no human edit to the code. On 69 rewrites of six copyleft Python projects we find that: \ding{182}~Agent-only rewriting is inexpensive and often yields low scores. Every controlled rewrite passes the harness after repair, usually within half an hour for the initial rewrite. Under a ground-up rearchitecture prompt, most rewrites fall below 25\% JPlag similarity and still pass the harness. \ding{183}~A single low score is an unreliable witness. Identical project--agent--prompt configurations produce wide spreads in similarity; run-to-run variation dominates project and agent effects, and in more than a third of configurations the three repeats straddle the threshold. Rewrites retain more of the original's imports and fingerprint facts than unrelated projects do, yet hand-written independent implementations of the same task often retain as much, and neither signal separates the two groups better than chance. Thus a low score on one rewrite is weak evidence of independence: another run of the same agent may score high. Claims based on similarity should report repeated generations, and candidate provenance signals should be checked against same task independent implementations, not only against unrelated projects.
summary_zh: 针对低token相似度被用作LLM重写独立于原项目证据的问题，测试源码条件重写下的相似度表现，发现仅靠Agent重写即可低成本获得低相似度且通过测试。
相同配置下重写相似度波动极大，单次低分不可靠，运行间差异远超项目或Agent效应，超三分之一配置的重复结果跨越阈值。
重写保留的导入和指纹特征无法有效区分重写与独立实现，单次低相似度是独立性的弱证据，建议报告重复生成结果并对比同任务独立实现。

title: Compositional Loop Invariant Inference for Multiphase Programs via Structured Neurosymbolic Reasoning
title_zh: 基于结构化神经符号推理的多阶段程序组合式循环不变式推断
abstract: Loop invariants are essential for deductive program verification, yet automatically inferring them for {multiphase programs}, whose loops contain conditional branches that induce multiple execution phases with distinct behaviors, remains an open problem. Existing LLM-based methods either reason about loops as a whole or use explicit branch information to generate atomic assertions jointly across branches, without maintaining complete candidate sub-invariants for independent generation and targeted repair. We present CLOVER, a structured neurosymbolic reasoning framework for multiphase invariant inference built on two interlinked mechanisms. First, compositional inference: CLOVER statically decomposes a loop into symbolic {loop branch sequences}, conjunctions of the loop guard and branch conditions that characterize distinct execution scenarios, and guides the LLM to generate candidate sub-invariants for each one independently, so that each LLM query focuses on a single execution scenario rather than the entire loop. Second, counterexample-guided localized refinement: when SMT verification rejects a composed disjunctive invariant, CLOVER traces the counterexample back through the branch structure to identify which specific loop branch sequence caused the failure and repairs only that sub-invariant, preserving all correct components. Both mechanisms are unified by a shared symbolic structure derived from the loop's branch semantics, which guides what the LLM generates, how candidates are composed, and where refinement is directed. We evaluate CLOVER on 316 linear arithmetic, 50 nonlinear arithmetic, and 54 multiphase benchmarks. CLOVER solves 35 of 54 multiphase benchmarks, outperforming the best LLM-based baseline (29) by 20.7\% and the best traditional method (22) by 59.1\%. On linear/nonlinear benchmarks, CLOVER remains competitive, solving 355 of 366 programs overall.
summary_zh: 多阶段程序循环含多条件分支致执行阶段各异，现有LLM方法缺乏独立子不变式生成与定向修复能力。
提出CLOVER框架，静态分解循环为符号分支序列，引导LLM独立生成各子不变式，聚焦单一执行场景。
SMT验证反例时，CLOVER将反例溯源至具体分支并仅修复该子不变式；在多阶段基准上超越最优基线20.7%。

title: Which Signals of Code Correctness Survive Distribution Shift? Hidden-State and Causal Predictors of Program and Verdict Correctness
title_zh: 代码正确性信号在分布偏移下的存活情况研究
abstract: Large language models increasingly judge code, yet without external feedback such judgments are unreliable, and verifying them by executing tests or by extended reasoning is costly. Instead, execution-free correctness predictors use signals from the model's output probabilities, sampled solutions, or hidden states to identify judgments that warrant further verification. However, these predictors may degrade under distribution shifts when generalizing across projects and languages. We compare six execution-free predictors from four families on Qwen3-Coder-30B and gpt-oss-20b under benchmark shift between LiveCodeBench and BigCodeBench and language shift across Python, C++ and Java. We evaluate two targets: whether the model's own verdict on a program can be trusted, and whether the program itself is correct. Besides established approaches, we adapt two novel causal localization methods to code, which have been shown to be more robust out-of-distribution on natural language tasks. For verdict correctness, causal localization improves robustness to language shift. For Qwen3-Coder a probe on the causally localized subspace stays 0.09 AUROC ahead of output confidence under language shift (0.11 in distribution), significantly outperforming the best non-causal predictor by 0.04 AUROC on average. This advantage, however, does not generalize consistently to gpt-oss or to benchmark shift. For program correctness, predictors transfer more successfully between benchmarks, largely by identifying problems on which the model tends to fail. However, their ability to rank candidates within the same problem is limited.
summary_zh: LLM代码判断缺乏外部反馈不可靠，而执行验证成本高，需研究免执行正确性预测器在跨项目和语言分布偏移下的鲁棒性。
在跨语言和基准偏移下评估六种免执行预测器，并首次将两种因果定位方法适配至代码任务以提升OOD鲁棒性。
因果定位提升了判决正确性对语言偏移的鲁棒性，但未一致泛化至其他模型或基准偏移；程序正确性预测器跨基准泛化较好，但同题内排序能力有限。

title: Do Recommenders Need to Think in Words? Latent Reasoning for Efficient LLM-Based Recommendation
title_zh: 基于LLM的高效推荐：用隐式推理替代显式推理
abstract: LLM-based recommender systems increasingly generate chain-of-thought (CoT) text before each item prediction to activate the LLM's reasoning capacity, costing tens to hundreds of extra tokens per recommendation at inference. We ask whether inference-time reasoning artifacts (textual or latent) can be replaced by training-time supervision alone, without loss of accuracy. We propose LatentRec, a framework for LLM-based generative recommendation that replaces inference-time reasoning artifacts with training-time per-step head supervision. LatentRec has three components. A 2.5M-parameter Continuous Thought Module iterates K latent reasoning steps over the LLM's hidden state during training. Soft Token Selection bridges the ~14x norm gap between hidden states and input embeddings. A Per-step Reasoning Loss (PRL) supervises every intermediate state through the LLM's prediction head against the first token of the target Semantic ID. The trained LLM retains this accuracy without the module at inference, so the module can be discarded at deployment. On three Amazon benchmarks, LatentRec improves HR@10 by 4.0-5.0% (relative) over a CoT-distilled baseline at 18.3x lower latency (batch=1). Per-step training supervision consistently improves accuracy across three datasets, paid once at training rather than at every recommendation.
summary_zh: LLM推荐系统推理时生成CoT文本开销大，需探索仅靠训练监督替代推理期推理的方法。
提出LatentRec框架，用连续思维模块迭代隐式推理，结合软令牌选择与逐步推理损失进行训练监督。
训练后可丢弃推理模块，在三个数据集上相对提升HR@10达4.0-5.0%，且降低18.3倍延迟。
comment: Accepted at CIKM 2026 (Short Paper). 5 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables
journal_ref: Proceedings of the 35th ACM International Conference on Information and Knowledge Management (CIKM '26), November 7-11, 2026, Rome, Italy

title: Towards Foundation Decision Models: Drex
title_zh: 迈向基础决策模型：Drex
abstract: Autoregressive approaches with large language models, such as long chain-of-thought reasoning, have become the default for new AI applications because they reach higher accuracy on a wide range of tasks. In production, however, they give inconsistent answers, require parsing of outputs, and add cost and latency. Decision models address this: given a question and a set of options supplied by the user, they return a probability distribution over the options without autoregressive decoding. We present Drex, a family of four open decision models with 8B (DLM), 9B (v1.5), 35B with 3B active (v2.0), and 27B (Max) parameters. Each request consists of a state (a document, record, or agent context, optionally with images) and questions about it, each asking for a choice among options, a yes/no judgment, or a score on an ordered scale. Training combines supervised fine-tuning with reinforcement learning from adjusted feedback (RLAF), plus vision tuning for Max. Ablations show that RLAF improves accuracy and that consistency losses improve robustness to option order. On Decision Index 0.4.1, Max sets a new state of the art among the decision models we compare (67.52 on the public suite vs. 60.70 for Jev 1.14.0). On Decision Bench v4, it is statistically tied with d3-turbo and GPT-6 Sol and trails Claude Opus 5.5 by 1.6 points, and it has the highest accuracy among decision models on DecideBench. Max answers a typical request in 183 ms, against about 2.0 s for GPT-6 Sol and 3.5 s for Claude Opus 5.5, and its outputs are stable under option reordering. All four models are open source: https://github.com/nace-ai/drex-decision-models
summary_zh: 自回归LLM在生产中存在不一致、高延迟等问题，决策模型通过直接返回选项概率分布来避免自回归解码。
提出Drex系列四个开源决策模型，结合监督微调、调整反馈强化学习（RLAF）及一致性损失进行训练。
Drex Max在Decision Index上达SOTA，速度远超GPT-6等，且对选项重排具有鲁棒性。
comment: 51 pages, 13 figures, 25 tables. Models and code: https://huggingface.co/nace-ai

title: THG-Omni: Traceable Human-Centric Graph Supervision for Video Reasoning
title_zh: THG-Omni：面向视频推理的可溯源以人为中心图监督框架
abstract: Omni-modal models can answer questions about video, but their predictions rarely show which participant, event, or interval supports an answer. Moreover, answer-level supervision alone does not teach a model to interpret structured video evidence. To systematically mitigate this issue, we present THG-Omni, a human-centric graph-supervision framework that links Segment Anything Model~3 participant tracks with temporally grounded Qwen3-VL annotations. Candidate semantic claims are checked against the source video and available audio before they are used to construct training questions, while track geometry provides explicit spatial and temporal supervision. The resulting questions teach an omni-modal reasoning model to interpret participant attributes, actions, affect, interactions, and their timing from a structured graph. At inference, THG-Omni uses a predicted graph constructed from the evaluation video. Experiments on IntentBench show consistent improvements over the unadapted backbone across social reasoning, emotion understanding, and deception perception. On NExT-QA, THG-Omni achieves 89.54\% accuracy with the matched graph, compared with 85.10\% without graph input. Further validation experiments show that compact graph input achieves 78.22\% accuracy, compared with 78.02\% using the full graph and 77.58\% without graph input. A complementary diagnostic demonstrates that the predicted graph preserves evidence useful for answering questions even without the source video and audio. Together, these findings show that THG-Omni improves human-centric video reasoning while grounding its evidence in identifiable participants and events. Our codes are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/review-n94hhfcwp5666/
summary_zh: 全模态视频模型缺乏可溯源证据支撑，仅靠答案级监督无法学习结构化视频证据。
提出THG-Omni框架，结合SAM3参与者轨迹与Qwen3-VL时序标注，通过几何与语义校验构建图监督训练问题。
实验表明该方法在社交推理等任务上持续提升，图输入使NExT-QA准确率达89.54%，且紧凑图即可保留核心证据。

title: Instantiating the Knowledge Plane
title_zh: 实例化知识平面：基于智能体LLM的跨域网络管理
abstract: In 2003, Clark et al. proposed the "Knowledge Plane", a layer of intelligent agents that share rich information about network state in order to collaboratively manage the Internet across administrative boundaries. The technology of the day lacked the two capabilities it demanded most: reasoning and unstructured communication. Thus, automated network management has remained largely confined to single domains, while interdomain problems are still resolved by human operators on the phone. We argue that agentic large language models can finally unlock the potential of the Knowledge Plane, but that doing so will require solving new research problems that arise particularly in this decentralized, multi-agent, coopetitive setting that have received limited attention in the literature thus far.
summary_zh: 跨域网络问题仍依赖人工协调，因传统技术缺乏推理与非结构化通信能力，知识平面构想未实现。
智能体大语言模型（LLM）具备所需推理与通信能力，有望解锁知识平面潜力以实现跨域协同管理。
在去中心化、多智能体及竞合环境下实例化知识平面，会引发新的研究问题，需进一步探索。
comment: Accepted at HotNets '26 (Salt Lake City, UT, USA). 11 pages

title: Generate-then-Rank: Learning Symbolic Goal Interpretation for Embodied Agents
title_zh: 生成再排序：具身智能体的符号目标解释学习方法
abstract: Goal interpretation is to translate a natural language instruction into a formal symbolic goal that a planner can execute. It is critical for embodied agents because any error here propagates to every downstream planning and action step. Doing it well requires both generating suitable candidates and reliably selecting among them. We present a two-stage generate-then-rank approach to Goal Interpretation in the Embodied Agent Interface (EAI). First, supervised fine-tuning adapts a Large Language Model (LLM) to EAI's output convention. Second, Candidate-Output Ranking from Errors (CORE) learns preferences over complete outputs from the model's own generated alternatives. We conducted experiments on the household scenes of the Embodied Agent Interface Benchmark. Multiple open source LLMs including DeepSeek-V3 chat, DeepSeek-Reasoner, and Qwen2.5-7B and Qwen2.5-72B were evaluated. The proposed method outperformed the baseline models including LLMs with simple prompting, chain-of-thought, and knowledge graph based approaches.
summary_zh: 具身智能体将自然语言指令转为符号目标易出错且会向下游传播，需同时生成合适候选并可靠选择。
提出两阶段生成再排序方法：先微调LLM适应输出规范，再用CORE算法从模型自身生成的候选中学习偏好。
在EAI基准上评估多个开源LLM，该方法优于简单提示、思维链及基于知识图的基线模型。
comment: 14 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at the 10th Euro-China Conference on Intelligent Data Analysis and Applications (ECC 2026)

title: Thinking Is Not Writing: Designing AI Chatbots to Connect Reasoning and Revision
title_zh: 思考非写作：连接推理与修改的AI聊天机器人设计
abstract: Supporting students' argumentative writing with AI requires connecting reflection to their revision processes. We present Maike, a Socratic chatbot supporting writing through argument diagnosis, targeted questioning, and a student model across Think and Write modes. In a classroom study, 65 secondary-school students used Maike or a control chatbot sharing the interface, language model, and Think/Write modes. Approximately 40% of students improved their essay scores. However, Maike users engaged more in idea-level dialogue (56% vs. 44%) and moved iteratively between discussion and editing. Transitions from ideas discussed in dialogue to revisions were positively associated with score gains. These findings suggest a design target for AI writing support: coordinating reflection with revision. We contribute an architecture for supporting argumentative reasoning without generating essay text and an approach linking interaction patterns to writing processes and outcomes. As AI becomes embedded in classrooms, understanding these connections is essential to assessing (and designing for) its educational value.
summary_zh: 问题：AI辅助议论文写作需将反思与修改过程相连，而非直接生成文本。
方法：提出Maike聊天机器人，通过论证诊断、定向提问与学生模型协调反思与修改。
结论：Maike用户更多参与观点级对话并在讨论与编辑间迭代，该转换与分数提升正相关。

title: Geometric Functional Inequalities for Markov Processes: An Invitation via the Langevin Diffusion
title_zh: 马尔可夫过程的几何泛函不等式：以朗之万扩散为引
abstract: Functional inequalities provide a language for reasoning about the long-time properties of ergodic Markov processes in terms of their macroscopic geometry. This article offers an informal introduction to functional inequalities for readers who are more familiar with probabilistic tools based around couplings, Lyapunov techniques, and similar. The main ideas are developed through the overdamped Langevin diffusion, where various functionals related to this convergence admit particularly transparent expressions, and for which the key associated inequalities -- namely, the Poincaré and logarithmic Sobolev inequalities -- are especially well-studied. We explain the qualitative content of these inequalities, what they imply about convergence to equilibrium, how they transform and compose under natural operations, and how they interface with classical probabilistic approaches. Related inequalities are discussed more briefly, and an annotated guide is provided for readers wishing to enter the wider literature.
summary_zh: 【问题→方法】为向熟悉耦合与Lyapunov等概率工具的读者介绍泛函不等式，本文以过阻尼Langevin扩散为核心展开非正式导引。
【方法→结论】通过Langevin扩散中收敛泛函的显式表达，阐释Poincaré与对数Sobolev不等式的定性内涵及其对收敛至平衡态的推论。
【结论→贡献】阐明不等式在自然操作下的变换与组合方式，建立其与经典概率方法的联系，并提供相关文献导览。
comment: 21 pages of writing, 4 pages of references, 6 figures

title: The Intrusion Pathway: How Non-Evidential Context Degrades Language Model Performance
title_zh: 非证据上下文如何降低语言模型性能：侵入路径
abstract: Language models lose accuracy when a prompt contains non-evidential context: irrelevant statements from unrelated domains, or random off-distribution tokens, with no competing answer and no semantic overlap with the query. Such noise pervades retrieval-augmented, tool-using, and long-context deployments, yet the failure has lacked a mechanistic account. We trace the corruption to the Intrusion Pathway, which starts with MLPs enriching both query-subject and irrelevant-token representations, parroting heads carry prefix-token content to the prediction position, and relational readers largely avoid unrelated sources. Nevertheless, preserved subject enrichment and selective reading do not prevent intrusion in the broader computation. We then localize part of this interference to a sparse set of attention heads, which we call intrusion heads. Their prefix-derived writes promote distractor-related content, while their reduced support for the correct answer arises primarily from weaker non-prefix contributions rather than direct suppression by the prefix. The same heads transfer across tasks and distractor types and are largely weight-disjoint from the heads that integrate relevant contextual evidence, enabling a class-conditional intervention. Replacing the corrupted last-token residual with its clean counterpart, an oracle probe that requires a matched clean forward pass, recovers 97.6% on average of the distractor-induced drop across four downstream tasks. A deployable mask level knockout of about ten heads, roughly 1% of the model's attention heads, recovers 57% at bounded cost to helpful context.
summary_zh: 无关噪声会降低语言模型准确率，但缺乏机制解释，本文追溯其失效原因为“侵入路径”。
定位到稀疏的“侵入头”，其前缀写入促进干扰内容，对正确答案的支持减弱而非直接抑制。
对约1%的侵入头进行掩码剔除，可恢复57%的噪声性能下降，且对有用上下文代价有限。
comment: 32 pages, 25 figures, 29 tables. Dikshant Kukreja and Gautam Gupta contributed equally. Website: https://dk4248.github.io/the-intrusion-pathway/ Code: https://github.com/dk4248/the-intrusion-pathway

title: Adapt the Object to the Subject: Representative Study Material for Empirical Software Engineering
title_zh: 适配研究对象至受试者：实证软件工程的代表性研究材料
abstract: External validity is a central concern in empirical software engineering, yet the debate has largely focused on whether study participants are representative. How well the study objects they reason about - code, models, or requirements - are representative of each participant's own work is often overlooked. Practitioners' own artifacts would be ideal, but are often out of reach, so researchers sample from public datasets or construct objects artificially. Whether this lack of subject-object fit affects participants' ability to act on the material remains unknown. We take a first step toward answering this question for requirements. We propose an approach that uses an LLM to generate context-adapted synthetic requirements just-in-time during an online survey from a short, participant-supplied context description, optionally injecting requirements smells as controlled stimuli. To validate the approach, we conducted a controlled experiment with 31 industry practitioners in a 2x2 design that crosses stimulus generation (static vs. synthetic) with quality (clean vs. smelly). Each participant rated the perceived representativeness and assessability of 20 requirements. Using Bayesian data analysis within a statistical causal-inference framework, we find that perceived representativeness has a strong positive effect on assessability. Synthetic requirements are rated as more representative and, primarily due to this gain, more assessable than static ones sourced from public datasets; smell injection leaves both perceptions unchanged. Our results support treating a lack of study-object representativeness as a first-class validity threat and position context-adapted synthetic study objects as a practical addition to the empirical methodology toolbox.
summary_zh: 实证软件工程常忽视研究对象的代表性，即代码或需求等材料能否代表受试者的实际工作，其影响尚不明确。
提出利用 LLM 根据受试者提供的简短上下文，即时生成上下文适配的合成需求，并可选注入需求缺陷作为刺激。
实验表明，感知代表性对可评估性有强正向影响；合成需求比静态需求更具代表性和可评估性，应将其视为首要效度威胁。

title: BiGrounder: Bidirectional Training Unlocks the Potential of GUI Grounding
title_zh: 双向训练释放GUI定位潜力
abstract: Graphical User Interface (GUI) grounding aims to map natural language instructions to precise operational coordinates, serving as a critical task for autonomous agent interaction. Current approaches formalize GUI grounding as predicting action-coordinate pairs from instructions, with end-to-end training supervised solely by final coordinates. Training datasets typically provide only a small number of descriptions per target coordinate, whereas real-world scenarios involve a much larger set of varied descriptions for the same target, which limits robustness to linguistic variation. While recent GUI grounding paradigms have begun employing reinforcement learning to enhance localization accuracy, models with limited exploratory capability before reinforcement yield constrained improvements even with identical training data during the reinforcement phase. To overcome these limitations, we propose a bidirectional reward paradigm that enables model self-reinforcement. During SFT, bidirectional training equips the model to generate action descriptions from target coordinates. During RL, the model samples semantically consistent instruction variations on-policy and grounds each variation back to its target. A cycle-consistency gate couples semantic quality to grounding success, turning the model's own instruction policy into a source of continually refreshed reinforcement trajectories. Our 4B-parameter model achieves competitive accuracy across five grounding benchmarks in our evaluation, indicating the effectiveness of the proposed training paradigm. https://github.com/Spell-shi/BiGrounder
summary_zh: 现有GUI定位仅用最终坐标监督，且描述多样性不足，导致模型对语言变化鲁棒性差。
提出双向奖励范式：SFT阶段学习由坐标生成描述，RL阶段在线采样语义一致的指令变体并回溯定位。
循环一致性门控将语义质量与定位成功耦合，实现模型自强化，4B模型在五项基准上达到领先精度。

title: RIVER: Evidence-guided multi-agent retrieval for enzyme--reaction discovery
title_zh: RIVER：证据引导的多智能体酶-反应检索框架
abstract: Enzyme function annotation and the identification of candidate enzymes for a given reaction are essential steps in connecting genomic information to biochemical reaction networks. However, existing methods rely on sequence or structural similarity or on training with known enzyme--reaction pairs, making it difficult to integrate biochemical evidence across large candidate spaces; they also struggle with retrieval tasks involving enzyme families whose members are highly similar. Here, we introduce RIVER (Reaction--enzyme Inference via Evidence-guided Retrieval), a multi-agent framework for bidirectional enzyme--reaction retrieval that identifies potentially catalyzed reactions for a given enzyme and ranks candidate enzymes for a given reaction. RIVER coordinates large language models, specialized biochemical computational tools, and external knowledge resources to assemble evidence at multiple levels, including reaction chemistry, protein sequences and domains, catalytic mechanisms, and database annotations. Dedicated validation modules further examine evidence gaps and potential conflicts and rerank candidates using traceable evidence records. On public benchmarks, RIVER achieves the highest success rates in both enzyme retrieval and enzyme annotation. In family-specific enzyme retrieval, RIVER outperforms the evaluated baselines on the selected datasets and metrics. In Escherichia coli enzyme retrieval tasks constructed from recent literature, RIVER achieves the best retrieval results with closed-source and open-source model configurations, substantially outperforming closed-source general-purpose and biology-specialized multi-agent systems, including Claude Code, Codex, and Phylo Max. These results suggest that evidence-guided multi-agent retrieval can prioritize biochemically supported enzyme--reaction relationships, providing a basis for subsequent experimental validation.
summary_zh: 现有酶-反应检索方法难以整合大候选空间的生化证据，且对高相似酶家族检索困难。
提出RIVER框架，协调LLM与生化工具等多智能体，多层级组装证据并验证冲突以重排候选。
在公开基准与大肠杆菌检索任务上，RIVER成功率最高，显著优于Claude Code等基线系统。

title: Uncovering Systematic Blind Spots in Graph Database Testing through Integration and Process-Level Analysis
title_zh: 通过集成与过程级分析揭示图数据库测试的系统性盲区
abstract: Graph databases are becoming foundational infrastructure for connected data, and a growing body of automated testing techniques has uncovered many bugs across mature graph database systems. Each technique checks a different aspect of correctness and exposes a different class of defect. Combining them is the natural next step, but each technique is judged by the real bugs it finds, not by useless reports or tests that can never fail, and that is what decides whether a developer can afford to fix the problems. To identify the remaining gaps, we integrated test capabilities from 8 testing methods and conducted an empirical study of their behavior, during which we found two blind spots. First, 12 hours of testing produce thousands of bug reports, far more than the number of genuine defects a mature database is likely to contain. Most reports are false positives caused by dialect or pattern-matching differences, and many of the remaining reports are duplicates. Second, analysis of process-level data reveals that many equivalence-based metamorphic test cases lose their ability to detect defects because of the optimization mechanism. Based on these findings, we summarize and realize these guidelines in GraphWeave, an integrated testing platform for graph databases. This includes a multi-agent system that analyzes the flood of bug reports to produce gating rules for issue filtering and adapter rules for dialect adaptation, and a plan-aware triage routes metamorphic pairs by plan, skipping those that share a plan on the same graph state and therefore cannot detect defects. We apply GraphWeave to NeuG, a recently open-sourced industrial graph database that has not been covered by prior graph database testing work. With modest manual effort, GraphWeave uncovers 19 previously unknown bugs, all of which have since been confirmed.
summary_zh: 图数据库自动化测试存在大量误报与等价测试失效问题，需整合多种测试方法以识别剩余缺陷。
