The same checkpoint also transfers across downstream models and agent harnesses without additional fine-tuning.
summary_zh: 长时序Agent交互历史过长需压缩，现有方法依赖特定任务，本文提出独立摘要器SumOne。
通过冻结重构器对掩码轨迹的恢复质量与长度惩罚，提供任务无关奖励，用GRPO优化摘要器。
SumOne实现即插即用压缩，推理成本降约75%-78%，性能仅降0.04，且可零微调跨模型迁移。

title: Understanding the Out-of-Distribution Generalization of Chain-of-Thought Reasoning in LLMs
title_zh: 大模型思维链推理的分布外泛化机制研究
abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning substantially improves Large Language Models (LLMs), yet its out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization mechanism remains theoretically underexplored. We study CoT as compositional OOD generalization: the target task lacks complete reasoning trajectories or direct input-output pairs, while training provides only in-distribution (ID) atomic step data. We show that CoT generalizes by repeatedly applying a shared single-step predictor to compose reusable ID transitions. Theoretically, let $T$ denote the number of reasoning steps in the target task, $n$ the number of training samples per sub-task, and $k$ the number of output tokens per step; then the OOD task risk is controlled by the sum of the ID sub-task risks, scaled by a coefficient of order $\mathcal{O}(k)$ that is independent of $T$, although the summed risk itself may still grow with $T$. A Rademacher-complexity analysis further shows that the estimation term is of order $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{T/n})$, rather than linear in $T$, due to predictor sharing under a uniform capacity control on the shared class. For autoregressive Next-Token Prediction, the final-task risk is bounded by the best-in-class step-level risk scaled by the same coefficient of order $\mathcal{O}(k)$, plus an estimation term of order $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}\big(k\sqrt{T/n}\big)$. A parity-coupled construction further shows that, for the sub-task empirical risk minimizer, the expected final-task risk is at least the best in-class risk plus $Ω(\sqrt{T/n})$ when $T\le n$. Experiments on Atom-Task and GSM8K support the theory: CoT enables short-to-long and compositional generalization, while explicit state tracking is crucial. Our code is available at https://github.com/maxliang114514/CoT-OOD.
summary_zh: 问题：CoT推理的分布外泛化机制缺乏理论探索，目标任务缺乏完整轨迹或直接数据对。
方法：将CoT视为组合泛化，通过共享单步预测器重复应用可复用的分布内转移，并进行Rademacher复杂度分析。
结论：OOD任务风险由ID子任务风险与O(k)系数控制，估计项为O(√(T/n))而非线性增长，实验验证了短到长泛化。

title: Entropogram-guided Visual Realignment Decoding: Capturing the Rhythm of Multimodal Reasoning
title_zh: 基于信息熵图的视觉重对齐解码：捕捉多模态推理节奏
abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable progress on cross-modal reasoning tasks, yet they continue to suffer from hallucinations in long-chain reasoning processes. In this work, we revisit hallucination in MLLMs from the perspective of reasoning generation dynamics. We argue that entropy is not merely a static measure of uncertainty but a structured signal that reflects how modality information is integrated throughout decoding. Through systematic analysis, we identify two characteristic entropy patterns associated with hallucination behaviors: (1) a generally high-confidence regime corresponds to premature convergence to inappropriate multimodal interactions; and (2) local abrupt entropy transitions are associated with reasoning instability and hallucination onset. Building on these observations, we propose an entropy-aware self-introspective framework for MLLM reasoning. Our method continuously tracks entropy dynamics during decoding and performs targeted visual re-alignment when suspicious hallucination states are detected, encouraging the model to re-examine salient visual evidence at critical reasoning stages. Extensive experiments across six multimodal reasoning benchmarks spanning nine distinct evaluation settings demonstrate that our approach delivers robust improvements in reasoning accuracy and hallucination robustness, while providing new insights into the generation dynamics underlying MLLM failures. The code is available at: https://github.com/jden4524/SelfRetrospectiveDecoding.
summary_zh: MLLM在长链推理中易生幻觉，本文从推理生成动态视角将其归结为熵的静态误用。
发现幻觉对应两种熵模式：高置信早收敛于不当交互，局部熵突变引发推理失稳。
提出熵感知自省框架，解码时追踪熵动态并在可疑处重对齐视觉证据，有效提升准确性与鲁棒性。

title: Zero-Shot Coordination among LLM Agents
title_zh: LLM Agent间的零样本协调
abstract: We study zero-shot coordination (ZSC), where independently developed agents must coordinate at test time. While ZSC has been well studied in the RL literature, far less is known about the performance of LLM agents despite their increasing deployment in such settings. Existing work on LLM coordination often relies on specialised scaffolding that independently developed agents are unlikely to share in practice. Moreover, evaluations on complex environments (e.g., Hanabi) make it difficult to pinpoint the sources of coordination failure. In contrast, we focus on simple, general-purpose scaffolds in minimal environments designed to isolate specific coordination challenges. Our results show that even in these controlled settings, frontier LLM agents struggle to coordinate, largely due to limited understanding of the coordination problem and weak reasoning about their partner's beliefs. While LLMs introduce semantic information as an additional axis for coordination, they nonetheless fail to exploit this structure effectively. Towards this, we propose Coordination-friendly definitions (CFDs) as a principled approach for enabling robust coordination among LLM agents. Finally, we show that CFDs can be discovered automatically, removing the need for manual engineering. Code is available at https://github.com/ahayler/zsc-llm-agents.
summary_zh: 现有LLM协调研究依赖专用脚手架且环境复杂，难以定位协调失败根源，本文改用通用脚手架与极简环境来隔离特定协调挑战。
实验发现前沿LLM在受控环境中仍难以协调，主因是对协调问题理解受限及对伙伴信念推理薄弱，且未能有效利用语义信息。
提出协调友好定义（CFDs）以实现LLM agent间的鲁棒协调，并证明CFDs可自动发现，无需人工设计。
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Poster. ICLR 26 MALGAI Workshop Oral. The first two authors contributed equally

title: MA-Mesh: Resilient Multi-Agent Collaboration via Role-based Self-Healing
title_zh: MA-Mesh：基于角色的自愈式多智能体协作框架
abstract: Effective collaboration in multi-agent systems requires mechanisms for coordination and adaptability in dynamic and uncertain environments. However, existing multi-agent systems rarely model resilience explicitly, instead relying on ad-hoc output correction that limits systematic, runtime management of robustness. In this work, we propose Multi-Agent Mesh (MA-Mesh), a framework that constructs a role-based self-healing layer on top of a collaboration pattern. Specifically, MA-Mesh generates resilience-aware system specifications and synthesizes them into executable multi-agent policy code. To enhance resilience, we introduce two self-healing mechanisms: Cross-agent reflection, a mechanism that allows agents to evaluate not only their own outcomes but also the performance of their peers, enabling informed behavioral adjustments and collective policy refinement; Role-based failover, a strategy which dynamically reassigns roles and enables agents to substitute for one another when sub-tasks fail or agents underperform, ensuring continuity of task execution. Experimental results across diverse tasks (e.g., software development, tool use, scientific reasoning) demonstrate that MA-Mesh significantly outperforms existing multi-agent systems in both task performance and robustness under system uncertainty.
summary_zh: 现有系统缺乏显式韧性建模，仅靠临时纠错，难以实现系统级鲁棒性管理。
提出MA-Mesh框架，生成韧性感知规范并合成策略代码，构建基于角色的自愈层。
引入跨智能体反思与角色故障转移机制，实验表明该框架显著提升任务性能与鲁棒性。

title: From hydrological laws to catchment models: A process-based model matches deep-learning accuracy on three continents
title_zh: 从水文定律到流域模型：基于过程的模型在三洲匹敌深度学习精度
abstract: Dooge asked whether hydrology has laws at the catchment scale. We ask whether a low-dimensional system built under physical laws can match the accuracy of neural networks that outperform process-based models on the same inputs. Three laws constrain a lumped catchment model. Conservation makes it a flux-connected storage network, dissipation fixes the sign of every flux and aggregation determines how the unresolved composition enters the fluxes, through effective laws over threshold distributions and a memory of the forcing. These laws admit four kinds of refinement. A parsimonious model under them, CaRT (11 parameters per catchment), is refined in a loop assisted by AI agents. Each refinement addresses an observed deficit through a hypothesis from the literature. The result, CaRT+, has fourteen states, 35 parameters per catchment and no daily neural network. Most refinements follow from aggregation over thresholds or from variables that carry no water but modulate fluxes. On 602 British and 593 US gauged catchments, single CaRT+ models reach median Nash-Sutcliffe efficiencies of 0.863 and 0.765 in held-out years. A stateful LSTM reaches 0.869 and 0.751 and an entity-aware LSTM 0.862 and 0.754, while three-seed LSTM ensembles remain ahead of the CaRT+ ensemble by 0.003-0.012 in median paired NSE. On 505 drier Australian gauged catchments unused in development, single CaRT+ models reach 0.778 against 0.762 and 0.753 for the two LSTMs. The results suggest that catchment-scale laws exist as laws of form, with the constitutive families shared and only their parameters learned.
summary_zh: 传统过程模型精度不及神经网络，探究基于物理定律的低维系统能否匹敌神经网络精度。
基于守恒、耗散与聚合定律构建精简模型CaRT，并在AI agent辅助下通过文献假设循环修正缺陷，得到CaRT+模型。
在英美澳602、593和505个流域上，CaRT+精度与LSTM相当，表明流域尺度存在形式定律，仅需学习参数。
comment: 61 pages, 12 figures, 13 tables, plus 19 pages of Supporting Information

title: LegalEvolver: Agentic Legal Judgment Prediction via Rubric-Guided Self-Evolution
title_zh: 基于评分准则引导自演化的法律判决预测智能体
abstract: As LLM-based agents develop, they have been increasingly applied in the legal domain. Legal Judgment Prediction~(LJP) requires models to conduct multi-step reasoning and external legal evidence retrieval. Existing legal search agents' performance is often constrained by the quality of retrieval queries. They often formulate queries directly from the initial user request, overlooking latent legal issues and legally salient details. To address this issue, we propose \emph{LegalEvolver}, a query optimization framework specifically designed to generate legally informative queries for LJP-oriented retrieval. Sampling high-quality optimized queries and their corresponding search trajectories is challenging, as relying solely on unguided high-temperature rollouts is both inefficient and constrained by the model's initial capabilities. We therefore heuristically optimize queries as seeds, improving the efficiency of trajectory generation. Furthermore, we summarize rollout experience into rubrics and use them to guide multi-round iterative self-evolution. Iteratively performing rubric optimization and rubric-guided RL enables the model to surpass its initial performance ceiling. End-to-end performance on extensive benchmarks demonstrates the effectiveness of query optimization on LJP. Comparisons with direct SFT followed by RL demonstrate the effectiveness of rubric guidance. Evolving rubrics further outperform fixed rubrics, confirming the benefits of self-evolution.
summary_zh: 现有法律检索智能体直接构建查询，易遗漏潜在法律问题与关键细节，限制了法律判决预测性能。
提出LegalEvolver框架，启发式优化查询作为种子提升轨迹生成效率，并总结经验为评分准则引导多轮自演化。
评分准则引导的强化学习使模型突破初始性能上限，演化准则优于固定准则，验证了自演化与查询优化的有效性。

title: Corralling AI Risks with Grassroots Contracts
title_zh: 用草根契约约束AI风险
abstract: AI's inflection point is a fountain of alarming risks. Digital platforms in particular are vulnerable to three major AI risks, as those in control of global platforms cede control to AI, of the algorithms, of membership and of content: (1) AI control of global platforms, social and economic, used by the majority of humanity, resulting in the majority of humanity becoming vulnerable to AI control. (2) Unaccountable AI agents operating anonymously on social and economic digital platforms, side-by-side with humans, possibly masquerading as humans, serving unknown masters with unknown goals, operating under unknown restraints without accountability or culpability. (3) Unattributed deepfakes generated by anonymous AI, with people unable to distinguish them from genuine content and with their producers evading accountability and culpability. Here, we propose to corral these AI risks with grassroots contracts, a digital incarnation of a two-centuries old notion of Pierre-Joseph Proudhon. We present grassroots contracts for a social graph with accountable AI agents and for a social network with digital provenance, and working smartphone apps that implement the two and show how they corral these major AI risks: (1) AI control of global platforms. (2) Unaccountable AI agents. (3) Unattributed deepfakes.
summary_zh: 数字平台面临三大AI风险：AI控制平台、匿名且不可问责的AI agent，以及无法溯源的深度伪造。
提出基于两百年前Proudhon理念的草根契约，作为约束上述AI风险的数字实现方案。
构建含可问责AI agent的社会图与含数字溯源的社交网络，并开发手机应用验证其能有效约束三大风险。

title: Give Up to Get More: Priors, Not Policies, Govern Test-Time Compute Allocation
title_zh: 放弃以求更多：先验而非策略决定测试时算力分配
abstract: When many inputs share a budget of repeated attempts by a large language model (LLM), a common rule gives harder inputs more. On public math, code and formal-proof samples, the best published difficulty-proportional rule captures half or more of the oracle gain on benchmarks the model mostly solves, but at most 13% on hard workloads, even given true pass rates. Because the value of one more attempt peaks at intermediate difficulty, the optimal static allocation is inverted-U and gives little to inputs that are hopeless at the current budget. In a strict survey of 221 LLM allocation papers, at least 13 give the hardest inputs the most attempts; their easier settings sit at budgets where this is near-optimal, so the cost appears on harder workloads. Acting on it requires knowing which inputs are solvable, so information, not the policy, drives the gain. With a verifier and a prior from a related model's past runs on the same inputs, Thompson Sampling raises the solved share on the hardest workload from 14% to 27%; without such a prior, no policy we tested beats round-robin. For the policies we tested, the gain vanishes between prior rank correlations of about 0.3 and 0.55, which cheap text-based priors barely reach on the weakest models, and it requires a verifier whose false acceptances are rare relative to the pass rate. On new Qwen2.5 samples the pattern holds, and tempering the prior avoids losses on easy workloads. We turn these results into a decision guide.
summary_zh: 问题：传统按难度分配LLM重试预算的规则在困难任务上收益极低，最多仅达oracle增益的13%。
方法：最优静态分配呈倒U型，应放弃当前预算下无望的输入；采用Thompson Sampling结合相关模型先验进行分配。
结论：算力分配增益由先验信息而非策略驱动；有先验时Thompson Sampling将最难任务解决率从14%提至27%，无先验时无策略优于轮询。
comment: 36 pages, 6 figures. Code, results and survey coding: https://github.com/nepersoned/priors-not-policies

title: Traffic-VL: Reinforced Vision-Language Models for Generalizable End-to-End Traffic Signal Control
title_zh: Traffic-VL：面向通用端到端交通信号控制的强化视觉语言模型
abstract: Existing traffic signal control methods typically rely on structured traffic states produced by dedicated perception pipelines. Emerging visual approaches often use idealized simulator images and convert them into intermediate representations before control, limiting their ability to directly exploit roadside visual observations. To bridge both the visual-domain and perception-to-decision gaps, we introduce SynTra-V and Traffic-VL. SynTra-V converts physics-based traffic simulations into photorealistic multi-view surveillance imagery across diverse road topologies and sensing conditions, and automatic semantic auditing checks that control-critical geometry, vehicle movements, and lane semantics match the simulator state. Traffic-VL is an eight-billion-parameter vision-language model that directly maps synchronized multi-view images and natural-language phase descriptions to signal decisions without intermediate structured states. Building on Traffic-R1's two-stage reinforced reasoning framework, Traffic-VL adapts its vision encoder via offline reinforcement learning on SynTra-V and freezes it during online visual stepwise trajectory policy optimization in closed-loop simulation. Experiments show that Traffic-VL matches structured-state Traffic-R1 while outperforming image-based controllers and general-purpose vision-language models, including Gemini 3 Pro. Evaluations on unseen topologies, degraded sensing conditions, real surveillance footage, and a three-week deployment across ten intersections further demonstrate robust visual generalization and effective constrained online control.
summary_zh: 现有视觉交通信号控制方法依赖理想化图像与中间表示，难以直接利用路侧视觉观测，存在视觉域与感知决策鸿沟。
提出SynTra-V生成多视角真实图像并审计语义一致性，结合Traffic-VL直接将多视角图像与文本映射为信号决策。
实验表明Traffic-VL性能媲美结构化方法，优于图像控制器及通用VLM，并在未见拓扑、真实视频与实际部署中展现强泛化性。

title: EvoCodeAgent: Project-Level Code Generation via Architecture-Code Co-Evolution and Experience-Guided Repair
title_zh: EvoCodeAgent：基于架构-代码协同演化与经验引导修复的项目级代码生成
abstract: Project-level code generation aims to automatically synthesize complete software repositories from high-level requirements, producing coherent multi-file systems with well-structured modules and consistent cross-file dependencies. Despite the strong capabilities of large language models (LLMs) in specification understanding and code synthesis, existing approaches still exhibit several critical limitations. First, many methods rely on static architectural designs that cannot adapt during iterative generation, leading to a growing misalignment between architecture and implementation. Second, they lack mechanisms to accumulate and reuse experience across iterations, resulting in recurring errors and reduced efficiency. Third, they often depend on standalone LLM-based evaluation of intermediate artifacts, which suffer from limited transparency and potential unreliability under long-context reasoning. To address these challenges, we propose EvoCodeAgent, a state-centric framework for project-level code generation. EvoCodeAgent maintains an evolving architectural state initialized from structured project specifications and continuously reconciles predicted relations from architecture and skeletons with realized relations extracted from generated code. It further uses tool-grounded verification evidence to support reliable state updates and abstracts reusable repair experiences from previous revision attempts to guide subsequent generation. Extensive experiments on project-level benchmarks of different scales, including DevBench and CodeProjectEval, demonstrate that EvoCodeAgent consistently outperforms baseline approaches. Under the GPT-5 setting, it achieves unit test pass rates of 60.48% and 27.73%, respectively, yielding up to a 53.5% improvement over the strongest baseline.
summary_zh: 现有项目级代码生成存在架构与实现失准、缺乏经验复用及评估不可靠的问题，提出EvoCodeAgent框架。
该框架维护动态演化的架构状态，持续对齐预测与已生成代码的实际关系，并使用工具验证保障状态更新。
抽象可复用的修复经验指导后续生成，实验表明在GPT-5下单元测试通过率最高提升53.5%，优于基线。

title: Beyond Scene Shortcuts: Action-Centric Video-Text Alignment for Fine-Grained Action Understanding
title_zh: 超越场景捷径：面向细粒度动作理解的动作中心视频文本对齐
abstract: Fine-grained action understanding requires vision-language models to ground what an agent does, how it acts, and why it acts in spatio-temporal evidence. However, richer supervision can backfire: fine-tuned models may generate detailed action descriptions grounded in static scenes and salient objects rather than motion, a failure we call Environment-Grounded Action Hallucination (EGAH). To mitigate EGAH, we propose Staged Attention Rectification and Reinforcement (STARR), an action-centric video-text alignment framework that breaks scene-action shortcuts through Action-Environment Dissociation and reinforces action-focused grounding with an Attention Consistency Reward within Group Relative Policy Optimization. We further construct FineActionR&R, combining temporally localized captions with hierarchical and temporal-causal reasoning data. Built on Qwen2.5-VL-7B, FineActionVLM-R1 improves average MotionBench accuracy by 3.01 percentage points over its base model and achieves 91.50% on HAU-MCQ-Bench. Qualitative comparisons further indicate more faithful fine-grained action descriptions with fewer environment-induced hallucinations.
summary_zh: 细粒度动作理解中，微调模型易依赖静态场景生成描述，导致环境诱发动作幻觉（EGAH）。
提出STARR框架，通过动作-环境解耦打破场景捷径，并用注意力一致性奖励强化动作聚焦。
构建FineActionR&R数据集，基于此训练的模型在MotionBench提升3.01个百分点，有效减少幻觉。

title: A.S.E 2.0: Understanding How Repository Context Impacts the Security of LLM-Generated Code
title_zh: A.S.E 2.0：探究仓库上下文对LLM生成代码安全性的影响
abstract: Large language model (LLM) coding assistants and agents construct a repository context before generating code. For security-sensitive code, this context decides whether the model sees the project's safeguards (e.g., authorization checks) or insecure code to imitate. However, context construction is designed almost exclusively for functional correctness, and secure-code benchmarks treat the context as fixed, so how repository context affects the security of generated code remains unclear. We construct CASE-Bench, a benchmark of 145 repository-level tasks from real CVEs in 51 projects. Each task runs in Docker, has functional tests and a proof-of-concept exploit validated in both directions, and is annotated with the repository code that enforces or undermines its security. Using CASE-Bench, we compare 13 context construction methods and six controls with six LLMs, edit single context elements, and analyze coding-agent trajectories. We find that (1) functionality-oriented context raises the functional pass rate by up to 8.2 percentage points (pp) but the secure pass rate by at most 3.7 pp, (2) withholding a safeguard lowers the secure pass rate by up to 8.1 pp, while one inserted insecure exemplar raises correct-but-exploitable code by 6.3 pp, and (3) coding agents observe the relevant safeguard in only 27-36% of trajectories. These findings inform security-aware context construction and secure-code evaluation.
summary_zh: 现有LLM代码助手的仓库上下文构建仅关注功能正确性，其对生成代码安全性的影响尚不明确。
构建CASE-Bench基准，包含145个真实CVE任务，对比13种上下文构建方法与6个LLM。
发现功能导向上下文对安全提升有限；移除防护或引入不安全示例均显著降低代码安全性。

title: MonoLaDN: Language-Guided DeNoising for Monocular 3D Object Detection
title_zh: MonoLaDN：面向单目3D目标检测的语言引导去噪
abstract: Monocular 3D object detection offers a low-cost route to 3D perception, but it remains fundamentally ill-posed, since depth must be inferred from a single view. Recent transformer-based detectors learn geometry purely from image features and 3D box annotations, lacking the high-level semantic priors that vision-language models (VLMs) acquire from large-scale pretraining. VLMs offer such priors, but deploying one directly as a detector is impractical due to its heavy inference cost. We propose MonoLaDN, a language-guided denoising framework that transfers the geometric reasoning of a VLM into a monocular 3D detector while keeping the deployed model purely vision-based. During training, a frozen VLM produces structured reasoning about each object's occlusion, depth, dimension, and angle from the image and its ground-truth boxes. We encode this reasoning into queries, perturb them with noise, and train the detector to reconstruct the clean reasoning. Reconstructing the corrupted reasoning forces the detector's depth-guided features to internalize the VLM's geometric priors, so this knowledge remains available even after the reasoning path is discarded at inference, adding no latency or parameters to the deployed model. Experiments on KITTI 3D and nuScenes show that MonoLaDN consistently outperforms state-of-the-art detectors and generalizes well to new domains.
summary_zh: 单目3D检测因深度推断不适定而困难，现有方法缺乏VLM的高层语义先验，且直接部署VLM推理成本过高。
提出MonoLaDN框架，训练时用冻结VLM生成结构化几何推理，对其加噪并训练检测器重建，以转移VLM先验。
该方法使纯视觉检测器内化几何先验，推理时无额外延迟与参数，在KITTI和nuScenes上优于SOTA且泛化性强。

title: CLEAR: Structured Specifications for Controllable Long-Horizon ML Research Engineering
title_zh: CLEAR：可控长周期机器学习研究工程的结构化规范
abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly being used to automate machine learning (ML) research workflows, ranging from code development and experiment execution to research reproduction and scientific discovery. Recent systems demonstrate that LLMs can perform substantial portions of ML research engineering with limited human intervention. These advances suggest a shift from automating individual research tasks toward automating long-horizon workflows that transform research artifacts into executable ML systems. However, ML research engineering remains substantially more difficult than isolated code generation. A research artifact typically specifies a system only implicitly through a mixture of natural-language descriptions, equations, pseudo-code, implementation details, datasets, and evaluation protocols. An agent must first infer the intended computational structure, translate it into executable components, coordinate their dependencies, and repeatedly diagnose and repair failures during execution. Consequently, the quality of the final system depends not only on code generation, but also on whether the agent can maintain a consistent representation of what should be implemented throughout this long-horizon process.
summary_zh: 【问题】LLM agent 自动化 ML 研究时，需从隐式规范推断计算结构并协调依赖，长周期流程极易失败。
【方法】提出 CLEAR 规范，将隐式研究产物转化为结构化规范，以显式定义系统的计算结构与组件。
【结论】结构化规范使 agent 在长周期工程中维持一致的实现表示，从而提升最终系统的质量与可控性。

title: A Systematic Benchmark for Evaluating Multimodal Personalized Reasoning of Vision-Language Models
title_zh: 视觉语言模型多模态个性化推理系统评测基准
abstract: People often make decisions by holistically reasoning over heterogeneous forms of personal information. In this paper, we study the relatively underexplored capability of multimodal personalized reasoning in multimodal large language models (MLLMs). To this end, we introduce \texttt{MPRBench}, a novel and comprehensive benchmark specifically designed to evaluate personalized reasoning across a wide range of tasks and real-world challenges. \texttt{MPRBench} consists of 12 sub-tasks and additionally supports interpretable analysis of representative error cases. Through extensive experiments, we find that current personalized MLLMs still struggle with personalized reasoning due to several key challenges, including inaccurate recognition of personalized concepts and sensitivity to irrelevant personal information. We hope that MPRBench will stimulate further research on personalized reasoning in MLLMs. Code and data are available at https://github.com/kkdh15/MPRBench
summary_zh: 现有研究对MLLMs的多模态个性化推理能力探索不足，提出MPRBench基准以系统评估该能力。
MPRBench包含12个子任务，并支持对代表性错误案例进行可解释性分析。
实验发现当前个性化MLLMs仍面临个性化概念识别不准及对无关信息敏感等挑战。

title: Analysis of Local Open-Weight LLM Agents on Vulnerability-Reproduction Tasks
title_zh: 本地开源权重LLM代理在漏洞复现任务上的分析
abstract: Open-weight language models that fit on a single consumer GPU are becoming capable on a growing range of tasks, and they matter because they can run locally without sending the code to a hosted service. Vulnerability reproduction, turning a vulnerability description into an input that crashes the vulnerable build, is a natural target for them, since it is an automated analysis task closer to test generation than to code comprehension and it runs against a build that must be executed rather than read. In order to assess whether current models can perform it, we evaluate twelve configurations of local models, spanning three generations, two architectures and three quantization levels, on ten CyberGym vulnerability-reproduction tasks, three runs each under one harness, and release the full artefact. We show that every configuration, down to the 4B model, solves most of the six easier tasks, and configurations separate only on the remaining four. For the harder tasks, the 27B model is required. Quantization did not change what the models solved in any matched pair, but it changed how fast they got there, and the mixture of experts reached the same scores in less wall clock. We also examine the agent trajectories. Almost every run we examined, including those that fail, names the vulnerable function and states the correct hypothesis, and what separates a solved task from an unsolved one is whether that hypothesis becomes a working input.
summary_zh: 漏洞复现需将描述转为崩溃输入，适合本地LLM执行，需评估其在此任务上的能力。
评估12种本地模型配置在10个漏洞复现任务上的表现，发现4B模型可解简单任务，27B模型为硬任务所需。
量化不影响解决范围但影响速度；失败用例多能定位漏洞函数，成败关键在于能否生成有效输入。
comment: 35 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Preprint of a manuscript under review at the Journal of Systems and Software (Elsevier). Artefact: https://doi.org/10.57967/hf/10888

title: HarnessFlow: MCTS-Guided Harness Optimization for LLM Agents
title_zh: HarnessFlow：面向LLM Agent的MCTS引导Harness优化
abstract: The performance of large language model (LLM) agents depends on both the underlying model and the harness that governs interaction with tools and the environment. Yet harness design remains largely manual, and automating it requires navigating an open-ended search space through costly end-to-end evaluations. We introduce HarnessFlow, a framework for optimizing complete executable harnesses under a limited candidate-evaluation budget, with the model and task environment held fixed. HarnessFlow organizes candidates and their evaluation histories in a refinement tree, using a Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS)-based policy to balance exploitation and exploration. A coding agent refines selected harnesses using archived code, execution feedback, and a library of reusable harness mechanisms. With 15 refinement attempts per benchmark, HarnessFlow achieves the highest mean test scores among the compared methods on six benchmarks spanning agentic tasks, coding, and web interaction. The optimized harnesses achieve an average score of 69.48%, outperforming the initial harnesses and Meta-Harness by 10.89 and 3.95 percentage points, respectively, while incurring lower average per-task execution costs than hand-engineered baselines. These results suggest that structured harness search offers a promising route toward automating the design of capable and efficient LLM agents.
summary_zh: LLM Agent性能依赖Harness设计，但现有设计多依赖人工，且自动优化面临搜索空间大、评估成本高的问题。
提出HarnessFlow框架，在有限评估预算下优化可执行Harness，利用MCTS策略平衡探索与利用，并让编码Agent结合执行反馈进行迭代精炼。
在6个基准测试中，优化后的Harness平均得分69.48%，显著优于初始Harness和Meta-Harness，且执行成本更低，验证了结构化搜索的有效性。

title: A Definition of Catastrophic Performance
title_zh: 灾难性性能的形式化定义
abstract: A central challenge in AI is specifying objectives that align with human preferences. While existing theoretical results elucidate how misspecification impacts performance, they typically do not distinguish between merely suboptimal and catastrophic outcomes. To enable rigorous analysis of catastrophic risk from AI misalignment, we introduce a formal definition of catastrophic performance. Our definition is based on two reference values. The first, baseline value, captures the value attained if no agent is deployed. The second, orthogonal value, captures the value of a trajectory that is unrelated to human preferences, in a sense we describe. Orthogonal value is typically far worse than baseline value. We interpret these reference values through examples in which past human activity has altered the state of the environment to human benefit. Starting at the resulting state, an AI agent is deployed with the goal of accelerating further progress. Catastrophic performance represents this agent's undoing of benefits afforded by human activity.
summary_zh: 现有AI目标误设理论未区分次优与灾难性结果，难以严格分析AI失准的灾难性风险。
基于基线值（无智能体部署时的价值）和正交值（与人类偏好无关的轨迹价值）两个参考值，提出灾难性性能的形式化定义。
该定义将灾难性性能解释为智能体撤销了过往人类活动所带来的环境收益，为分析AI失准风险提供严格基础。

title: Executable Specifications in Transition Algebra
title_zh: 变迁代数中的可执行规约
abstract: Transition Algebra can be viewed as an extension of many-sorted first-order logic by borrowing essential features from dynamic logic. This leads us to new, more expressive sentences that include transitions labelled with actions, which are built from terms using union, composition, and iteration operators. We define a suitable notion of Horn clause, develop a system of proof rules for reasoning about clauses, and subsequently show that the proof system is sound and complete. We then introduce a rewriting relation based on Horn clauses, capturing transitions along established paths expressed as actions. This rewriting relation is naturally extended to a narrowing procedure for solving queries, thereby laying foundation for logic programming in Transition Algebra. As usual, soundness for both rewriting and narrowing is straightforward, whereas completeness requires additional conditions. Finally, we provide a prototype tool that demonstrates the practical aspects and shows the effectiveness of the proposed method.
summary_zh: 为扩展多类别一阶逻辑的表达能力，引入变迁代数并定义包含动作标记变迁的新句子与Horn子句。
针对该子句提出证明规则系统，证明其具备可靠性与完备性，并基于此定义捕获既定路径变迁的重写关系。
将重写关系扩展为求解查询的narrowing过程，奠定逻辑编程基础，并提供原型工具验证方法有效性。

title: CoSafe: Cooperative Runtime Safety Assurance for Mixed-Traffic Autonomous Driving
title_zh: CoSafe：面向混合交通自动驾驶的协同运行时安全保障
abstract: With the rapid development of autonomous driving systems (ADSes), real-world roads are evolving into mixed-traffic environments where autonomous vehicles (AVs) and other traffic participants (e.g., human-driven vehicles (HDVs), cyclists, and pedestrians) coexist and interact with each other. However, current ADSes still incur various safety violations in mixed traffic scenarios, raising a strong demand for runtime safety assurance frameworks that can continuously monitor hazards and prevent potential violations. Existing ego-centric assurance approaches are insufficient for mixed traffic, where violations often arise from locally reasonable yet jointly incompatible decisions among multiple vehicles and cannot be reliably resolved through independent takeover. To bridge this gap, we propose CoSafe, a modular and ADS-agnostic cooperative runtime safety assurance framework for mixed-traffic autonomous driving to extend runtime safety assurance from ego-centric takeover to scene-level cooperative intervention. CoSafe leverages vehicle-to-everything (V2X) communication to enable roadside units (RSUs) to monitor scene-level hazards and jointly mitigate hazards involving multiple vehicles. We integrate CoSafe with seven state-of-the-art ADSes, and our evaluation on the InterDrive benchmark demonstrates that CoSafe improves the driving score of AVs by 70.03% on average, reduces safety violations by 87.80%, and accurately identifies unsafe AVs with an F3 score of 0.930, while satisfying real-time constraints.
summary_zh: 混合交通中现有自动驾驶系统频发安全违规，且以自我为中心的独立接管无法解决多车决策冲突。
提出CoSafe框架，利用V2X通信让路侧单元监控场景级危险，实现多车协同干预。
在InterDrive基准上集成7种ADS评估，驾驶得分提升70.03%，违规减少87.80%，且满足实时约束。
comment: Accepted by the 49th IEEE/ACM International Conference on Software Engineering (ICSE 2027). 13 pages

title: Annotator-Free Object Detection via Foundation Model Collaboration
title_zh: 基于基础模型协作的无标注目标检测
abstract: Object detection research remains constrained by high annotation costs and the closed-set assumptions of supervised models, limiting scalability to novel categories. We present a target-dataset annotation-free object detection framework that eliminates the need for human labeling on the target dataset by leveraging the complementary strengths of pretrained foundation models, including segmentation and vision-language systems, combined with a self-refining training loop. To further reduce reliance on expensive LVLM queries, we introduce a landmark-based clustering mechanism that amortizes labeling across image clusters, improving label consistency while lowering computational cost. Our method autonomously generates segmentation proposals, assigns semantic labels through multimodal reasoning, and iteratively improves both localization and classification using a lightweight open-set detector. This modular pipeline enables adaptation to completely unseen object classes and domains without any human-provided target-dataset annotations, while maintaining compatibility with existing detection architectures. Evaluations on COCO, LVIS, ODinW-35, and Roboflow-100 demonstrate substantial performance gains over state-of-the-art open-vocabulary and long-tail detection methods, achieving 60.8 AP on COCO and 47.4 AP on LVIS under zero-shot settings. Beyond strong benchmark results, our approach provides a scalable foundation for real-world detection systems in unknown environments, where annotation is infeasible.
summary_zh: 目标检测受制于标注成本高及闭集假设，提出利用预训练基础模型协作的无标注检测框架以解决该问题。
该方法结合分割与视觉语言模型生成伪标签，并引入基于地标的聚类机制降低LVLM查询开销与提升标签一致性。
经轻量级开放集检测器自迭代优化，在COCO等基准零样本设置下大幅超越现有方法，实现60.8 AP。

title: Chiron: Cache Management Empowered by LLM Intelligence for AI Workloads
title_zh: Chiron：基于LLM智能的AI负载缓存管理系统
abstract: AI clusters keep data in remote object stores and rely on local caches to stop GPUs from waiting for data. A cache performs well only when its prefetching and eviction policies match the access pattern, yet these patterns differ across AI workloads and change between phases of one workflow. Existing methods either need code changes, which compromises user transparency, or use low-end heuristics, which cannot follow such changes. Large language models (LLMs) can infer access behavior without user hints, but direct LLM control of cache actions suffers from long reasoning delay, high token cost, and poor decision quality. We present Chiron, a cache system based on advisory switching control. An LLM asynchronously diagnoses the access pattern and recommends a policy. A deterministic harness gates this advice, executes expert-designed policies locally, and returns cache feedback for review. We implement Chiron atop JuiceFS and evaluate it on nine AI workloads. It reduces job completion time by 14.3-41.2% over the best baseline on popular AI workloads.
summary_zh: AI集群缓存策略需匹配多变的访问模式，现有方法需改代码或启发式差，直接用LLM控制则延迟高且成本大。
提出Chiron缓存系统，采用咨询切换控制：LLM异步诊断访问模式并推荐策略，确定性执行器门控并执行专家策略。
在九个AI负载上评估，Chiron相较于最优基线，将作业完成时间降低了14.3%至41.2%。

title: AssameseLM-E2B: An Open-Weight Assamese Language Model for Efficient Consumer-Grade Deployment
title_zh: 面向消费级设备的高效阿萨姆语开源模型
abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) excel in high-resource languages, their performance often degrades in low-resource languages due to tokenization inefficiencies, generative instability, and linguistic interference. This paper presents AssameseLM-E2B and its instruction-tuned variant, AssameseLM-E2B-it, a 2-billion-parameter model adapted specifically for low resource Assamese language. Built upon the Gemma-4 architecture, the model incorporates an expanded byte-level BPE vocabulary to reduce tokenization overhead by nearly 500% compared with multilingual 2B--3B baselines. We employ a parameter-efficient Continual Pre-Training (CPT) pipeline with Hybrid LoRA, followed by Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) on a balanced, multi-domain dataset to enhance instruction-following and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) capabilities. Evaluation demonstrates a Bits-per-Byte (BPB) score of 0.7488 on FLORES-200, alongside an overall RAG score of 96.7% and 100% refusal accuracy on adversarial unanswerable prompts. Comparative analysis reveals significant limitations in general-purpose baselines, including receptive-productive decoupling, generative degradation on Romanized Assamese, and unintended Bengali script assimilation. These results demonstrate the potential of parameter-efficient adaptation for developing capable, locally deployable language models for low-resource languages under constrained computational resources.
summary_zh: 低资源语言LLM存在分词低效与生成不稳定问题，本文提出专为阿萨姆语定制的20亿参数模型AssameseLM-E2B。
采用扩展字节级BPE词表降低分词开销，结合Hybrid LoRA持续预训练与SFT，提升指令遵循与RAG能力。
模型在FLORES-200上BPB达0.7488，RAG得分96.7%，证明了参数高效适配在低资源语言本地部署的潜力。

title: Reasoning-Aware Cross-Modal Association Unlearning in Multimodal Large Reasoning Models
title_zh: 多模态大推理模型中推理感知的跨模态关联遗忘
abstract: Multimodal large reasoning models (MLRMs) integrate visual inputs with textual and parametric knowledge, allowing sensitive information to be accessed through cross-modal associations during reasoning. This raises privacy concerns when a visual input should no longer provide access to such information. Machine unlearning can remove this influence without retraining the model from scratch. However, multimodal unlearning methods mainly target samples, concepts, or knowledge content, without separating the knowledge from the cross-modal association through which it is accessed. In reasoning models, target information may disappear from the final answer while remaining in intermediate reasoning, or be replaced by incorrect substitute knowledge. We therefore study cross-modal association unlearning, where the forget target is a designated visual-to-knowledge association: the model should suppress target-bearing behavior under the designated visual context while preserving access to the same knowledge in permitted contexts. We propose Visual-Keyed Counterfactual Rebinding (VKCR), a parameter-efficient framework for cross-modal association editing. VKCR first localizes the edit to a compact association-conditioned parameter subspace. It then reduces support for the designated target at task outputs and counterfactually rebinds the affected reasoning behavior by discouraging target-bearing or unsupported continuations while favoring valid non-sensitive alternatives. We further introduce CLEAR-R and MLLMU-R to evaluate target leakage, hallucinated reassociation, reasoning preservation, and modality-specific utility. Experiments show that VKCR substantially reduces image-conditioned target leakage and hallucinated reassociation, including across heterogeneous task formulations, while preserving non-sensitive visual reasoning and permitted text-only knowledge.
summary_zh: 多模态推理模型存在跨模态关联隐私泄露风险，现有遗忘方法未解耦知识与关联，且易在中间推理残留目标信息。
提出跨模态关联遗忘任务，要求在特定视觉上下文抑制目标行为，同时在允许上下文保留知识访问。
提出参数高效框架VKCR，定位关联子空间并反事实重绑推理行为，有效减少目标泄露与幻觉重关联。

title: A Layered View of LLM Support in Underwater Robotics
title_zh: 水下机器人中LLM支持的分层架构视角
abstract: This extended abstract discusses a specific and, in our experience, practically relevant role for large language models (LLMs) in underwater robotics. Our main premise is that, in underwater fielding missions, the immediate difficulty is often not the synthesis of new low-level control laws, but the operation of complex robotic systems under limited communications, partial observability, and expensive field time. In particular, a significant fraction of the effort during sea trials is devoted to fault diagnosis, telemetry interpretation, mission adjustment, and coordination across heterogeneous assets and operators. We argue that LLMs may be useful at this higher operational level, especially when grounded in structured vehicle state, alarms, logs, mission context, and existing planning or validation tools. At the same time, current limitations in grounding, consistency, and causal reasoning make these systems lack the predictability required to guarantee direct control, especially in real-world critical applications, although we do not exclude a future evolution in this direction. This viewpoint suggests a layered architecture in which conventional autonomy remains responsible for control, perception, estimation, and validated mission execution, whereas LLM-based modules serve as an additional support layer for debugging, operator interaction, constrained replanning support, orchestration, and post-mission analysis.
summary_zh: 水下机器人海试难点常为复杂系统运维而非底层控制，需解决故障诊断与任务调整等问题。
LLM在高层运维（如调试、交互、重规划）中具潜力，但当前因因果推理等局限无法保证直接控制。
提出分层架构：传统模块负责控制与执行，LLM作为辅助层支持调试、交互与任务编排。
comment: Presented at the I-RIM 3D 2026 - Workshop n.30 How would you like intelligence in your robots? Interdisciplinary perspectives on intelligent machines

title: DSRS: Teaching MLLMs to Perceive, Reason, and Segment in Complex Driving Scenes
title_zh: DSRS：教MLLM在复杂驾驶场景中感知、推理与分割
abstract: Existing reasoning segmentation frameworks typically employ multimodal large language models (MLLMs) with broad world knowledge to extract semantics in a human-like manner and generate corresponding segmentation masks. Nevertheless, these frameworks lack the necessary scene-specific awareness. This paper introduces driving scene reasoning segmentation (DSRS), a scene-specific task that requires models to interpret implicit instructions, infer spatial relations, detect potential risks, handle challenging conditions, and comprehend underlying traffic rules, ultimately generating accurate segmentation masks. Meanwhile, we establish a benchmark dataset to facilitate future research on the DSRS task. To pioneer this task, we propose DSRS-Net, a novel architecture with advanced reasoning segmentation capability for automated driving. Specifically, DSRS-Net seamlessly infuses geometric features for deeper reasoning segmentation, without compromising the original multimodal fusion mechanism. This strategy effectively mitigates the modality representation mismatch in MLLMs caused by RGB-only pretraining, while enhancing the integration of geometric, contextual, and linguistic features. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superior performance of DSRS-Net in both driving scene reasoning segmentation and other language-driven segmentation tasks across various public datasets. The source code and dataset will be released upon publication.
summary_zh: 现有推理分割框架缺乏场景感知能力，难以应对复杂驾驶场景的隐式指令与空间关系等挑战。
提出驾驶场景推理分割任务及DSRS-Net架构，通过无缝注入几何特征以深化推理分割。
该方法有效缓解MLLM模态表示失配，增强特征融合，在多项公开数据集上取得优越性能。

title: Measurements of isolated photon pair production in association with jets in pp collisions at $\sqrt{s}$ = 8 TeV with the ATLAS detector
title_zh: ATLAS探测器测量8 TeV质子对撞中双光子与喷注的产生
abstract: Measurements of integrated and differential production cross section of two isolated photons in events with and without associated hadronic jets based on the 2012 dataset of 20.3 fb$^{-1}$ integrated luminosity of proton-proton collisions at $\sqrt{s}=8$ TeV collected by the ATLAS experiment are presented. The measurements consider photons with pseudorapidities of $|η^γ|<1.37$ or $1.56<|η^γ|<2.37$ and transverse energy of $E_{T}^γ>22$ GeV. Jets are required to have $p_{T}^{j}>25$ GeV for $|η^{j}|<2.4$ and $p_{T}^{j}>50$ GeV for $2.4<|η^{j}|<4.4$. Events are classified into categories based on the number of jets and integrated fiducial cross sections of diphoton production in association with inclusive and exclusive number of jets are presented. Fiducial cross sections, differential in sixteen diphoton, jet, dijet and photon-jet observables, are presented and compared with leading-order Sherpa 1.4.1 predictions in all jet categories, fixed-order next-to-leading-order GoSam and BlackHat calculations in selected categories, and NLO-matched predictions from Sherpa 2.2.14 in all categories. Overall, the NLO predictions provide a reasonable description of the data, with significant discrepancies observed for increasing jet multiplicity, particularly for angular variables, attributable to the absence of higher-order terms in the calculations. The Sherpa 2.2.14 NLO-matched predictions provide the best overall description of the data across all jet categories and observables.
summary_zh: 【问题】缺乏双孤立光子与喷注联合产生的精确截面数据【方法】基于ATLAS 2012年8 TeV质子对撞数据测量积分与微分截面【结论】提供了含不同喷注数目的双光子产生截面测量结果
【问题】需检验不同阶次QCD计算对双光子加喷注过程的描述能力【方法】将16种可观测量截面与Sherpa、GoSam及BlackHat等LO和NLO预测对比【结论】NLO预测整体合理，但随喷注数增加及角变量出现显著偏差
【问题】寻找对实验数据描述最佳的理论预测【方法】对比各类预测与实测截面【结论】Sherpa 2.2.14的NLO匹配预测在所有喷注类别和可观测量上对数据描述最佳
comment: 56 pages in total, author list starting page 39, 17 figures, 4 tables, submitted to Phys. Rev. D. All figures including auxiliary figures are available at https://atlas.web.cern.ch/Atlas/GROUPS/PHYSICS/PAPERS/STDM-2016-12/

title: KVGuard: A KV Cache Safety Checker for LLM Serving Systems
title_zh: KVGuard：面向LLM服务系统的KV缓存安全检查器
abstract: Modern LLM serving systems manage the KV cache through PagedAttention, a custom GPU allocator that partitions a single CUDA-allocated region into fixed-size physical blocks and maps each request to those blocks through a CPU-built block table. This block-based design exposes a previously unstudied class of memory safety bugs in the KV cache, including double-free, use-after-free, out-of-bounds access, uninitialized read, and permission violation, which silently corrupt outputs or break request isolation without ever crashing the system. Existing memory sanitizers cannot detect them, because they reason about CUDA-level addresses rather than KV cache blocks, requests, and block tables, and their redzone- and quarantine-based designs do not fit the scarce GPU memory budget of LLM serving. This paper presents KVGuard, the first systematic memory-safety abstraction for KV cache management in LLM serving systems. KVGuard maintains a compact shadow block for each physical KV block, recording per-request permission and per-entry initialization, and uses this metadata to perform five safety checks across the PagedAttention workflow, spanning CPU allocation, block table construction and translation, and GPU-side block table lookup and KV entry access. Each check fires at the boundary that introduced the violation, enabling early detection during development rather than reporting downstream output corruption many requests later. A prototype of KVGuard on vLLM and SGLang covers all 29 historical real-world KV cache safety bugs collected from the two systems' patch histories. KVGuard further found 8 previously unknown safety violations while reporting no false positives. It adds 3.0% and 7.4% geomean TPOT overhead on Qwen 2.5 14B on vLLM and SGLang and at most 0.11% of the KV cache in memory overhead, two orders of magnitude below NVIDIA Compute Sanitizer on the same workloads.
summary_zh: LLM服务系统的KV缓存存在未知的内存安全漏洞，现有检查器无法检测且不适用于GPU显存受限场景。
提出KVGuard，为KV缓存管理建立首个系统化内存安全抽象，通过紧凑影子块记录权限与初始化状态。
在vLLM和SGLang上实现原型，覆盖全部29个历史漏洞，发现8个新漏洞且无误报，开销极低。

title: SBVUL: Statement-Based Vulnerability Detection
title_zh: SBVUL：基于语句的漏洞检测方法
abstract: Many recent approaches for vulnerability detection use large language models (LLMs) to classify functions as vulnerable or benign, leaving developers to locate the exploitable statements. Furthermore, while these approaches have shown performance improvements, they still fall short in distinguishing vulnerable from patched real-world functions. This paper presents SBVul, an agentic approach that detects exploitable statements in C/C++ functions. In Phase~1, an LLM agent explores the function and its repository and identifies candidate statements. In Phase~2, a second agent analyzes the control and data flow of each candidate and confirms it, rules it out, or marks it uncertain. We created a manually verified ground truth of exploitable statements for 200 pairs of the PrimeVul Paired test set and ran SBVul with the open-weight models Qwen 3.8 and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and Anthropic's Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5. Phase~1 identifies ground-truth statements in 56--77% of the vulnerable functions, and Phase~2 confirms such a statement with an explanation accepted by an LLM judge in 26--73%. However, all models also confirm candidates in 23--61% of the patched functions. Across vulnerable and patched functions, the highest statement-level precision is 0.315 at a recall of 0.605 obtained with Opus 5.5 (xhigh). At the function level, SBVul with Opus 5.5 classifies 42.0% of the pairs correctly, compared with 33.8% reported for the best previous approach.
summary_zh: 现有LLM漏洞检测仅分类函数，需人工定位漏洞语句，且难以区分真实与已修补函数。
提出SBVul智能体方法：阶段1探索代码定位候选语句，阶段2分析控制与数据流确认漏洞。
在函数级分类上，SBVul准确率达42.0%，优于先前最优的33.8%，但语句级精度仍有限。

title: ModalSearcher: Weaving Visual Evidence into Autonomous Cross-Modal Deep Search
title_zh: ModalSearcher：将视觉证据融入自主跨模态深度搜索
abstract: Static and incomplete parametric knowledge limits the performance of multimodal large language models on novel-knowledge and knowledge-intensive tasks, especially those requiring multi-hop evidence acquisition. Existing multimodal agentic search methods often fix visual evidence at the input or a predefined trajectory position, making it difficult for agents to select search modalities as their information needs evolve and to handle complex real-world queries. We define this capability as autonomous cross-modal search: an agent chooses among direct reasoning, text-to-text search, text-to-image search, and reverse-image search, actively introduces visual evidence when appropriate, and switches between and integrates modalities across multiple hops. We propose ModalSearch-Pipeline, a scalable procedure for constructing an interleaved multimodal knowledge graph. It samples paths with diverse depths and modality compositions and uses backward question construction to obscure entity names and image targets that would expose reasoning shortcuts while retaining necessary disambiguating clues, yielding text-only, image-initialized, and arbitrarily interleaved multi-hop problems. We train the ModalSearcher Agent with supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning in a live Web environment, and construct ModalSearch-Bench. Experiments show that ModalSearcher-8B improves average accuracy by 16.2 points over Qwen3-VL-8B under the same agentic workflow across five multimodal knowledge-intensive QA benchmarks, with consistent gains on independently constructed active visual-search benchmarks.
summary_zh: 多模态LLM受限于静态知识，且现有搜索方法固定视觉证据位置，难以应对复杂多跳查询。
提出ModalSearch-Pipeline构建交错多模态知识图谱，生成多样化多跳问题以训练智能体。
经SFT与RL训练的ModalSearcher-8B在五个QA基准上较基座模型平均准确率提升16.2点。

title: ReactWorld: Structuring Interaction Responses for Embodied Video Generation
title_zh: ReactWorld：面向具身视频生成的结构化交互响应
abstract: Embodied video world models predict scene changes caused by robot actions, yet generated object responses may remain inconsistent with task intent and contact dynamics. Critical responses in embodied scenes often concentrate in local regions and specific time intervals. Inspired by chain-of-thought reasoning, we introduce ReactWorld, an embodied video generation model guided by structured interaction anticipation. In the generation backbone's feature space, an interaction response field predictor anticipates how the interaction will unfold, explicitly describing participant roles, future motion response intensity, and local motion changes. A response feedback adapter forms increments to object features from the difference between the object branch's outputs with predicted and zeroed local dynamics inputs. It also converts predicted displacements into positional biases for temporal attention. These two mechanisms guide object feature updates and information retrieval across frames, respectively. Through interaction anticipation and generative feedback, ReactWorld achieves an average score of 77.51 on RBench, outperforming PhysisForcing by 3.29 points with improvements in all nine categories. On EZS-Bench, it achieves a Domain score of 86.98 and an average score of 81.87.
summary_zh: 具身视频世界模型生成的物体响应易与任务意图和接触动力学不一致，且关键响应常集中于局部时空区域。
提出ReactWorld模型，通过交互响应场预测器显式预测参与者角色、运动响应强度及局部变化，并引入响应反馈适配器修正特征与注意力。
在RBench和EZS-Bench上，ReactWorld分别取得77.51和81.87的平均分，全面超越PhysisForcing，验证了结构化交互预测的有效性。

title: Beyond Risk Cues: A Mechanism-Level Benchmark and Verifiable Debate for Scam Video Detection on the Web
title_zh: 超越风险线索：网络诈骗视频机制级基准与可验证辩论
abstract: Online scam videos pose significant threats to individuals and society. Existing studies primarily focus on binary classification, offering limited insights into how scams work and the reasoning behind detection decisions. Moreover, they often overlook the challenge of distinguishing scam videos from superficially similar non-scam content, such as advertisements, and the robustness of detection models against misleading arguments. These limitations hinder reliable scam video detection. To address these limitations, we introduce MechScam, a benchmark comprising 6,614 videos covering diverse scam mechanisms and non-scam categories. MechScam provides explanations supported by video evidence, annotations of potential scam elements and their context, and misleading arguments constructed from genuine evidence. Recognizing that genuine evidence can still be used to justify misleading conclusions, we further propose ScamCourt, a debate framework in which trained prosecution and defense debaters present opposing arguments, while a trained judge makes decisions based on a transcript with verified citations. Extensive experiments show that state-of-the-art MLLMs struggle to distinguish scam videos from similar non-scam content. ScamCourt outperforms larger MLLMs and same-backbone fine-tuned baselines, reducing false positives and showing stronger resistance to misleading arguments. Together, MechScam and ScamCourt contribute to more reliable and interpretable scam video detection. The dataset and code are available at https://github.com/SuperYFan/MechScam.
summary_zh: 现有诈骗视频检测仅做二分类，难区分相似非诈骗内容且易受误导论证影响，可靠性不足。
提出MechScam基准，包含6614个视频及证据解释，并构建由真实证据支撑的误导论证。
提出ScamCourt辩论框架，通过控辩双方对抗与带引用验证的法官决策，显著降低误报并增强抗误导能力。

title: Learning When to Think Aloud in Latent Reasoning
title_zh: 基于重要性引导的潜在推理显隐转换框架VITAL
abstract: Latent Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning improves efficiency by shifting intermediate computation into continuous hidden states. However, fully latent methods often struggle on precision-critical tasks such as mathematical reasoning, while existing hybrid approaches retain substantial token-generation overhead. We introduce VITAL, an importance-guided hybrid reasoning framework that selectively verbalizes informative tokens as reasoning anchors while keeping most computation latent. A lightweight gating head dynamically selects between explicit token generation and direct hidden-state feedback. VITAL constructs hybrid trajectories from explicit CoT using token- importance estimation and trains the model through curriculum-based supervised training, followed by reinforcement learning with a reward that balances correctness and conciseness. Experiments show that VITAL consistently out- performs existing fully latent reasoning methods, achieving relative average accuracy gains of 9.6% on GPT-2 and 5.1% on Llama-3.2-1B at comparable reasoning lengths. Compared with hybrid baselines, VITAL achieves higher reasoning accuracy with substantially shorter reasoning trajectories on Qwen3-1.7B.
summary_zh: 全潜在推理在精度关键任务上表现不佳，而现有混合方法存在大量生成开销。
提出VITAL框架，通过轻量级门控头动态选择显式生成或隐式反馈，将关键token作为推理锚点显化。
VITAL在相近推理长度下准确率显著提升，且相比混合基线能用更短轨迹实现更高精度。

title: SWEOps-Bench: Evaluating Agents for End-to-End Resolution of Software-Induced Cloud Incidents
title_zh: SWEOps-Bench：评估云事件端到端解决能力的智能体基准
abstract: As autonomous agents advance, the traditional boundary between software development and cloud operations gradually blurs, increasing the need for integrated incident detection, localization, and remediation. Existing benchmarks evaluate isolated diagnostic queries or repository-level program repair, failing to test continuous incident resolution across operational clusters and source repositories. We introduce SWEOps-Bench, an interactive benchmark comprising 55 reproducible incident tasks derived from confirmed historical defects across 16 Kubernetes operator projects. Each task preserves the original software repository and initializes in a healthy cluster before a controlled workload triggers the historical fault. Agents investigate runtime evidence and submit source or configuration repairs through a terminal interface, while the harness builds and deploys the changes within a shared time budget. Evaluation covers stage-wise accuracy, verified recovery, penalized lifecycle latency, and token consumption. Across six agent-model configurations, faulty-state detection ranges from 72.7% to 90.9%, whereas overall recovery ranges from only 14.5% to 52.7%, exposing a substantial gap between recognizing incidents and resolving them end to end. Trajectory analysis further shows that reported diagnosis and final recovery only partially coincide: some tasks achieve verified recovery despite an incorrect reported RCA, while runtime symptom clearance can still fail fix-specific functional verification. SWEOps-Bench establishes a rigorous foundation for evaluating autonomous agents in integrated development and operational environments.
summary_zh: 现有基准仅评估孤立的诊断或修复，缺乏对跨云集群与代码库的连续事件解决能力的测试。
提出SWEOps-Bench，包含55个源自K8s历史缺陷的可复现事件任务，通过终端交互评估智能体的端到端修复。
实验表明智能体故障检测率达90.9%但整体恢复率仅52.7%，揭示了识别事件与端到端解决间的巨大鸿沟。

title: Towards Insight-Centric Data Spaces: Integrating Visual Analytics and Decentralized Data Ecosystems
title_zh: 迈向以洞察为中心的数据空间：整合可视化分析与去中心化数据生态
abstract: Visual analytics and dataspaces address complementary challenges in modern data ecosystems: visual analytics enables interactive exploration and human-centered reasoning over complex data, dataspaces provide decentralized infrastructures for sovereign and collaborative data sharing. Both fields have largely evolved independently, resulting in a gap between data management and data understanding in distributed environments.We explore their intersection and argue that integration is essential for next-generation data ecosystems. Visual analytics acts as a cognitive layer for dataspaces by making data availability, quality, provenance, and exchange processes observable and interpretable, while dataspaces reshape visual analytics by introducing decentralized, heterogeneous, and governed data environments. We illustrate this interplay through a semi-synthetic cultural dataspace scenario analyzing exchange patterns and metadata quality across a federated ecosystem. Based on these insights, we identify key open challenges and outline a vision of insight-centric data spaces, in which data management and analysis are tightly integrated into a unified, human-centered environment.
summary_zh: 可视化分析与数据空间独立发展，导致分布式环境中数据管理与理解脱节。
将可视化分析作为数据空间的认知层，使数据质量与交换过程可观测；数据空间则为其提供去中心化环境。
通过文化数据空间场景验证交互，提出以洞察为中心的数据空间愿景，实现数据管理与分析的统一。

title: Reasoning-Trace Overflow in Code Generation: An Empirical Study of Explicit Reasoning Models
title_zh: 代码生成中的推理轨迹溢出：显式推理模型实证研究
abstract: Explicit reasoning can help language models generate code, but it also introduces a practical risk: the model may spend so much of its output budget reasoning that it never produces usable code. We study this behaviour in relatively small open-weight reasoning models, framing it as reasoning-trace overflow. Across seven models and six code benchmark settings, we measure how much of a fixed 32k-token output budget is spent on reasoning, whether that reasoning improves pass@1, and whether lightweight inference-time controls can mitigate overflow. Our results show that the value of reasoning is highly conditional. Overflow is rare on simpler function-level tasks, but becomes common on harder code-generation benchmarks and for particular model families: on several model--benchmark pairs, more than half of generations exhaust the full 32k-token budget while still reasoning. Most complete overflow is associated with repetitive reasoning loops, although substantial long reasoning also occurs without looping. Disabling reasoning can therefore be competitive for overflow-prone models, simply because it ensures that an answer is produced. At the same time, reasoning remains valuable for stronger models on harder algorithmic and code-understanding tasks. Finally, prompt steering can substantially reduce overflow for some models but is inconsistent, while budgeted transitions provide more direct control and can improve both performance and token efficiency for overflow-prone models. These findings suggest that explicit reasoning should be treated as a controllable resource for code generation, rather than an always-on capability.
summary_zh: 显式推理模型在代码生成中可能耗尽输出预算而未产出代码，本文将此现象定义为推理轨迹溢出并展开实证研究。
在7个模型与6个基准上发现，溢出在简单任务中罕见，但在困难任务及特定模型中频发，多与重复推理循环有关。
轻量级推理时控制（如预算转换）能有效缓解溢出并提升效率，显式推理应作为可控资源而非默认开启能力。

title: SleuthVLM: Do We Really Need Audio-in-Video for Omni Video Understanding?
title_zh: SleuthVLM：全视频理解真的需要音频输入吗？
abstract: Omni models answer questions about videos by jointly processing sampled frames and audio in one turn, with progress driven largely by scaling model size and omni training data. We ask whether a model needs to hear the audio directly at all, and present SleuthVLM, an agent harness built on a VLM that never hears the audio directly: speech will be transcribed into text, and the VLM will sleuth the video on its own without any predefined workflow. On four omni benchmarks with videos up to 90 minutes, SleuthVLM achieves the best average accuracy: \textbf{75.0%}, 2.6 points above Gemini 3.8 Flash, and it also tops the Video-MME-v2 leaderboard with \textbf{77.8%}; with an open-source 27B VLM, it beats all open-source omni models. We draw three findings: SleuthVLM beats a model that glances; hearing is not the bottleneck, agentic ability is; omni understanding needs better agentic ability, not just more omni data for modality alignment. So we provide a simple but effective starting point for doing omni video understanding. Omni understanding needs better agents, not just bigger models that hear.
summary_zh: 现有全视频模型依赖直接处理音频，需探究模型是否真需直接听取音频。
提出SleuthVLM，基于VLM构建agent，将语音转录为文本并自主探索视频。
无需直接听音频，该模型在多个基准上超越Gemini等模型，证明提升agent能力比增加音频数据更关键。

title: SynMOE: A Syntax-Aware MOE-Guided Approach for PEFT-Based Code Intelligence Learning
title_zh: 面向代码智能的语法感知MOE引导PEFT方法SynMOE
abstract: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) has emerged as an important approach for adapting Language Models (LMs) in downstream tasks. However, in the domain of code intelligence, the performance of most PEFT methods relatively drops compared to Full fine-Tuning (FT), hindering their broader applicability. One of the main reasons is that current PEFT methods are generally based on assumptions about the low-rank nature or sparsity of parameter updates, lacking explicit modeling of code-related information. To tackle this limitation, we propose SynMOE, a syntax-aware MOE-guided approach for PEFT on code intelligence learning. Specifically, SynMOE contains two stages: syntactic information extraction and syntax-aware MOE-guided adaptation. It first obtains the syntactic labels of source code from Abstract Syntax Trees (ASTs), and then aligns the labels with the input tokens of code LMs. In the second stage, syntactic labels are integrated into the MOE module, participating in the routing decision of MOE for a more powerful syntactic-aware token representation. We evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed approach by applying it to two typical PEFT methods, LoRA and $(IA)^3$, across three diverse code intelligence tasks. Experimental results show that SynMOE achieves consistent and significant improvements. Even compared to FT, SynMOE achieves comparable or superior performance while being more computationally efficient. In addition, we also conduct ablation studies, hyperparameter analysis, and evaluation in the low-resource scenario to provide a comprehensive investigation of the proposed approach.
summary_zh: 现有PEFT方法因缺乏对代码信息的显式建模，在代码智能任务上性能落后于全量微调。
提出SynMOE方法，先从AST提取语法标签并对齐输入token，再将其融入MOE模块参与路由决策。
实验表明SynMOE在多种任务上显著提升LoRA等PEFT性能，可比肩全量微调且计算更高效。

title: Adapting Qwen3 to Tajik from 0.6B to 8B: Lower Text Loss Did Not Mean Better Understanding
title_zh: Qwen3塔吉克语适配：更低文本损失未必意味更好理解
abstract: Small LoRA adapters trained on Tajik news and books lowered Qwen3's Tajik text loss at every size we tried, from 0.6B to 8B, by 0.60 to 1.45 nats per token, but none of them improved Tajik reading comprehension where it can be measured. On Belebele the 1.7B and 8B adapters left accuracy unchanged and the 4B adapter lowered it by 3.7 points; at 0.6B the score rose by 4.2 points but sits near chance and coincides with a change in which answer letter the model prefers, so we do not read it as understanding. At 8B, continued pretraining on about 375 million tokens of raw Tajik text was followed by a Belebele gain of 9.9 points. After a further supervised fine-tuning stage, our main model, e3, is 11.4 points above Qwen3-8B on Belebele; its English MMLU changed by -1.2 points, and a loss larger than 3.3 points is excluded. The same heavy recipe applied to Qwen3-0.6B-Base brought its text loss close to that of the 8B model after books-only pretraining, while its multiple-choice answers stayed near chance and its English MMLU fell by 7.6 points. We report 15 trained models and their 5 starting models from June to October 2025, scored in 2026 on one harness with paired intervals, and we report what went wrong: lost training records, a thinking-mode dataset with almost no reasoning in it, later branches whose training data was never documented, and a 4-bit release that contains no transformer layers.
summary_zh: 问题：LoRA微调降低了Qwen3各规模的塔吉克语文本损失，但未提升阅读理解能力。
方法：对比LoRA与持续预训练加监督微调（SFT），并排查训练记录丢失等工程问题。
结论：重度训练流程显著提升8B模型理解力，但小模型仅降损失且严重损害英文能力。

title: Reglos: A Self-Evolving Personal Memory Agent with Recursive Self-Improvement
title_zh: Reglos：具备递归自我改进的自演化个人记忆Agent
abstract: Personal agents draw on past conversations to tailor their responses to each user. Their memory systems store and update what each user says, and coding agents now also rewrite the harness that turns this memory into the model's context. Such patches risk overfitting, because one tested only on the failures it targets can fix those cases and help nowhere else. We present Reglos, a training-free personal memory agent that tests whether harness changes help beyond the failures they were written to fix. Its self-evolving memory adds to each user's append-only record with every conversation, as new preferences supersede old ones and facts can be forgotten. Its harness improves through recursive self-improvement, in which a coding agent proposes patches from failure traces and a critic from a second model family screens each one for benchmark gaming. After the harness is frozen, a fixed evaluator decides which further patches to accept. With the same backbone behind every system, Reglos outperforms state-of-the-art memory systems such as Mem0, MemOS and EverOS, reaching 61.3% and 84.0% on PersonaMem-v2 and LongMemEval-S with Qwen3.8-27B, and 57.5% and 87.2% with GPT-5.6 Luna.
summary_zh: 现有个人记忆Agent修改上下文处理代码易导致过拟合，仅能修复特定失败案例而缺乏泛化能力。
提出Reglos，一种免训练的记忆Agent，通过递归自我改进机制让编码Agent提议补丁，并由异构模型critic审查以防刷榜。
在相同骨干模型下，Reglos性能超越Mem0等SOTA系统，在PersonaMem和LongMemEval基准上取得显著提升。
Reglos采用仅追加的用户记录实现自演化记忆，并在harness冻结后由固定评估器决定补丁接受，确保系统稳定改进。

title: RI-Prune: Relation and Information Aware Visual Token Pruning for Multi-Image Vision-Language Models
title_zh: 面向多图像视觉语言模型的关联与信息感知视觉Token剪枝
abstract: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have recently been extended to handle multiple input images, but this extension dramatically increases the visual token budget, making visual-token pruning not merely an efficiency option but a practical necessity. Existing visual-token pruning methods, primarily designed for the single-image setting, rely on attention-derived saliency signals to estimate per-token importance. However, this attention-centric design transfers poorly to the multi-image regime: it causes substantial performance degradation on multi-image benchmarks, suffers from strong positional bias, and loses discriminative attention signals as the number of input images increases. To test whether attention-selected tokens are truly important for multi-image reasoning, we conduct two complementary causal probes Leave-One-In and Leave-One-Deletion, which measure token importance by restoring individual tokens to a zeroed visual sequence or removing them from the full sequence. Attention-based pruners provide only marginal gains over random selection, showing that attention is a weak proxy for visual-token importance in multi-image reasoning. Motivated by this gap, we propose Relation and Information Aware Pruning (RI-Prune), a training-free, attention-free pre-decoder selector for multi-image visual token pruning. RI-Prune scores each visual token using a z-normalized combination of three signals computed from projector outputs: query relevance, cross-image correspondence with compact per-image prototypes, and intra image representativeness. By integrating these signals, RI-Prune performs balanced per-image Top-K selection to preserve information across input images. Across multiple multi-image benchmarks and three LVLM backbones, RI-Prune achieves a stronger trade-off between token reduction and task performance than prior pruning methods, particularly under aggressive token budgets.
summary_zh: 多图像输入使视觉Token激增，现有基于注意力的剪枝方法存在位置偏置且随图像增加性能剧降。
通过因果探针实验发现，注意力信号在多图像推理中是Token重要性的弱代理，效果仅略优于随机选择。
提出无需训练的RI-Prune方法，融合查询相关性、跨图像对应与图像内代表性三种信号进行均衡Top-K剪枝，实现更优性能。

title: USI-Brain: Enhancing Underwater Spatial Intelligence via Spatial Data-Driven Vision-Language Modeling
title_zh: USI-Brain：基于空间数据驱动的水下视觉语言建模
abstract: Underwater spatial reasoning depends on object boundaries and geometric cues that are obscured by scattering, color distortion, and low visibility. Existing underwater resources capture these cues through images, annotations, and depth maps, but provide fragmented supervision for vision-language models. We present a spatial data engine that connects visual appearance with object-level geometry through enhancement, 2D and geometry-assisted question generation, and expert filtering. It produces 4.27M QA pairs across five capability groups. We use this corpus to train USI-Brain and introduce an Underwater Prior-guided Rectifier (UPR) that applies gated corrections to visual features. USI-Bench evaluates the resulting capabilities with 6,525 held-out QA pairs. On its 15 task metrics, USI-Brain and USI-Brain + UPR improve over Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct by 5.76 and 7.63 points on average, respectively, using signed differences on 100-point scales. Ablations show that geometry-assisted supervision improves depth and ordering by 4.8 and 6.1 points with UPR disabled, while UPR adds 18.0 points in scene description under matched training data. Both variants use raw images at evaluation. Across NautData, UWBench, and MarineEval, USI-Brain achieves the best or joint-best score on 28 of 32 metrics. Model weights and USI-Bench will be released at https://github.com/SKY-Zhu-91/USI-Brain.
summary_zh: 水下空间推理受制于散射与低能见度，现有数据对视觉语言模型监督碎片化，提出空间数据引擎生成427万QA对。
利用该语料训练USI-Brain模型，并引入水下先验修正器UPR，对视觉特征进行门控校正以增强空间感知。
在USI-Bench等基准上，USI-Brain及结合UPR的版本显著超越基线模型，在32项指标中28项取得最优。

title: A Controlled Experimental Evaluation of Configuration and Cache Architecture in LLM Serving Engines
title_zh: LLM服务引擎配置与缓存架构的受控实验评估
abstract: Multi-agent LLM applications repeat most of their prompt tokens across requests, and serving engines reuse the cached state of shared prefixes. vLLM and SGLang reuse it at different granularities, and benchmarks of their default deployments report large performance gaps, usually credited to the cache. Such comparisons rarely control for other configuration differences. One of them, whether a long prompt is prefilled in chunks, is set by each engine's defaults from the hardware and the release, and it confounds the comparison. We built a reproducible testbed on Kubernetes and a seeded multi-agent workload generator, and compared the two engines under vendor defaults and with chunked prefill matched. SGLang's configuration is the same in both arms, which makes it an internal control across independently provisioned deployments. Under defaults, vLLM's median time to first token is up to 64x SGLang's. Matching one setting removes 78% of the capacity gap where that gap is largest and 30 to 67% of the latency gap. Near saturation the remaining latency gap reflects queue growth. A fluid queue model driven only by a 4.4% throughput shortfall reproduces it, and shows that such a gap scales with the length of the benchmark run. What survives matching is a tail-latency advantage of 2.4 to 6.4x at equal throughput, consistent with cache-aware ordering of waiting requests. We derive six recommendations for comparing serving engines.
summary_zh: 多智能体LLM应用存在共享前缀，但现有引擎（vLLM与SGLang）对比未控制分块预填充等配置差异，导致性能评估失真。
构建可复现K8s测试床与多智能体负载生成器，在默认配置与匹配分块预填充设置下，对两引擎进行受控对比实验。
匹配单一配置可消除最大容量差距的78%及延迟差距的30-67%；剩余延迟差距源于队列增长，SGLang保留2.4-6.4倍尾延迟优势。

title: Enforcing Accountable Disclosure in Confidential AI
title_zh: 机密AI中的可问责披露系统CORDE
abstract: Advances in CPU and GPU confidential computing enable confidential AI, allowing LLMs to process user prompts without exposing them to service providers or infrastructure operators. However, AI agents often need to send prompt-derived information to external services, and providers may also require limited disclosure for safety monitoring and failure diagnosis. We propose CORDE, a system for confidential virtual machines (CVMs) designed to satisfy the principle of Confine or Declare: user-derived data is confined by default, but when necessary, it may leave the CVM only after being "declared." To "declare" data is to record its exact contents, recipient, and stated reason in a user-accessible, tamper-evident declaration log. To put this principle into practice, we present an integrated system design that combines per-user information-flow control in Rust with a TEE-based ledger and remote attestation. Our evaluation on an NVIDIA H100 GPU shows that declaration before disclosure adds little overhead in task latency, about 0.5% on the AppWorld agent benchmark. CORDE provides a basis for accountable disclosure of user data, supporting responsible and transparent data management in AI services.
summary_zh: 机密AI中，Agent需向外部服务发送数据，且需有限披露以监控安全，导致用户数据泄露风险。
提出CORDE系统，遵循“限制或声明”原则，数据默认受限，若需披露则须记录内容、接收方及原因至防篡改日志。
结合Rust信息流控制与TEE账本，在H100 GPU上评估显示，声明披露仅增加约0.5%延迟，实现可问责数据管理。

title: Graph-Mediated Large Language Model Systems in the Agentic Era: Reasoning, Knowledge, Retrieval, Execution, and Coordination
title_zh: 智能体时代的图介导大语言模型系统
abstract: Graphs play an increasingly important role in large language model (LLM) systems, supporting structural reasoning, knowledge grounding, retrieval, and memory. As these systems evolve toward the agentic era, graphs also organize execution dependencies and multi-agent communication, linking intermediate observations and retained information to subsequent decisions. However, understanding their contribution requires distinguishing the function of each graph operation, the component responsible for its computation, and the subsequent use of its output. This survey introduces an operation-level role--locus taxonomy for reasoning, knowledge and evidence, retrieval and memory, execution, and coordination. We compare how graph observations and external computations guide decisions, how memory representations and updates support later tasks, and how dependencies constrain execution and information delivery. These comparisons distinguish improvements in local metrics from downstream task performance while retaining the conditions under which results were reported. We then organize benchmarks, comparison designs, process diagnostics, and system costs into an evaluation framework. Finally, we identify open challenges in adaptive computation and stopping, memory maintenance, and dependency-aware recovery. The survey provides a basis for assessing when graph mechanisms are useful and for evaluating their effects across components and stages.
summary_zh: LLM系统向智能体演进，图结构支撑其推理与检索，但缺乏对图操作、计算组件及输出用途的区分。
提出操作级角色-轨迹分类法，对比图观测与外部计算对决策的引导，及依赖约束对执行与信息传递的限制。
构建含基准与系统成本等的评估框架，指出自适应计算、记忆维护与依赖感知恢复等开放挑战。

title: Reward Budgeting Reduces Premature Convergence in Reinforcement Learning for LLM Reasoning
title_zh: 奖励预算减少LLM推理强化学习的早熟收敛
abstract: RL for LLM reasoning often reaches an early performance plateau as the policy distribution becomes increasingly sharp. Recent work has studied policy entropy as both a diagnostic and a control signal for this behavior. In our experiments, however, increasing entropy alone does not reliably change the eventual plateau. We analyze RL through its implicit target policy and derive a sharpness factor $κ$, together with an effective counterpart $κ_{\mathrm{eff}}$, that describes how strongly reward or advantage gaps are translated into probability-ratio gaps.
